Method: 提出 AI Cosmos 智能体基础设施：将学习者与角色专门化的智能体组织进学习情景，情景中整合任务相关知识并在需要时提供可执行工作台；同时设计资产记忆循环（asset-memory loop），把实践过程与结果保存为带显式来源（provenance）与依赖关系的可复用资产。评估采用两项预注册随机对照实验，分别考察法律推理与编程能力获得，并在各实验条件间固定使用同一底层 LLM。

Result: 在法律推理上，AI Cosmos 相比常规 LLM 取得更大的学习增益；在编程上，对未见问题的掌握程度高于 LLM-as-Teacher 基线。

Conclusion: 结果表明，以情景化参与和累积性实践资产为核心的学习组织方式，能够带来超越单纯 LLM 辅助的学习效果，尤其体现在知识迁移与未见问题解决能力上。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can improve task performance during learning, yet these gains do not necessarily reflect learners' ability to thereafter apply the knowledge and skills independently. We present AI Cosmos, an agentic infrastructure for situated learning that organizes learning around two complementary principles: scenario-based participation and cumulative assets of practice. AI Cosmos organizes learners and role-specialized agents within learning scenarios that integrate task-relevant knowledge and, when needed, executable workbenches. An asset-memory loop preserves the processes and outcomes of practice as reusable assets with explicit provenance and dependencies. We evaluate scenario-based interaction through two preregistered randomized controlled studies examining the acquisition of legal reasoning and programming competence, holding the same underlying LLM across conditions. AI Cosmos achieves greater learning gains than a conventional LLM in legal reasoning and higher mastery of unseen programming problems than an LLM-as-Teacher baseline.

</details>


### [283] [Rethinking Pre-pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40051)
*Alexander Stern,Tim Rocktäschel,Acyr Locatelli,Laura Ruis*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 在算力匹配的实验下，将算力分配给合成数据进行"预预训练"(PPT)的效果始终不如纯自然语言训练；此前报告的PPT增益依赖于权重初始化方案，且PPT所学内容在后续自然语言训练中会被遗忘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验"合成数据预预训练"(PPT)作为独立训练阶段是否真能提升语言模型训练效率，特别是纠正以往结果可能受初始化方案混淆的问题，并在多种数据约束条件下系统评估其价值。

Method: 设置四种PPT课程（k-Dyck、神经细胞自动机NCA、声明式参考语料、代码）与三种训练情形（数据受限、数据不受限、高token/参数比881M参数/50B token）；在算力匹配条件下对比纯自然语言训练；复现NCA实验并考察不同权重初始化方案；比较数据受限时重复epoch与合成课程；另设PPT获得额外算力（而非占用自然语言预算）的情形；并分析PPT知识的遗忘与交错训练(interleaving)效果。

Result: 数据稀缺时，对100M token语料重复多epoch在自然语言验证损失上优于所有合成课程，且下游准确率无一致优势；复现NCA在原始初始化下得到5.4%困惑度改善，但改进初始化后两种方法均提升且无PPT基线提升更多，差距缩小；当PPT获额外算力时，小自然语言预算下增益仍存在，但在1B token时消失；模型在后续自然语言训练中遗忘PPT所学，交错训练可防止遗忘但未显著提升自然语言性能。

Conclusion: 合成预预训练作为独立训练阶段的收益有限，以往增益对初始化方案敏感且易被遗忘；应重新思考此类合成数据在语言模型训练中的使用方式。

Abstract: We report that allocating compute to synthetic pre-pretraining (PPT) never outperforms pure natural-language training in our compute-matched experiments. This holds across four PPT curricula (k-Dyck, neural cellular automata (NCA), declarative reference corpora, and code) and three training regimes: data-constrained, data-unconstrained, and a high token-to-parameter-ratio regime (881M parameters trained on 50B tokens). When natural language is scarce, repeated epochs over a 100M-token corpus beat every synthetic curriculum on natural-language validation loss, with no consistent downstream accuracy advantage from PPT. We find that PPT gains reported in prior work are sensitive to the weight initialization scheme. In an NCA reproduction, we recover a 5.4% perplexity improvement from PPT under the original initialization scheme. An alternative scheme improves both methods, but the no-PPT baseline more, closing the gap between them. However, when PPT receives additional compute rather than a share of the natural-language budget, gains persist at small natural-language budgets even with improved initialization, but disappear by 1B tokens. Finally, models forget what they learn during PPT in subsequent natural-language training; interleaving the same data throughout training prevents forgetting, but does not significantly improve natural-language performance. Our results suggest limited benefits of synthetic pre-pretraining as a distinct training stage and motivate rethinking how such data are used in language model training.

</details>


### [284] [Upcycling Language Models for Multiple Specialized Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40091)
*Mingzi Cao,Xi Wang,Nikolaos Aletras*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling)，通过将稠密层扩展为专家+路由器的upcycling结构，并引入领域感知监督，使路由器学会按领域选择专家；微调时仅更新对应专家与路由器，在多领域适配中取得最高平均性能且保留通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多领域适配需优先利用相关领域知识并减少无关领域干扰。现有基于LoRA的方法要么对各适配器等权加权（忽略输入领域），要么动态加权但仍激活全部（含无关）适配器；且低秩结构限制性能上限，upcycling容量更大但缺少让路由器有效区分领域的机制。

Method: DS-Upcycling：将稠密Transformer层upcycle为专家集合加路由器；引入新的领域感知监督（domain-aware supervision），使路由器通过学习选择合适专家来区分领域；在每个新领域上微调时，仅更新对应专家与路由器，冻结其余全部参数。

Result: 在适配领域上平均性能高于所有基线，同时保留通用性能；每领域仅用256条样本作路由器监督时，适配后路由准确率达90–98%，而无该方法的路由器仅43–70%。

Conclusion: DS-Upcycling以upcycling扩展容量并用领域感知监督训练路由器，实现高精度领域路由与低干扰的多领域适配，在性能与通用能力保持上优于现有LoRA类方案。

Abstract: Effective multi-domain adaptation of large language models requires prioritizing relevant domain knowledge while minimizing interference from irrelevant domains. Existing approaches commonly use Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) to train a separate adapter for each domain and combine these adapters within one model. However, they either weight adapters equally regardless of the input domain or dynamically weight adapters while still activating all of them including irrelevant ones. Additionally, while efficient, their low-rank structure limits performance. In contrast, upcycling is a model expansion method that adds experts and a router to a dense Transformer layer offering larger capacity than LoRA approaches. In this paper, we propose Domain-Specialized Upcycling (DS-Upcycling) for multi-domain adaptation. We introduce a new domain-aware supervision that allows the router to effectively learn to distinguish domains by selecting the appropriate experts. During fine-tuning on each new domain, we update only the corresponding expert and router while freezing all other parameters. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest average performance across the adapted domains compared to baselines while retaining general performance. With just 256 examples per domain for router supervision, DS-Upcycling achieves 90-98% routing accuracy after adaptation compared with 43-70% for routers trained without our approach.

</details>


### [285] [Towards Full-Text Scholarly Argument Mining using Entity-Anchored Claim Extraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40196)
*Bhuvanesh Verma,Andy Lüking,Mounika Marreddy,Leon Lukas Hammerla,Alexander Mehler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文利用科学实体提及（任务、数据集、模型）识别并结构化全文文献中的论断（claims），构建人Gold标准与LLM多数投票生成的Silver数据集（1,487条claims），验证仅在Silver上微调的编码器优于小规模人工Gold训练，并能零样本迁移到训练语料外的NLP论文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全文论证挖掘需建模长距离依赖，且句级论证成分标注代价高、耗时长，形成标注瓶颈；作者希望借助科学实体提及降低对人工标注的依赖。

Method: 以50篇情感分析全文论文为案例：(1) 建立人工Gold标准（Krippendorff's α=0.80），从300个候选句中确定113个含claim句子并抽取199条结构化claim记录；(2) 采用LLM多数投票集成生成1,487条claims的Silver数据集；(3) 用编码器在Silver上微调，并与小规模人工Gold微调对比，测试跨语料零样本迁移。

Result: 人工标注一致性α=0.80；300候选句中得到113个claim-bearing句子、199条结构化claim记录；LLM集成产出1,487条Silver claims；仅Silver微调的编码器性能超过小Gold微调模型，并在训练语料外的NLP论文上表现出较强零样本迁移能力。

Conclusion: 以科学实体为锚点可有效识别与结构化论断；LLM多数投票生成的Silver数据可作为人工标注的可行替代，缓解标注瓶颈并具备跨域泛化潜力。

Abstract: Argument mining in full-text scholarly articles remains an important yet challenging task. This difficulty stems not only from the need to model long-distance dependencies but also from the substantial effort required to annotate sentence-level argumentative components throughout lengthy documents. To address these challenges, we introduce a novel approach that leverages scientific entity mentions (e.g., tasks, datasets, and models) to identify and structure claims in scholarly literature. We validate our approach through a case study involving 50 full-text research papers on sentiment analysis. We first establish a reliable human gold standard (Krippendorff's $α= 0.80$), identifying 113 claim-bearing sentences and extracting 199 structured claim records from 300 candidate sentences. To address the annotation bottleneck, we employ a majority-voting ensemble of large language models (LLMs) to generate a silver-standard dataset comprising 1,487 claims. Encoders fine-tuned exclusively on the silver-standard dataset outperform those trained on a small human-annotated gold-standard dataset and demonstrate strong zero-shot transfer to NLP papers outside the training corpus.

</details>


### [286] [Mobilizing the Archive: Bitext Extraction at Scale from Archival Documents for Extremely Low-resource Languages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40233)
*Chutong Meng,Alec J. Bateman,Antonios Anastasopoulos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出从语言学文献（语法书、词典等）中抽取翻译例句，构建面向网络资源匮乏语言的平行语料抽取流水线（OCR+VLM），并在20种语言上验证其用于训练MT模型和LLM上下文学习的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于网页挖掘平行句对的方法对低资源机器翻译有效，但世界上大多数语言几乎没有网络存在感；它们拥有的是语言学家数百年积累的语法书、词典等文献资源，这些资源蕴含可为网络低代表性语言提供平行数据，并有望扩展到数千种语言。

Method: 设计一条从语言学文献中抽取翻译示例的流水线，借助OCR模型与视觉语言模型（VLM），确保识别出的内容与视觉版面布局信息对齐，从而提取双语文本（bitext）。

Result: 在20种语言上验证所抽取双语文本的效用：既用于训练机器翻译模型，也用于大语言模型的上下文学习；在上下文学习设置下，向低资源语言和高资源语言翻译分别较零样本翻译提升+15.78和+6.94 chrF2++。

Conclusion: 语言学文献可作为一种被忽视但极具价值的平行数据来源，能够为网络低代表性语言自举翻译系统，并具备扩展到更多语言的潜力。

Abstract: While mining parallel sentences from web pages has proven effective for low-resource machine translation, the majority of the world's languages have little to no web presence. What they do have, though, are resources that are the result of centuries of efforts by linguists, such as grammars, dictionaries, and other documentation materials. We propose extracting translation examples from such linguistic resources, which offer parallel data for languages under-represented online and could potentially scale to thousands more languages. We develop a pipeline to achieve this, leveraging an Optical Character Recognition (OCR) model as well as a vision language model (VLM), to ensure identified content to be aligned with visual layout information. We demonstrate the utility of the extracted bitexts for bootstrapping translation systems across 20 languages, both by training machine translation models and by applying in-context learning for large language models. For in-context learning, we observe improvements of +15.78 and +6.94 chrF2++ over zero-shot translation for into low- and high-resource languages, respectively.

</details>


### [287] [ScienceJudge: Pattern Perturbation Augmentation for Sentence-Level Scientific Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40238)
*Chuhai Cai,Xin Chen,Min Yang,Feng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Pattern Perturbation Augmentation（PPA），将报道错误建模为标签特定的保真度破坏变换以构造可控硬负样本，并结合视觉-语言预测器与LLM预测器的类加权集成系统ScienceJudge，用于句子级多模态科学主张验证，在NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1官方榜单排名第一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 句子级科学主张验证需判断AI生成科学段落中每句话是否被多模态证据包支持。细粒度报道错误往往保持文本流畅合理，仅引入细微的证据—主张偏差，在稀疏且类别不均衡的监督下难以检测。

Method: PPA从标注样本中归纳可复用的错误模式，将其视为标签特定的保真度破坏变换，施加于被支持的claim上生成受控硬负样本，并通过模式级、操作级与跨域增强扩展覆盖；在此基础上构建ScienceJudge，融合经PPA训练的视觉-语言预测器与指令引导的LLM预测器，采用类加权集成推理。

Result: 本地开发集平均分由0.8124提升至0.8692，Macro-F1为0.8466，段落精确匹配（Paragraph Exact Match）为0.8919；提交系统以0.6890的最终分数在NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1官方榜单排名第一。

Conclusion: 以错误模式驱动的受控负样本增强可有效缓解细粒度报道错误的稀疏、不均衡监督问题，配合异构模型集成显著提升多模态科学主张验证性能并取得榜单最优结果。

Abstract: Sentence-level scientific claim verification determines whether each sentence in an AI-generated scientific paragraph is supported by a given multimodal evidence bundle. Fine-grained reporting errors often preserve fluent and plausible statements while introducing subtle evidence-claim deviations, making them difficult to detect under sparse and imbalanced supervision. We propose Pattern Perturbation Augmentation (PPA), which models reporting errors as label-specific faithfulness breaking transformations and induces reusable error patterns from labeled examples. PPA applies these patterns to supported claims to construct controlled hard negatives and expands their coverage through pattern-level, operation-level, and cross-domain augmentation. Based on these augmented views, we develop ScienceJudge, which integrates PPA-trained vision-language predictors and instruction-guided LLM predictors through class-weighted ensemble inference. On the local development set, ScienceJudge improves the average score from 0.8124 to 0.8692, achieving a Macro-F1 of 0.8466 and a Paragraph Exact Match score of 0.8919. Our submitted system ranks first on the official NLPCC 2026 Task 10 Track 1 leaderboard with a final score of 0.6890.

</details>


### [288] [Judged in Company: In-Context Batching Makes LLM Verdicts Depend on Other Items](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40241)
*Peng Xie,Amr Alanwar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 多条目批量打分并不满足"判决可分离"假设：换随机分批可使11–22%（4–9B）或6–15%（14–32B）的判决翻转，且与单项打分的AUROC差异很小（-0.033~+0.010），说明分数近似稳定而判决高度不稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实践中为节省成本，常让语言模型在单个提示中同时评判多个独立条目，这隐含假设各条目判决互不影响、与位置无关。论文旨在检验该可分离性假设是否成立，并量化批量评判引入的判决不稳定性。

Method: 在三类评判任务（社交媒体评论有害性、简答题评分、评论星级）上，用4–9B与14–32B的开源权重模型，将同一批2,000个条目按不同的随机分批（每批25条）重新组合，比较判决翻转率；对抗性对照为改条目键名与改写指令。进一步将翻转率精确分解为顺序、槽位、成员构成三部分，并在阈值模型下推导翻转率随上下文贡献方差以平方根增长的规律；另用编辑单次生成实验分别检验模型自身先前判决与邻近文本的作用。

Result: 分批重排导致有害性与评分任务11–22%（4–9B）、6–15%（14–32B）判决改变，比改键名/改写指令高6.5–13.3与4.2–9.1个百分点；而AUROC相对单项仅变化-0.033~+0.010。翻转主要源于邻居顺序与槽位；条目成员构成效应占0.11–0.22，九次排列多数投票仍残留52–60%翻转；十五个随机批次的多数与单项判决在8.4–17.8%判决上不一致。简单任务（星级）仅2.9–3.9%改变。编辑生成表明模型自身先前判决与邻居文本均起作用。

Conclusion: 批量判决不具可分离性；小分数扰动经阈值放大为大量判决翻转。建议对歧义条目单条一提示评判，用缓存前缀回收成本，并在批量评判时额外报告与单项打分的一致率。

Abstract: To save cost, practitioners often ask a language model to grade many independent items in one prompt. This assumes that verdicts are separable: that the verdict on an item does not depend on the other items in the prompt or on its position among them. Across three judgement tasks (harm in social-media comments, short-answer grading and review star ratings) and five open-weight models with 4-9B parameters, assigning the same 2,000 items to different random batches of 25 changes 11-22% of decisions on harm and grading, 6.5-13.3 points more than renaming the item keys or rewording the instruction, while AUROC against human labels differs from single-item grading only by -0.033 to +0.010; for four models with 14-32B parameters, 6-15% of decisions change, 4.2-9.1 points more. We show that flip rates decompose exactly into components of order, slot and membership, and that under a threshold model they grow with the square root of the variance that the context contributes, so that effects that are small for scores are large for decisions. Most of the latent dissimilarity between partitions comes from the order of the neighbours and the slot. The main effect of which items share the prompt, the part that voting over permutations of a batch cannot remove, accounts for 0.11-0.22 of it, and majority votes over nine permutations still leave 52-60% of the flips. Batched verdicts also differ systematically from single-item verdicts: even the majority of fifteen random batches disagrees with them on 8.4-17.8% of decisions. Editing a single generation shows that both the model's own earlier verdicts and the neighbours' texts carry the effect. On the easy task, star ratings, only 2.9-3.9% of decisions change. We recommend grading ambiguous items one per prompt, recovering most of the cost with a cached prefix, and reporting agreement with single-item grading whenever items are batched.

</details>


### [289] [Latent Path Exploration via Potential-Guided Subtrajectory Balance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40283)
*Xiaoling Zeng,Qi Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 SubLAT，将相对答案势函数与 Subtrajectory Balance 结合，学习连续隐空间中的随机探索，使采样到的隐状态转移更趋向有效推理路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续隐空间推理可免去显式推理链生成，随机隐推理支持在连续空间采样多条路径，但随机性本身不足以保证有效探索；核心难点在于如何引导中间隐状态之间的随机转移走向有用的推理路径。

Method: 设计相对答案势函数，以终止状态的正确性信号为基准，比较采样状态与替换状态的答案支持度；引入 Subtrajectory Balance，将势差与不同长度子轨迹上的前向、后向转移密度关联；联合使用答案监督、CoT 监督与表示蒸馏训练。

Result: 在算术与演绎推理任务上，随采样预算增大解覆盖度提升，域内与域外基准均如此，并在若干结构化 OOD 基准上改进；轨迹分析显示采样隐路径逐步分化，且算术基准上正确轨迹的平均相对势更高。

Conclusion: 以相对势驱动的子轨迹平衡可为连续隐推理提供有效的探索引导，提升解覆盖度与跨域泛化，并呈现可解释的轨迹分化现象。

Abstract: Continuous latent reasoning enables language models to perform intermediate computation without generating explicit reasoning traces. Advances in stochastic latent reasoning allow multiple paths to be sampled in continuous space, but stochasticity alone does not ensure effective exploration. A key challenge is guiding stochastic transitions between intermediate latent states toward useful reasoning paths. We introduce SubLAT, which couples a relative answer potential with Subtrajectory Balance to learn stochastic latent exploration. The relative potential evaluates the answer support of sampled states against replacement states, with a correctness signal at the terminal state. Subtrajectory Balance relates potential differences to forward and backward transition densities across subtrajectories of different lengths. The model is jointly trained with answer supervision, CoT supervision, and representation distillation. Experiments on arithmetic and deductive reasoning show increasing solution coverage with larger sampling budgets across in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks, as well as improvements on several structural OOD benchmarks. Trajectory analyses reveal progressive divergence among sampled latent paths and higher mean relative potentials for correct trajectories across arithmetic benchmarks.

</details>


### [290] [Decision and System One models in rheumatology: accuracy and calibration on specialty-training examination questions and diagnostic case vignettes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40318)
*Alfredo Madrid-García,Diego Benavent,Fabian Lechner,Phillip Kremer,Johannes Knitza,Beatriz Merino-Barbancho*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究评估了四个System One模型（Jev 1.13、Clef、Microsoft-Decision-1、Laya）与GPT-6 Luna、GPT-6 Sol及两个本地生成模型在风湿病学考试题和诊断病例题上的准确性与校准，发现System One模型在考试题上表现高但病例题上明显下降，且高置信度预测可靠性不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: System One（快速直觉型）推理模型在医学问答中的准确性与置信度校准尚缺乏系统评估，尤其在不同任务类型（考试题vs诊断病例）和不同语言下的表现是否一致尚不清楚，需要任务特异性的评测来指导临床应用。

Method: 采用两个基准：扩增版RheumaMIR数据集（172道西班牙专科培训风湿病考题，西/英双语）与RheumBench（70个英文诊断病例，每个含5–18个候选诊断，其中52个包含正确诊断；随机基线9.6%）。比较4个System One模型、GPT-6 Luna、GPT-6 Sol及2个本地生成模型；主要结局为准确率，次要结局为校准度、区分度、概率≥0.90答案的准确率及语言差异。

Result: RheumaMIR中Jev准确率西语93.0%、英语91.9%，低于GPT-6 Sol（99.4%，Holm校正P≤0.005）；GPT-6 Luna 97.7%、Clef 91.9–93.0%、Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0–87.8%，无显著语言差异；Jev概率≥0.90的答案（占76–77%）正确率98.5%。RheumBench中准确率普遍下降：GPT-6 Sol 76.9%、GPT-6 Luna 63.5%、Clef 59.6%、Jev 50.0%、Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4%（均低于GPT-6 Sol，P≤0.045）；Jev出现过度自信（平均概率0.659，过度/不足自信指数+0.159），其≥0.90概率答案（占25%）正确率84.6%，而GPT-6 Luna（占42%）为95.5%；Laya在两基准上接近随机水平。

Conclusion: 表现最佳的System One模型在考试题上高度准确，但在诊断病例上准确率明显下降且仍逊于GPT-6 Sol；Jev的高置信度预测在病例题上可靠性降低，凸显任务特异性评估与置信度校准的必要性。

Abstract: Objectives: To evaluate the accuracy and calibration of Decision and System One models on rheumatology examination questions and diagnostic vignettes. Methods: Two benchmarks were analysed: 172 rheumatology questions from Spanish specialty-training examinations (expanded RheumaMIR dataset) in Spanish and English, and 70 English diagnostic vignettes from RheumBench with 5-18 candidate diagnoses, 52 of which included the reference diagnosis. Four System One models (Jev 1.13, Clef, Microsoft-Decision-1, Laya) and GPT-6 Luna (OpenAI Decisions API) were compared with GPT-6 Sol and two local generative models. The primary outcome was accuracy; secondary outcomes included calibration, discrimination, accuracy of answers with probability >=0.90 and language differences. Results: In RheumaMIR, Jev's accuracy was 93.0% in Spanish and 91.9% in English, below GPT-6 Sol (99.4%; Holm-adjusted P<=0.005); GPT-6 Luna reached 97.7%, Clef 91.9-93.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 86.0-87.8%, without detectable language differences. Jev's answers with probability >=0.90 (76-77% of answers) were 98.5% correct. In RheumBench, accuracy was lower: GPT-6 Sol 76.9%, GPT-6 Luna 63.5%, Clef 59.6%, Jev 50.0% and Microsoft-Decision-1 40.4% (each System One model below GPT-6 Sol, Holm-adjusted P<=0.045; chance 9.6%). Jev became overconfident (mean probability 0.659; over/underconfidence index +0.159), and its answers with probability >=0.90 (25% of cases) were 84.6% correct, against 95.5% for GPT-6 Luna (42%). Laya performed near chance in both benchmarks. Conclusion: The best-performing System One models were highly accurate on examination questions but less accurate on diagnostic vignettes, remaining below GPT-6 Sol. Jev's high-confidence predictions were less reliable on vignettes, highlighting the need for task-specific evaluation and calibration.

</details>


### [291] [Don't Lose the Thread: Empowering Long-Horizon LLM Agents with Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40350)
*Zheng Zhu,Xiaozhuan Liang,Xi Chen,Bei Yu,Jiaya Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出CORAL，一种让LLM智能体自主管理工作记忆的推理范式，通过任务检查点与上下文重置解决长程任务中的认知过载问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中因工作记忆不断膨胀、充斥无关信息而注意力被稀释，导致规划与推理失效（认知过载）。

Method: CORAL以智能体可调用的工作记忆管理工具集形式实现，允许智能体对任务进度和已验证事实做检查点，并自适应开启新的解题回合，清空杂乱上下文仅保留检查点信息，从干净状态恢复推理；同时用多回合智能体强化策略优化（Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization）增强检查点能力。

Result: GAIA基准上8B模型达42.8%平均准确率，在高难长程任务（Level 2/3）提升尤其显著；输入token比ReAct智能体少6-7倍；可泛化至多跳知识问答基准及更难的BrowseComp，并使强商用智能体提升8.0分。

Conclusion: 通过上下文自管理与检查点重置机制，CORAL在提升长程推理性能的同时显著降低推理成本，验证了工作记忆主动分配的有效性与可迁移性。

Abstract: Agents powered by large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in solving complex reasoning tasks. However, LLM agents often falter on long-horizon tasks due to cognitive overload, as their working memory becomes cluttered with expanding and irrelevant information, which dilutes their attention and hinders effective planning and reasoning. To mitigate this challenge, we introduce Cognitive Resource Self-Allocation (CORAL), a novel reasoning paradigm that empowers agents to proactively optimize their context. Implemented as an agent-callable working memory management toolset, CORAL allows an agent to checkpoint its task progress and verified facts, and adaptively initiate a new problem-solving episode by resetting cluttered context while preserving only the checkpointed information, enabling it to resume reasoning from a clean state. We further enhance the agent's checkpointing capabilities using a Multi-episode Agentic Reinforced Policy Optimization algorithm. On the GAIA benchmark, CORAL with an 8B model achieves 42.8% average accuracy, with particularly strong gains on the most challenging long-horizon tasks (Level 2 and Level 3). Crucially, these gains come at a substantially lower inference cost: CORAL consumes 6-7$\times$ fewer input tokens than a ReAct agent. It also generalizes to multi-hop Knowledge QA benchmarks and to the considerably harder BrowseComp, where it improves a strong proprietary agent by 8.0 points.

</details>


### [292] [Scaling Mathematical Proof Supervision from Structured Textbooks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40394)
*Youqing Fang,Zhouqi Hua,Yinhao Tang,Yuzhe Gu,Lingkai Kong,Bin Liu,Weiming Zhang,Kai Chen,Yanan Sun,Wenwei Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文构建了TOME-Math语料库（2,118本大学数学教材→约38万条结构化证明监督记录），保留章节顺序、命题—证明链接、依赖引用与来源追溯，并据此研究课程学习与数据规模/来源广度的缩放规律，微调后较基座模型平均提升16.7个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数学监督数据通常被扁平化为孤立的“问题—解答”对，丢弃了原始教材的课程组织与论证（证据）结构，导致依赖关系、命题—证明对应等关键信息损失。

Method: 构建TOME-Math大规模语料：将2,118本覆盖大学数学核心学科的教材转换为约380K条结构化证明监督记录，显式建模章节顺序、命题—证明链接、依赖引用及来源溯源；基于这些结构信号开展跨学科课程学习，并刻画监督数量与来源广度的缩放模式。

Result: 在完整规模下，TOME-Math微调使模型在留出评测与公开基准上的未加权平均分较基座模型提升16.7个百分点，并在总体上优于所评估的三个公开指令数据基线。

Conclusion: 结构化教材既是可扩展的数学监督来源，也是研究数据组织方式对数学推理影响的实证框架；作者将公开语料以促进后续研究。

Abstract: Mathematical supervision for language models is typically flattened into isolated problem-solution pairs, discarding the curricular organization and evidential structure of the original sources. We introduce TOME-Math (Textbook-Oriented Mathematical Evidence), a large-scale corpus that converts 2,118 textbooks spanning the core areas of university-level mathematics subjects into approximately 380K structured proof-supervision records while preserving chapter order, proposition-proof links, dependency references, and source provenance. Leveraging these structural signals, we explore curriculum learning across multiple mathematical subjects and characterize scaling patterns with supervision volume and source breadth. At full scale, fine-tuning on TOME-Math raises the unweighted mean score across our held-out evaluations and established public benchmarks by 16.7 percentage points over the base model, while exceeding all three public instruction-data baselines evaluated in aggregate. Our findings highlight structured textbooks as both a scalable source of mathematical supervision and an empirical framework for studying the impact of data organization on mathematical reasoning. We will release the corpus to facilitate further research on structured mathematical supervision.

</details>


### [293] [Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40454)
*Adilet Metinov,Chingiz Arziev*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Glance通过给生成器加轻量决策适配器与指针头，在共享prefill上直接从缓存上下文分支出相关性探针为候选段落打分，实现单一9B骨干同时承担生成、决策与重排，每项决策技能仅增约0.1 GiB显存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG通常为重排与回答分别部署模型，导致模型驻留重复与段落处理重复（每对query-passage需单独prefill），资源开销大。

Method: 在生成器上添加轻量决策适配器（decision adapter）与指针头（pointer head）；从共享prefill的缓存上下文分支出短的���关性探针（relevance probes），每个段落产生一个分数，无需对每个query-passage对单独prefill；仅MS MARCO上微调39分钟；另设仅探针激活的适配器使生成可从原始段落缓存继续。

Result: SciFact nDCG@10 0.741、NFCorpus 0.345（bge-reranker-v2-m3为0.721/0.326）；HotpotQA 300题上，同基座生成器下所选上下文使答案F1提升0.045（配对bootstrap 95% CI [0.014,0.076]）；扩展性实验中重排质量随候选数增至200（43k tokens）持续上升，单次共享prefill下超cross-encoder 0.058 nDCG@10。

Conclusion: 初步结果证明基于生成器的重排可用单一驻留骨干完成；局限在于评测目前仅覆盖两个检索数据集、一个QA数据集与一个骨干系列。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation commonly serves separate models for reranking and answering, duplicating model residency and passage processing. We introduce Glance, which equips the generator with a lightweight decision adapter and pointer head to score candidate passages from a shared prefill. Short relevance probes branch from the cached context, producing one score per passage without separately prefilling each query-passage pair. A single resident 9B backbone supports generation, general decisions and reranking, with approximately 0.1 GiB of additional memory per decision skill. After 39 minutes of MS MARCO fine-tuning, Glance achieves nDCG@10 of 0.741 on SciFact and 0.345 on NFCorpus, compared with 0.721 and 0.326 for bge-reranker-v2-m3. On 300 HotpotQA questions, its selected context improves answer F1 by 0.045 over cross-encoder-selected context under the same base generator (paired bootstrap 95% CI [0.014, 0.076]). In a scaling study, reranking quality keeps rising up to 200 candidates (43k tokens) scored from one shared prefill, where it exceeds the cross-encoder by 0.058 nDCG@10, and a probe-only activated adapter lets generation continue from the original passage cache. These initial results demonstrate generator-based reranking with one resident backbone; evaluation currently covers two retrieval datasets, one QA dataset and one backbone family.

</details>


### [294] [rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40488)
*Art Kanke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 研究考察前沿模型作为研究智能体是否具备"品味"（在结果未知前判断实验是否值得做）。六个前沿模型针对七篇近期NLP论文提出最小可行实验（MVE）并预测其中标与排序，由独立执行器全部执行、三名模型审计员评判。结果：415个MVE中194个被评为可靠、有价值且新颖，但仅73个同时超出种子论文且非显而易见；智能体的排序优于随机选择，但未优于沿用论文中首个实验；其预测优于基准率，却不比同模型在仅给定论文时更准；团队协作成本更高而无明显质量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检验研究智能体是否具备"研究品味"——即在实验结果是未知的情况下，判断哪些实验值得优先执行的能力。现有工作多关注智能体能否生成实验或提升下游指标，但缺乏对"优先级判断质量"本身的系统评测，尤其是与简单基线（如论文中首个实验）和更强信息条件下同类模型的对照。

Method: 构建一套评测框架：选取6个前沿模型与7篇近期NLP论文；每个模型以单智能体或团队形式，针对论文提出最小可行实验（MVE），自行设定阈值并预测各MVE是否通过，同时给出排序。随后由独立的执行器执行全部MVE（含排名末位的），再由3名模型审计员对结果进行评判，并按"可靠/有价值/新颖""是否超出种子论文""是否非显而易见"等维度打分。最后将智能体的首选与随机选择、论文中首个实验、以及仅给论文和预注册信息的新实例预测基线进行对比。

Result: 共收集415个MVE。其中194个被判定为可靠、有价值且新颖，但仅73个同时满足超出种子论文且非显而易见。智能体的首选命中审计员最有价值实验的频率高于随机选择，但未能证明优于"直接选论文中第一个实验"；其通过/失败的预测优于基准率，但与仅获得论文和注册信息的同模型新实例相比，准确性无显著差异。团队模式成本更高，而提案质量无明确整体提升。

Conclusion: 研究智能体能够产出大量有价值的实验想法，但现有证据不足以表明其排序判断能有效改善"选择执行哪个实验"的决策质量。作者公开了评测框架与包含415个MVE及其预测和审计结果的完整数据集，以支持后续对研究品味问题的可复现研究。

Abstract: Do research agents have taste, the judgment of which experiments are worth running before their outcomes are known? We give six frontier models seven recent NLP papers. Each model, working as a research agent alone or as a team, proposes minimum viable experiments (MVEs), forecasts whether each will pass a threshold it sets and ranks them. A separate executor then attempts every MVE, including those ranked last, and three model auditors judge the results. Of 415 MVEs, 194 are judged sound, valuable and new, but fewer than half of these (73) are also judged beyond the seed paper and non obvious. The agents' first choices match the auditors' most valued experiment more often than a random pick, but are not shown to improve on choosing the experiment written first. Their forecasts beat a base rate but are not measurably more accurate than those of a fresh instance of the same model given only the paper and registrations. Teams cost more without a clear overall improvement in proposal quality. The agents produce many worthwhile experiments, but the evidence that their rankings improve the choice of which to run remains limited. The evaluation harness and a dataset of all 415 MVEs, with their forecasts and audited outcomes, are available at https://github.com/ArtKanke/rTaste.

</details>


### [295] [A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40511)
*Zach Paris,Emily Finn*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究使用岭降秩回归（ridge reduced-rank regression）识别LLM表征中的"大脑预测子空间"，发现仅需原嵌入维度的1-3%即可恢复完整线性编码性能，且该低维子空间区别于主成分方向，并具有跨被试泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM被广泛用作人类语言处理的计算模型，但究竟是其表征中的哪些成分驱动了与神经活动的对齐尚不清楚。

Method: 采用岭降秩回归定位LLM表征中支持神经响应线性预测的表征方向；覆盖三个自然语言聆听数据集（颅内电生理与fMRI）及六种模型条件（自回归、双向掩码、随机初始化）；并与PCA主成分方向进行对比。

Result: 仅用1-3%的嵌入维度即可恢复完整线性编码性能；低维子空间可跨留出被试泛化、跨数据集部分泛化；PCA需更多维度才能达到同等神经预测效果，表明脑预测方向不同于整体方差主方向；并据此揭示神经活动中被过度表达的可解释特征。

Conclusion: LLM与大脑的对齐由模型表征中一个小而结构化的子集支撑，为该对齐现象背后的机制提供了分析框架。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity. Here, we use ridge reduced-rank regression to identify the brain-predictive subspace of LLM representations: the representational directions that support linear prediction of neural responses. Across three naturalistic language-listening datasets spanning intracranial electrophysiology and fMRI, and six model conditions spanning autoregressive, bidirectional masked, and randomly initialized language models, we find that full linear encoding performance can be recovered using only 1-3% of the original embedding dimensionality. These low-dimensional subspaces generalize across held-out participants and, to a lesser extent, across datasets, suggesting that neural predictivity is concentrated in a compact and partially shared representational space. We next compare these brain-predictive directions with the principal axes of variation in the embeddings. Principal component analysis requires substantially more dimensions to recover neural prediction, demonstrating that the directions most useful for predicting neural activity are distinct from those capturing the most overall variance within LLM representations themselves. Finally, characterizing the learned subspaces allows us to surface interpretable features that are overrepresented in neural activity above and beyond the LLM representations. Together, these results show that LLM-brain alignment is supported by a small, structured subset of model representations and provides a framework for better understanding exactly why these representations align. Code can be found at: https://github.com/thefinnlab/low-rank-alignment

</details>


### [296] [How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40516)
*Max Neuwinger,Hanna Yukhymenko,Imanol Schlag*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出可扩展的模板化增强流水线，构建覆盖60种语言的多语言拒答与良性语料MSafeTemp，揭示仅英语评测会误判多语言安全性，并证明该数据可提升跨语言安全对齐效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM安全对齐高度集中于英语，多语言（尤其低资源语言）安全性表现差；相关开源训练数据规模有限，且未采用区域本地化的有害主题，对齐范围难以超越单一文化语境。

Method: 构建基于模板的可扩展增强流水线：从有害提示中抽取安全模板，进行翻译，再用文化上真实的实体（有害与良性两类）填充槽位，从而批量生成多语言拒答语料与良性语料；据此发布经校验的MSafeTemp语料库，覆盖60种语言。

Result: 实验显示纯英语评测会误判多语言安全性：对若干模型而言，在英语中失败的攻击经翻译后即成功；文化本地化变体还暴露出翻译本身无法覆盖的额外失效。同时，通过模板增强安全训练数据可提高对齐的多样性与质量，使英语之外的安全性能得到改善。

Conclusion: MSafeTemp及其流水线旨在促进面向代表性不足文化的更安全、更负责任模型的研究与开发。

Abstract: Safety alignment for Large Language Models is heavily focused on English with limited multilingual representation, particularly damaging low-resource language performance. Related open training datasets are often limited in size or do not follow region-localized harmful topics to broaden the scope of alignment beyond cultures. We propose a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline to produce massive multilingual refusal and benign corpora, extracting safe templates from harmful prompts, translating them and then filling in the slots with culturally authentic entities, both harmful and benign. As a result, we release MSafeTemp, a validated corpus spanning 60 languages useful for multilingual safety alignment and evaluation. Using the dataset, we show that English-only evaluation misjudges multilingual safety: for several models, attacks that fail in English succeed once translated, while culturally localized variants expose further failures that translation alone misses. We also confirm that augmenting safety training data through templates allows for higher diversity and quality of alignment, resulting in improved safety performance beyond English. MSafeTemp and the respective pipeline are aimed at facilitating research and development of safer and more responsible models for less-represented cultures.

</details>


### [297] [IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40518)
*M. Mohaiminul Islam,Muhammad Abulaish*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出IndicIPR-QA1，首个覆盖印度全部七部知识产权法案、从法条原文抽取精确答案跨度的抽取式问答基准，含4,462个QA对与1,116个法条上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 法律问答（尤其低资源法域）要求答案精确且可溯源至法条，但目前缺少覆盖印度七部IPR法案、答案严格取自法条原文的抽取式QA基准。

Method: 用GPT-4o生成问题与答案，经九项自动质量检查、单模型与多模型LLM评估以及200对人工审核进行校验；按章节划分训练/验证/测试集以避免源上下文重叠；分析答案跨度长度、词汇重叠与多子句结构；以BM25与微调InLegalBERT在统一滑动窗口推理协议下对比。

Result: BM25的token级F1为20.21，微调InLegalBERT达85.02；七部法案间性能差异明显，答案跨度长度、词汇重叠与多子句结构各法案各异。

Conclusion: BM25与InLegalBERT之间约65个F1点的差距表明单纯词面匹配不足以回答此类法律问题，需语义建模；法案间性能差异反映答案抽取难度的显著不均衡。

Abstract: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law. However, to the best of current knowledge, no existing extractive QA benchmark provides exact answer spans from statutory texts across all seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights (IPR) Acts. This paper presents IndicIPR-QA1, an extractive QA benchmark for Indian IPR laws. The proposed dataset contains 4,462 QA pairs from 1,116 statutory contexts across seven Acts. Questions and answers are generated using GPT-4o and validated through nine automatic quality checks, single and multi-model LLM evaluations, and a 200-pair human audit. Section-level partitioning prevents source-context overlap across the training, validation, and test sets. Further analysis examines answer span length, lexical overlap, and multi-clause structure across the corpus and individual Acts. BM25 achieves a token-level F1 score of 20.21, while fine-tuned InLegalBERT reaches 85.02 under a unified sliding-window inference protocol. The large performance gap between BM25 (20.21 F1) and InLegalBERT (85.02 F1) shows that simple word matching is not enough to answer these legal questions. Performance also varies across the seven Acts, indicating substantial differences in answer-extraction performance.

</details>


### [298] [Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40533)
*Pedro Carvalho Brom*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文无需数据中心，在单块消费级GPU上从零训练含分词器的语言模型，并给出面向专业领域任务的质量评估方案。发布Python包与两个葡语notebook、预注册对比协议及11–12M参数模型的参考数值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自建领域专用语言模型不再依赖大型算力设施，但缺少可复现的训练流程与"模型是否胜任专业任务"的判定方法，因此需要一套轻量、可测、预注册的评测基线。

Method: 在同一网络上实现自回归与掩码扩散两种生成方式；仅用文本构建法律任务，配Kneser-Ney n-gram下界与公开基准；采用预注册的对比协议，在巴西散文与联邦法律文本上以每轮数分钟的预算训练并测量，记录仅靠测量才暴露的缺陷。

Result: 自回归模式在64轮达峰后开始记忆语料，掩码扩散可持续提升至256轮；测试最优点上扩散似然界比自回归优0.06 bits/byte，处于预注册最小效应内。在留出法律与训练后颁布的法案上，似然与6-gram下界持平，续写劣于下界；篡改文本检测优于下界；仅在与训练分布不符的"法令"体裁中，交叉引用填空优于下界及160M、630M公开模型（后者接近或低于随机），且仅在组内等权时成立，逐项持平630M模型。公开模型（算力为其5×10²–10⁵倍）在篡改检测与续写上领先。

Conclusion: 小规模从零训练的领域模型在部分任务（篡改检测、特定体裁填空）具竞争力，但续写与整体似然仍受n-gram下界和大模型压制；盲人评议为预注册项，不属本版本内容。

Abstract: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method. It releases a tested Python package and two notebooks in Brazilian Portuguese with autoregressive and masked diffusion generation on one network, a preregistered comparison protocol, legal tasks built from text alone with a Kneser-Ney floor and public yardsticks, reference numbers for models of 11 to 12M parameters, and a catalogue of defects that only measurement revealed. On Brazilian prose and federal laws, at minutes per run, the autoregressive mode peaks at 64 epochs over the same text and then memorises it, while masked diffusion improves up to 256. At their best points on test, the diffusion bound exceeds the autoregressive likelihood by 0.06 bits per byte, within the preregistered minimum effect. On held-out laws and on acts published after training, the model ties a 6-gram floor in likelihood on the same windows, and it loses to the floor at continuing those acts. It beats the floor at detecting tampered text, and fills cross-references more often than the floor and public models of 160M and 630M parameters, only in decrees, a genre absent from training, where those scorers stay near or below chance, and in filling the blank only when each group weighs the same, since per item it ties the 630M model. On laws, the public models, trained with about 5x10^2 to 10^5 times its compute, lead in tampered text and continuation. The blind human reading is preregistered and not part of this version.

</details>


### [299] [Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40574)
*Yifu Luo,Chuang Ma,Zeyu Chen,Enkelejda Kasneci,Qi Chen,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出首个 token 级自适应 On-policy Self-distillation 方法 MTA-OPSD，为每个 token 从多教师池中选择最偏好的教师进行监督，在 Qwen3 数学推理任务上平均较基座模型提升最高 +5.9。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 OPSD 方法的教师要么在整个训练过程中固定（始终接触完整参考），要么仅在 response 之间自适应调整部分参考暴露程度。作者认为二者均不足：教师偏好可在同一 response 内逐 token 变化，因此每个 token 需要自己的教师。

Method: 通过 teacher-intervention 先导实验验证教师偏好逐 token 不同，并发现可通过多数投票与 KL 选择为每个 token 识别偏好教师；据此构建由候选教师组成的 multi-teacher pool，使每个 token 在训练中自适应选择其偏好教师，形成 token 级自适应 OPSD。

Result: 在 Qwen3 模型上的数学推理任务实验中，MTA-OPSD 一致优于现有 OPSD 方法，相对基座模型平均增益最高达 +5.9。

Conclusion: 在 token 级自适应调整教师监督是有效且必要的，MTA-OPSD 作为首个 token 级自适应 OPSD 方法验证了这一思路，代码已开源。

Abstract: On-policy Self-distillation (OPSD) has proven effective for post-training large language models by constructing a teacher conditioned on privileged references. However, existing approaches keep the teacher fixed either throughout training by consistently exposing it to the full reference, or within each response by adaptively varying partial reference exposure only across responses. In this paper, we argue that neither of them is sufficient. Instead, every token needs its own teacher, as the teacher preference can vary token by token within the same response. Through a teacher-intervention pilot study, we validate that the teacher preference differs across tokens, and reveal that a preferred teacher can be identified for each token through majority voting and KL-based selection. Motivated by these findings, we propose Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation (MTA-OPSD), the first token-level adaptive OPSD method. Our method constructs a multi-teacher pool consisting of candidate teachers, and enables every token to adaptively select its preferred teacher during training. Experiments with Qwen3 models on mathematical reasoning tasks show that MTA-OPSD consistently outperforms existing OPSD approaches with an average gain of up to $+5.9$ over the base model, highlighting the importance of adapting teacher supervision at the token level. The code is available at https://github.com/xingzhejun/MTA-OPSD.

</details>


### [300] [PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40576)
*Zhihao Yang,Boyuan Zheng,Puhui Tan,Yukun Chen,Kuan Zhang,Longze Chen,Jiaming Li,Renke Shan,Lu Wang,Xianpei Han*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出PIVOT方法：将教师生成的纠正片段插入学生轨迹，并对这些片段施加token级KL监督，与RLVR联合训练，解决稀疏奖励下无学习信号的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RLVR依赖结果级稀疏奖励，在困难推理任务上当一个group内所有rollout均失败时无法提供学习信号；引入更强教师信号时，需解决如何将信号融入RLVR、既保证产生可获奖励的成功轨迹又对学生可学习的问题。

Method: 区分两种互补机制：轨迹级干预（提升获得带奖励轨迹的可及性）与token级监督（提供密集学习目标）。控制实验显示单独使用任一机制均不充分，故提出PIVOT：在学生rollout中插入教师生成的纠正片段，并对这些片段施加token级KL监督，同时保留RLVR目标；并系统分析干预位置与监督方式以形成有效配方。

Result: 在困难逻辑游戏与数学推理基准上PIVOT一致优于现有方法，逻辑游戏平均avg@8从最佳基线19.5%提升至35.6%，接近翻倍。

Conclusion: 轨迹级干预与token级监督相辅相成，二者结合并对干预位置与监督方式进行设计，可有效缓解RLVR稀疏奖励问题，显著提升学生模型在困难推理任务上的表现。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal. Stronger teachers can provide additional guidance, but this raises a central question: how can such signals be incorporated into RLVR to support successful rollouts while remaining learnable for the student? We distinguish two complementary mechanisms: trajectory-level intervention, which improves access to reward-bearing trajectories, and token-level supervision, which provides dense targets to guide student learning. Our controlled experiments show that either mechanism alone can remain insufficient, motivating their combination. We therefore introduce PIVOT, which inserts teacher-generated corrections into student rollouts and applies token-level KL supervision to these segments alongside the RLVR objective. Beyond their combination, we systematically analyze where to intervene and how to supervise, yielding a recipe for effective guidance. Across hard logic games and mathematical reasoning benchmarks, PIVOT consistently outperforms existing methods, nearly doubling mean avg@8 on logic games from 19.5% for the best-performing baseline to 35.6%.

</details>


### [301] [Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40577)
*Zelin Zhao,Tianchi Ma,Junyuan Shang,Shuohuan Wang,Dianhai Yu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 Multi-View MoE：用多个独立初始化的路由器聚合 sigmoid 分数改进专家选择，并复用路由偏好调制专家计算，在固定活跃专家预算下提升 MoE 模型效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一路由器的排序与专家实际效用评估之间一致性弱（中层与深层尤甚）；而用更丰富信号做选择或计算会带来额外开销（需预计算或重复专家前向）。

Method: Multi-Router 子模块聚合多个独立初始化路由器的 sigmoid 分数，训练中形成差异化专家偏好，使被单个路由器强烈偏好或被多个路由器共同支持的专家得以入选；再利用各被选专家跨路由器的相对分数，将学习到的潜在视图混合进其输入，实现路由偏好在选择与计算上的复用。每个被选专家仅执行一次前向。

Result: 24 层 10B-A1B 模型、708B token 训练下，完整方法在九任务下游均值上较基线提升 1.18 个百分点；仅 Multi-Router 提升 0.6 个百分点，并使路由分数与专家效用评估的秩相关全局相对提升 8.1%、单路由器对齐最差层约 58%。

Conclusion: 多路由器多视图机制在保持活跃专家数、专家 FLOPs 与 all-to-all 通信量不变的前提下，提升专家选择质量与下游性能；受控混合干预显示模型利用了同时依赖专家与 token 的输入差异。

Abstract: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget. Dense evaluation of all experts reveals weak agreement between single-router rankings and expert-utility evaluation rankings, especially in middle and deep layers. Richer signals for selection and computation incur additional cost: selection based on internal expert activations requires preliminary computation, while processing multiple full representations separately through the same expert repeats its computation. We propose Multi-View MoE to improve expert selection with multiple routers and reuse their preferences to modulate expert computation under a fixed expert budget. Its Multi-Router submodule aggregates sigmoid scores from independently initialized routers. These routers develop highly differentiated expert preferences during training, allowing experts strongly favored by one router or jointly supported by several routers to be selected. Multi-View further uses each selected expert's relative scores across routers to mix learned latent views into its input, reusing routing preferences for both selection and computation. Each selected expert executes one forward pass, preserving the active-expert count, expert FLOPs, and all-to-all communication volume. On a 24-layer 10B-A1B model trained on 708B tokens, full Multi-View MoE improves the nine-task downstream mean by 1.18 percentage points over the baseline. Multi-Router alone yields a 0.6-percentage-point gain and improves the rank correlation between router scores and evaluated expert utility, with relative increases of 8.1% globally and approximately 58% in the layer with the lowest single-router alignment. Controlled mixing interventions show the model uses input differences that depend on both the expert and the token.

</details>


### [302] [When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40611)
*A. J. A. Jubayer Talukder,Mohammad Ariful Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在28,058个决策点上联合评估主动式助手的“门控+生成”两阶段系统，揭示门控的价值在于精度与算力节省、记忆画像决定提示质量，并提出单个1B解码器同时门控与生成的统一方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主动式助手系统将“何时干预”的门控与“提示什么”的生成器分离为两个模型；缺乏对二者联合评估，且不清楚各组件（门控、检索、记忆画像、生成器规模）分别贡献多少，存在优化空间未明的问题。

Method: 在28,058个决策点上端到端评估门控+生成流水线；用oracle门控给出阶段式生成上限作对照；做算力节省分析（8B vs 1B生成器）、记忆画像消融、检索与大生成器消融；提出单模型方案——一个1B解码器从中间层门控、同一前向过程生成；并用1,144条人类评分（32段对话）验证。

Result: 真实门控下端到端精确匹配0.2619（上限0.2971），端到端精度0.2387，仍有明显提升空间；算力节省从8B的4.39x降至1B的1.38x；移除记忆画像损失24.7个精确匹配点（重标定BERTScore 0.57→0.35），检索与更大生成器对精确匹配无增益；单模型匹配或超过双模型流水线，墙钟时间少1.31–1.76x，三个种子下深层出口与独立门控持平；人类评估支持记忆效应，单模型与1B流水线持平、低于8B；分级指标与LlamaPIE原生评判比精确匹配更贴近人类评分。

Conclusion: 门控主要通过精度与算力节省获利，且其收益随生成器变小而收窄；记忆画像是提示质量的主要驱动因素，检索与模型规模并非关键；单解码器可同时完成门控与生成并达到同等或更优效果、更低延迟，是更实用的架构；精确匹配应视为严格下界，宜采用分级指标与原生评判作为更贴近人类的评估。

Abstract: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points. Stage-wise generation scores are oracle-gate ceilings: behind a real gate, end-to-end exact match is 0.2619 against a ceiling of 0.2971, and end-to-end precision is 0.2387, leaving substantial headroom. A gate pays off through precision and compute, whose saving falls from 4.39x with an 8B generator to 1.38x with a 1B one. The memory profile drives hint quality: removing it costs 24.7 exact-match points (rescaled BERTScore 0.57 to 0.35), while retrieval and a larger generator add nothing on exact match. One 1B decoder can do both, gating from an intermediate layer and generating in the same pass. At its final checkpoint it matches or exceeds the two-model pipelines on automatic end-to-end measures with 1.31-1.76x less wall-clock time than the matched 1B pipeline; across three seeds, its deeper exit ties the separate gate. A human evaluation (1,144 ratings over 32 dialogues) supports the memory effect and rates the single model level with the matched 1B pipeline and below the 8B one. Graded metrics and LlamaPIE's native judge track human ratings more closely than exact match, which we report as a strict lower bound.

</details>


### [303] [Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40619)
*Chengyang He,Wenlong Zhang,Koduvayur Subbalakshmi,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出STRATA基准（8,735条疫苗不良事件临床时间线假设，含金标准计划、证据集、p值和结论）与ART分阶段范式，对语言模型数据分析的全过程逐步评分，揭示主要失败点在于"选哪些记录算数"，即结论-证据缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络与语言模型充斥着关于事件随时间共现的"发现式"断言，但每个都是需在正确记录上做显著性检验才能裁定的时间性假设。验证者必须指定零假设、选择检验方法、确定相关记录，任一步出错都可能"结论正确而过程错误"。然而现有语言模型数据分析基准只评结论，且直接给出相关数据，掩盖了过程性错误，在医疗等高风险场景代价高昂。

Method: 构建STRATA基准：基于疫苗不良事件报告的临床时间线，生成8,735条时间性假设，并由公开代码本推导、确定性oracle复现金标准验证计划、证据集、p值与结论。提出ART（articulate, retrieve, test）三阶段范式，将每个决策暴露为可检查的输出：先显式表述假设与零假设，再检索相关记录，最后执行检验。

Result: 五种模型配置的实验表明，系统主要在"判断哪些记录应计入证据"这一环节失败，形成仅凭准确率无法察觉的结论-证据缺口。ART弥补了大部分缺口，并使31B开源模型在同一范式下与前沿模型差距缩小到0.01以内；前沿模型在给定代码本后即可成功。

Conclusion: 仅评结论的数据分析评测会系统性掩盖过程错误，需对验证全流程逐步评分；将决策外显化的分阶段范式能显著提升可检验性与性能，代码本等规范信息对前沿模型尤为关键。

Abstract: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it. Assertions about how events unfold across many cases fill the Web, and each is a temporal hypothesis that only a significance test over the right records can settle. The verifier must specify the null, select the test and decide which records bear on the hypothesis, and any of these choices can go wrong while the conclusion still comes out right. Yet benchmarks for language-model data analysis grade only the conclusion, with the relevant data handed over. We study the problem in health, where a wrong verdict is costly, and present STRATA, a benchmark that grades every decision on the way to a verdict: 8,735 hypotheses over the clinical timelines of vaccine adverse-event reports, with gold plans, evidence sets, p-values and verdicts derived under a released codebook and reproduced by a deterministic oracle. We also propose ART (articulate, retrieve, test), a staged paradigm that exposes each decision as an inspectable output. Extensive experiments with five model configurations show that systems fail mostly at choosing which records count, a verdict-evidence gap that accuracy alone conceals. ART closes most of this gap and brings a 31B open model to within 0.01 of the frontier models under the same paradigm; the frontier models succeed once given the codebook.

</details>


### [304] [ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40627)
*Qiyao Ma,Xiaodong Liu,Weiwei Yang,Mingqian Feng,Chengquan Guo,Jialin Song,Carolyn Buractaon,Zhe Zhao,Junshan Zhang,Sandeep Atluri,Christopher White,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Assess→Decide→Respond框架：让模型先评估意图、提交显式可解析的安全决策token，再基于该决策生成回复，并用强化学习在第payload轮训练该决策；利用对齐"浅层性"作为干预点，实现强多轮安全防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐存在"脆弱性"，行为集中在最初几个输出token上，多轮对话中恶意意图被分散后仍常绕过防御；现有防御继承该弱点，仅监督回复表层形式，未给模型显式的安全决策来学习。

Method: 把"浅层性"视为高杠杆干预位置先占据它。框架为三段式：评估用户意图→提交显式、可解析的安全决策→以该决策为条件生成回复。决策token跨度用强化学习在payload轮训练，奖励为规则式自验证奖励（对标签与对话已知性质做校验，无需judge与标注），并支持LLM-as-judge的渐进决策空间奖励（含安全重定向）。

Result: 在两个模型族、十四个覆盖安全/效用/有用性的基准上对照实验取得最强多轮安全性，并在保持安全领先的同时维持效用，仅以适度有用性代价换取。逐token KL分析与干预实验确认效果集中于设定回复轨迹的短暂"审议"片段，且该决策token是因果控制点。

Conclusion: 攻击者所利用的"浅层性"恰恰成为防御机制：把安全决策显式化并前置到轨迹决定性的token跨度上，可将其转化为因果控制点，从而显著提升多轮安全性并保持效用。

Abstract: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often. This brittleness has a mechanistic root: Alignment is shallow, with safety behavior concentrated in a model's first few output tokens, and existing defenses inherit the weakness, supervising the surface form of the response without ever giving the model an explicit safety decision to learn. We take the opposite view of shallowness: if a short span determines the trajectory of an entire response, that span is the highest-leverage place to intervene, and the defender can occupy it first. We propose Assess $\to$ Decide $\to$ Respond, a framework in which the defender assesses the user's intent, commits to an explicit, parseable safety decision, and only then generates a reply conditioned on it, with the commitment trained by reinforcement learning at the payload turn. Because the decision is a token span, the reward can be a rule: a self-verified reward checks the committed label against the conversation's known nature, requiring no judge and no annotation, while the same format also supports an LLM-as-judge reward over a graded decision space with safe redirection. Across two model families and fourteen benchmarks spanning safety, utility, and helpfulness, our defenders achieve the strongest multi-turn safety in a controlled comparison, maintaining their lead in safety while preserving utility at a modest cost to helpfulness. A per-token KL analysis and interventional probes confirm why this works: training concentrates its effect on the brief deliberation that sets a response's trajectory, and the decision committed there is a causal control point. The very shallowness attackers exploit becomes the mechanism of defense.

</details>


### [305] [Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40655)
*Steven Yu,Sheng-Yu Wang,Kimia Hamidieh,Antonio Torralba,David Bau*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出可控归因基准CATT（用虚构知识微调LLM以获得无歧义真值），系统操纵单一数据配置诊断归因失败原因；发现因果证据高度局部化且被文档平均稀释，改用负对数几率梯度并仅聚合top token分数，使真值召回提升35–72个百分点，并在FTRACE-TREX上最多提升4.9倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LM数据归因评测同时变动多个数据集属性，无法定位归因算法失败的具体原因；因此需要一个可单因素控制变量的评测框架来诊断失败来源。

Method: 构建Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT)：在完全虚构的知识上微调LLM，得到无歧义的真值，从而逐一改变数据配置（如文档冗余度、词汇干扰项）。在可配置评测下考察两个此前关注不足的设计选择：(1) 计算梯度所用的损失函数；(2) 逐token归因分数聚合为文档分数的方式。

Result: 冗余与干扰项一致性地降低归因性能；训练文档中的真实因果证据高度局部化，而标准的全文档平均会将其稀释为噪声；将交叉熵梯度替换为负对数几率梯度可凸显关键token，仅聚合top token分数即可在多个基线上使真值召回提升35–72个百分点；该修正可迁移至FTRACE-TREX，对每种方法的反事实重训练性能最多提升4.9倍。

Conclusion: 归因失败主要源于评测不可控与聚合/损失设计的失配；可控合成基准为单因素诊断提供可行路径，负对数几率梯度加top-token聚合是一种即插即用、跨基准泛化的改进方案。

Abstract: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [306] [Moment-Guided Optimizers for Noisy Deep Learning: MGO-SC as a Simple Consistency Gate for Adam-Style Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37712)
*Alicem Koyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MGO-SC优化器：用符号EMA的幅值构造坐标级"符号一致性门"，并给出保均值变体，在CIFAR-10/ResNet-18的对称与非对称标签噪声下稳定优于AdamW。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自适应优化器在强随机性与标签噪声下梯度符号与幅值不稳定，行为退化，现有方法多需二阶信息或逐样本过滤，代价较高。

Method: 对Adam类方法做轻量改造：由符号指数滑动平均的幅值导出逐坐标一致性门，符号稳定坐标被信任、符号抖动坐标被降权；指出朴素门控只能收缩更新、损失有效步长，故提出保均值变体，在各坐标间重新分配信任而不改变每张量净步长幅值；不引入二阶信息与逐样本过滤。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、ResNet-18、匹配学习率与解耦权重衰减下，保均值MGO-SC在干净、对称与非对称标签噪声中一致优于AdamW基线（如40%对称噪声下+1.4个百分点），配对bootstrap 95%置信区间不含零，Wilcoxon检验p<0.01；报告了匹配种子效应量、非参数置信区间与配对显著性检验，并开源代码与原始日志。

Conclusion: 朴素一致性门控因收缩更新而失效，需采用保均值重分配；MGO-SC以极低开销在噪声鲁棒性上带来统计显著、稳定的增益，但证据限于单一数据集与骨干网络。

Abstract: Adaptive optimizers are widely used in deep learning, yet their behavior can degrade under heavy stochasticity and label noise where the sign and magnitude of gradients can be unstable. We study MGO-SC (Moment-Guided Optimizer with Sign-Consistency), a lightweight modification of Adam-style methods that derives a coordinate-wise consistency gate from the magnitude of a sign exponential moving average (EMA): coordinates whose gradient sign is stable are trusted, while coordinates whose sign fluctuates are down-weighted. We show that the naive form of this gate, which can only shrink updates, loses effective step size and underperforms when the learning rate is matched to the baseline. We therefore introduce a mean-preserving variant that reallocates trust across coordinates without changing the net per-tensor step magnitude. On CIFAR-10 with ResNet-18, under a matched learning rate and decoupled weight decay, mean-preserving MGO-SC consistently improves over its AdamW baseline across clean, symmetric, and asymmetric label noise (e.g., +1.4 points at 40% symmetric noise; paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding zero; Wilcoxon p<0.01), while adding no second-order information or per-sample filtering. We report matched-seed effect sizes, nonparametric bootstrap confidence intervals, and paired significance tests, and we release code and raw logs.

</details>


### [307] [What a Weight Update Buys: Leverage Across Training Stages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37719)
*Shikhar Shiromani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"杠杆率"(leverage)：用更新方向的Fisher二次型除以同尺寸随机方向的Fisher二次型，作为衡量"单位权重变化换取行为改变"的精确指标。在Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2等系列checkpoint上，该指标跨四个数量级排序出预训练(≈随机水平)、SFT(约5倍)、RL-Zero/RLVR(400–1500)、DPO(400–23000)的层级；并据此发现预训练累积的是"噪声式"权重漂移、bf16无fp32主副本训练会冻结大量坐标并降低杠杆率，同时导出了DARE随机drop-and-rescale损伤的重用律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练仅移动约千分之一权重范数却剧烈改变行为，预训练移动约三分之一范数却只带来缓慢漂移，说明单纯权重位移量无法刻画更新的"有效性"。作者希望建立一个精确、可复现的度量，量化单位权重变化所"买到"的行为改变，并借此诊断不同训练阶段、数值精度与数据复用策略的本质差异。

Method: 定义leverage为更新的Fisher二次型 F(Δ) 与同checkpoint上同尺寸随机方向的Fisher二次型之比；每个方向用一次前向模式(forward-mode)自动微分求得该二次型。在已发布的开源模型(Olmo-3、Tülu-3、Zephyr、OLMo-2)的预训练窗口、SFT、RL-Zero、RLVR、DPO各阶段checkpoint上系统测量；对比fp32主权重与纯bf16训练；分析更新幅度与对角Fisher的对齐性；推导并实验验证DARE在保留率p下的损伤律；并用两组对照实验(受控SFT/DPO轨迹、按已发布配方复现DPO阶段)检验读数的可靠性。

Result: Leverage在四类checkpoint上跨四个数量级：预训练窗口在散文数据上处于随机水平；SFT约为随机方向的5倍；RL-Zero与RLVR为400–1500；DPO为400–23000。预训练方面，30k至1M步的窗口在散文上并不比同尺寸随机方向更具影响力，与SGD的噪声二次模型预测一致，即预训练把更新累积成噪声。精度方面，无fp32主副本的bf16训练冻结36–99%的坐标，杠杆率最多降低约7倍，并产生fp32训练不具备的"更新幅度—对角Fisher"对齐。复用方面，符号翻转零假设预测DARE在保留率p下的相对损伤为 (1-p)/(p·ρ_sign)，在DARE有效的范围内与实测相差不超过2倍。对照方面：所有带fp32主权重的受控SFT与DPO轨迹在移动过程中杠杆率均下降；两次按已发布配方从锚点重跑DPO，位移落在发布值的1%以内、杠杆率落在4%以内，而朴素配方读数低5–6倍；逐一留一消融将杠杆水平归因于长度归一化损失与batch size 128的共同作用。

Conclusion: 权重位移的幅度与行为改变之间并非线性对应，leverage给出了一个廉价、精确、跨阶段可比的"单位权重变化价值"标尺。它揭示了预训练噪声式累积、bf16训练导致坐标冻结与杠杆损失、以及数据复用损伤的可预测规律，并可复现性地还原已发布后训练流程的关键特性，为诊断与设计后训练配方提供了定量工具。

Abstract: Post-training moves a language model's weights by about a thousandth of their norm and changes its behavior sharply; pretraining moves them by a third and buys a slow drift. We introduce leverage, an exact measure of what a unit of weight change buys: the Fisher quadratic form of an update, computed with one forward-mode pass per direction, divided by the same form for random directions of the same size at the same checkpoint. Leverage orders released Olmo-3, Tülu-3, Zephyr, and OLMo-2 checkpoints over four orders of magnitude: pretraining windows sit at the random level on prose, SFT five times above it, RL-Zero and RLVR at 400-1,500, and DPO at 400-23,000. With this instrument we find that pretraining accumulates into noise: windows of 30k to 1M steps are no more consequential on prose than random directions of their size, as a noisy quadratic model of SGD predicts. We find that training precision changes what an update looks like: training bf16 parameters without an fp32 master copy freezes 36-99% of coordinates, lowers leverage up to sevenfold, and creates an alignment between update magnitudes and the diagonal Fisher that fp32 training does not show. We derive and verify a law for reuse: the sign-flip null predicts the relative damage of random drop-and-rescale (DARE) at keep rate $p$ as $(1-p)/(p\,ρ_{\mathrm{sign}})$, within a factor of two of measurement wherever DARE succeeds. Two controls make these readings reliable: every controlled SFT and DPO trajectory with fp32 master weights loses leverage as it moves, and two re-runs of a released DPO stage from its anchor with its published recipe land within 1% of the released displacement and 4% of its leverage, where a plain recipe reads five to six times lower; leaving one component out traces the level to the length-normalized loss and its batch size of 128 together.

</details>


### [308] [Threshold Compatibility and Support-Selection Diagnostics in Neural Discovery of Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37726)
*Zeen Song*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在神经PDE发现的稀疏支持选择中，"精确回归"不等于"正确方程"：中位数/样本标准差阈值存在精确的双信号保留边界与全向量扰动界，扩散项可因阈值兼容性而系统性丢失且难以通过重拟合或验证恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动回归精度充足时，稀疏支持选择仍可能给出错误的方程结构；作者想以有限诊断手段精确刻画"支持选择失败"的机制来源（阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤、评分拒绝），而非提出新的发现算法。

Method: 针对中位数/样本标准差阈值的神经PDE发现流程，推导两项理论结果：精确的双信号保留边界与完整向量的扰动界；并以数值实验作诊断，包括扩散-平流精确库、四十个已保存稀疏状态的真支持重拟合、固定顺序阈值岭回归对照（60个理想对照）、条件验证、事后能量池化，以及四个未使用解析轨迹上的240次物理残差比较。

Result: 精确的平流-扩散库虽将系数恢复到数值精度却仍丢失扩散项；真支持重拟合可降低扩散误差但不恢复全部导数精度；固定顺序阈值岭回归在60个理想对照中完全恢复支持，但在所有学习状态中选出多余项；全折正确支持候选被条件验证拒绝，事后能量池化则在全部60个状态中保留其更低的极小损失；在240次物理残差比较中，给定支持估计全部优于未修正的选中方程；系数、观测点与权重固定时，精确替换学习库与目标会使学习行排序在59/60状态中反转；对两种损失同时加权在任一预算下均未满足规定的Burgers扩散收益判据。

Conclusion: 这些有限诊断区分了阈值不兼容、重拟合损伤和分数拒绝三类失败模式；但既不能确立自动修正，也不支撑一般性恢复或预测稳定性。

Abstract: Accurate regression need not yield the correct equation after support selection. For a median/sample-standard-deviation threshold in neural PDE discovery, we derive an exact two-signal retention boundary and a complete-vector perturbation bound. Exact advection-diffusion libraries lose diffusion despite coefficient recovery to numerical precision. True-support refits of forty saved sparse states reduce diffusion error without restoring all derivative accuracy. A fixed sequential threshold ridge comparator recovers exact support in sixty ideal controls but selects extra terms in every learned state. All-fold correct-support candidates are rejected by conditional validation; post hoc energy pooling preserves their higher minimum loss in all sixty states. Supplied-support estimates outperform unchanged selected equations in all 240 physical-residual comparisons on four unused analytic trajectories. With coefficients, observation points and weights fixed, exact replacement of the learned library and target reverses their learned-row ordering in 59/60 states. Weighting both losses also fails the specified Burgers diffusion-benefit criterion at every tested budget. These finite diagnostics distinguish threshold incompatibility, refit damage and score rejection; they establish neither automatic correction nor general recovery or predictive stability.

</details>


### [309] [Predicate Neuron: Differentiable Quantization of Predicate Relations in Gradient-based Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37727)
*Ioannis Konstantoulas,Iliana Loi,Kyriakos Sgarbas*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Native Predicate Neuron（谓词神经元），一种可微分的一阶逻辑量化神经元模块，通过单一可训练参数学习操作切换，兼具硬逻辑执行与可微反向传播，可原生嵌入FC/CNN/RNN/Transformer架构，提升收敛速度、精度并降低损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统符号推理方法依赖静态架构，难以与深度神经网络及梯度优化融合；标准深度架构在处理不连续性与单调关系推理时存在困难，亟需一种可原生集成、可微分的逻辑推理神经元。

Method: 设计Native Predicate Neuron：通过一阶逻辑量化以单一可训练参数学习在逻辑操作间交替；采用"双重性质"梯度机制——训练中执行硬逻辑操作同时保持可微性以支持反向传播；对输入与选择状态均进行量化，从而逼近连续与非连续函数。

Result: 在MNIST、Wikitext等基准上，跨全连接、卷积、循环与Transformer架构评估，加入谓词神经元整体上加速收敛、提升准确率、降低损失，在需要单调推理或处理不连续性的任务上提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: 谓词神经元可原生集成到标准神经网络中实现模糊逻辑运算，并已在Keras与PyTorch中开源提供。

Abstract: In machine learning, symbolic reasoning approaches often rely on static architectures that hinder integration into deep neural networks and gradient-based optimization. To address this, we introduce the Native Predicate Neuron, a differentiable logic-reasoning neural module that enriches standard architectures with symbolic reasoning capabilities via first-order logic quantization. The proposed neuron models relational logic by learning to alternate between operations using a single trainable parameter. It features a tailored gradient mechanism with a dual-nature formulation: executing hard logical operations during training while maintaining differentiability for backpropagation. By quantizing both its input and choice state, the Predicate Neuron approximates continuous and non-continuous functions, effectively resolving discontinuities that standard deep learning architectures struggle with. We evaluate the Predicate Neuron across Fully-Connected, Convolutional, Recurrent, and Transformer architectures on benchmarks like MNIST and Wikitext. Results show that incorporating Predicate Neurons accelerates convergence, boosts accuracy, and lowers loss in general, with particularly strong improvements in tasks requiring monotonic reasoning or handling discontinuities. Overall, the Predicate Neuron natively integrates into standard neural networks to enable fuzzy logic operations and is available in Keras and PyTorch.

</details>


### [310] [Selective Transfer Learning for Groundwater Level Anomaly Forecasting: Accuracy-Risk Trade-offs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37733)
*Yaxuan Wu,Ali Mohammed Mansoor Alsahag,Seyed Sahand Mohammadi Ziabari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究荷兰多井地下水异常预测中的上下文感知选择性迁移学习（CASL）：以约束式上下文混合冻结的无迁移与固定迁移父模型，在457口井上较无迁移降低RMSE 0.424–1.084%，但全局凸混合与CASL互有胜负，体现精度—风险权衡而非上下文优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 源域预训练虽能提升平均精度，但在异质井上并非一致可靠——固定迁移会在相当比例的井上造成性能退化（18.38–51.86%的井受损）。因此需要一种能在井级别选择性、上下文感知地平衡迁移收益与风险的方法。

Method: 提出CASL：在冻结的“无迁移”与“固定迁移”两个父模型之上，用校准集训练受限的上下文混合权重（contextual blending）。对照基线为Global Convex Blend——同一对父模型但每个种子仅拟合一个全局凸混合权重。任务设定：9个连续实测月度输入、精确3个日历月目标、无插值；评估覆盖457口井、13,718个测试窗口、5个预定义种子；源池固定为maxsim0.60四格池，仅依据Always-TL验证RMSE冻结。

Result: CASL相对No TL的RMSE低0.424–1.084%；在固定迁移受损井中部分挽回97.53–99.50%，完全挽回23.46–43.78%。但全局凸混合在4个种子上保护更多井，CASL在4个种子上池化RMSE略低；且部分挽回可由凸混合结构本身产生，不能证明上下文优越性。

Conclusion: 两种方法互不占优，结果支持固定划分上的“精度—风险权衡”，而非滚动部署有效性；CASL的平均精度提升伴随井级风险控制的不确定性，需在真实滚动场景中进一步验证。

Abstract: This work studies context-aware selective transfer learning for multi-well groundwater anomaly forecasting in the Netherlands. Source-domain pretraining can raise average accuracy but is not uniformly reliable: it degrades performance on a substantial fraction of heterogeneous wells. Context-Aware Selective Learning (CASL) uses calibration-trained, constrained contextual blending of frozen no-transfer and fixed-transfer parents. Global Convex Blend uses the same parents with one calibration-fitted weight per seed. The corrected task requires nine consecutive observed monthly inputs and an exact three-calendar-month target, without interpolation. Evaluation covers 457 wells and 13,718 test windows under five predefined seeds, with the four-cell maxsim0.60 source pool frozen using Always-TL validation RMSE alone. Fixed transfer harms 18.38-51.86% of wells. CASL has 0.424-1.084% lower RMSE than No TL, partially rescuing 97.53-99.50% and fully rescuing 23.46-43.78% of fixed-harmed wells. Partial rescue can arise structurally from convex blending and does not establish contextual superiority. Global Convex Blend protects more wells in four seeds, while CASL has slightly lower pooled RMSE in four. Neither dominates: the results support an accuracy-risk trade-off on the fixed split, not rolling deployment validity.

</details>


### [311] [Anisotropic Trust Region Warping for Prior-Data Fitted Networks in Bayesian Optimisation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37737)
*Samuel Younger,Tinkle Chugh,George De Ath*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出各向异性信赖域(ATR)扭曲方法，通过核目标对齐估计逐维长度尺度并对输入空间做仿射重缩放，在不重训PFN的前提下修正其与重拟合GP在长度尺度上的先验错配，保持O(d·N²)推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PFN用一次前向传播替代GP代理模型在贝叶斯优化中的超参数重拟合，但其先验在元训练时固定。当目标函数长度尺度超出元训练先验众数时，PFN的预测对数似然与重拟合GP的差距随长度尺度增大而扩大，并传导至优化性能。

Method: ATR扭曲：用核目标对齐(kernel target alignment)逐维估计长度尺度；对输入空间施加仿射重缩放，将目标映射到PFN期望的长度尺度；以锚点为中心的信赖域决定保留哪些观测；PFN的推理成本O(d·N²)不变，无需重新训练网络。

Result: 实验表明PFN预测对数似然随长度尺度超出先验众数而落后于重拟合GP，且该缺陷影响优化表现；在Matérn-3/2核生成函数上，ATR扭曲在长度尺度范围两端均提升PFN的优化性能。

Conclusion: 先验固定导致的长度尺度失配是PFN的核心短板，ATR扭曲以低成本、免重训的方式有效缓解该问题，并在极短与极长长度尺度情形下均带来收益。

Abstract: Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) replace the hyperparameter refitting of Gaussian Process (GP) surrogates in Bayesian optimisation with a single forward pass, at the cost of a prior that is fixed at meta-training time. We show empirically that a PFN's predictive log-likelihood falls increasingly behind that of a refitted GP as the objective function's lengthscale grows beyond the mode of the PFN's meta-training prior, and that this deficit carries over to optimisation performance. To correct the mismatch without retraining the network, we introduce Anisotropic Trust Region (ATR) warping. Per-dimension lengthscales are estimated by kernel target alignment, and an affine rescaling of the input space maps the objective onto the lengthscale the PFN expects, with a trust region around the anchor determining which observations are retained, leaving the PFN's $\mathcal{O}(d \cdot N^2)$ inference cost unchanged. On functions drawn from a Matérn-3/2 kernel, ATR warping improves optimisation performance of the PFN at both extremes of the lengthscale range. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/Trust-Region-Warping-For-PFNs.

</details>


### [312] [Spokes, not a Ring: Revisiting the Weekday Manifold in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37796)
*Diksha Gupta,Rieke Fruengel,Stefan Heimersheim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文检验"连续流形假设"，发现星期流形实为七个离散状态组成的环，而非连续圆环。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作假设大语言模型可将部分概念表示为多维流形而非单一方向，且用这些流形解释或操控表示时，常默认沿流形移动对应概念的连续变化。作者要检验这一连续流形假设是否成立。

Method: 以典型的"星期"流形为对象：一是测量局部敏感度分布，考察其与星期节点是否对齐；二是在流形上进行on-manifold steering（沿流形操控表示），观察表示与行为之间的映射形态；三是检验流形中间空间是否承载其他概念（如一天中的时间、不确定性、自然文本）。

Result: 局部敏感度出现七个极小值，且与七个星期对齐，说明表示—行为映射呈阶梯状而非平滑连续；中间空间不被时间、不确定性或自然文本占据，即除七个离散状态外无其他概念沿该流形被表示。

Conclusion: 尽管星期流形几何上呈显著圆形，其表示更接近环状排列的七个离散状态而非连续圆环，故连续流形解释不成立；并呼吁对其他表示流形检验其移动是否对应有意义的表示与行为变化。

Abstract: Recent work has hypothesised that large language models may represent some concepts as multi-dimensional manifolds instead of single directions. Using these manifolds to interpret or steer representations often assumes that moving along them corresponds to a continuous change in the represented concept. In this work, we test this continuous manifold assumption on the prototypical weekday manifold. Despite its striking circular geometry, we find that the weekday representations behave more like seven discrete states arranged in a circle than a continuous ring. First, we show that local sensitivity has seven minima aligned with the weekdays, producing a step-like mapping between representation and behaviour under on-manifold steering. Second, we test whether any concepts are represented along the manifold outside the seven discrete states, and find neither time of day, uncertainty, nor natural text populate the intermediate space. Together, these results challenge the continuous interpretation of the weekday manifold and motivate testing whether movement along other representation manifolds correspond to meaningful changes in model representations and behaviour.

</details>


### [313] [Responsible Quantum Machine Learning for Medical Imaging: A Fairness Audit Across Sensitive Subgroups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37819)
*Giovanni dos Santos Franco,Felipe Mahlow,Ellison Fernando Cardoso,José Adenaldo Santos Bittencourt,Felipe Fanchini*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对医学影像分类中的经典与量子分类器进行子群体公平性审计，假设QML并非天然公平，并在两种数据集上比较基线及三种缓解策略，发现公平性效应依赖模型与数据集，量子模型需经验性子群体评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QML在医学分类中日益受关注，但其在子群体感知公平性准则下的行为研究不足；且普遍存在"量子模型天然公平"的隐含假设，缺乏实证检验。

Method: 基于ResNet-18嵌入，在DDI（敏感属性：Fitzpatrick皮肤类型）与CheXpert衍生胸片数据（敏感属性：年龄组）上训练SVM、MLP、QSVM、QCNN；设置基线及三种缓解策略（可微Equalized Odds正则、梯度反转学习GRL、二者组合），以PanDerm、EVA-X为基础模型外部参照；并对每种缓解设置预设非劣效性边际，检验相对基线的整体判别性能。

Result: 量子分类器可获得有竞争力的整体性能但仍存在子群体差异；部分子群体AUC差距最小的配置（如DDI上QCNN+GRL）因整体判别力下降而不具临床可接受性；DDI上QSVM+GRL+EO在性能/公平权衡上最佳并接近PanDerm；CheXpert上QCNN+GRL整体性能最高但差异增大，EVA-X仍更强。

Conclusion: 公平性效应具有模型与数据集依赖性，QML需经验性子群体感知评估；较小AUC差距可能源于最优组性能下降而非最差组提升，故需引入非劣效性判据；所有量子模型均为经典模拟，不主张量子优势。

Abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) is increasingly explored for medical classification, yet its behaviour under subgroup-aware fairness criteria remains understudied. We present an empirical fairness audit of classical and quantum classifiers for medical imaging, assuming QML is not inherently fair. Two scenarios are evaluated: dermatological lesions on DDI (sensitive attribute: Fitzpatrick skin type) and chest X-rays on CheXpert-derived data (sensitive attribute: age group). Using ResNet-18 embeddings, we train SVM, MLP, QSVM and QCNN under a baseline and three mitigation settings: differentiable Equalized Odds (EO) regularisation, Gradient Reversal Learning (GRL), and both combined. Foundation models (PanDerm, EVA-X) serve as external references. Quantum classifiers may achieve competitive aggregate performance while still exhibiting subgroup disparities. Since a smaller subgroup AUC gap may stem from degrading the best group rather than improving the worst, each mitigation is also tested against a pre-specified non-inferiority margin relative to its baseline. Under this criterion, several configurations with the smallest disparity, notably QCNN with GRL on DDI, are not clinically acceptable due to loss of global discrimination. On DDI, QSVM with GRL+EO performed best and approached PanDerm in the performance/fairness trade-off; on CheXpert, QCNN with GRL achieved the highest aggregate performance but increased disparity, and EVA-X remained stronger. Fairness effects are model- and dataset-dependent, so QML requires empirical subgroup-aware evaluation. All quantum models run in classical simulation; we claim no quantum advantage.

</details>


### [314] [Learning Without Clocks: Partition-Invariant Neural Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37823)
*Han Wang,Jingyuan Bao,Juntao Wu,Saiao Zhou,Yuman Nie*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 事件相机、脉冲耳蜗等传感器输出异步事件，现有学习系统多将其分帧/打包，导致输出依赖切分方式。作者提出"时间中介非交换"(TM)模型：事件更新两两可交换且在相邻事件间解析演化，从而对切分、同时事件顺序和时间戳连续扰动均鲁棒，同时保留对时序次序的敏感性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流学习系统先把异步事件流分帧或打包，输出因而依赖流的切分（分辨率）；而从理论上刻画"事件驱动、闭式演化"网络究竟还需何种额外性质才能实现切分不变、同时事件顺序无关、时间戳连续且仍对时序敏感，此前缺乏系统分析。

Method: 对任意非线性事件模型证明：(i)同时事件顺序无关、(ii)对时间戳连续，各自等价于事件更新的两两可交换；一旦可交换，全部顺序依赖源自其与事件间动力学的非交换，并随时滞线性消失。由此定义TM模型类，给出分辨率鲁棒性界；构造最小TM层——Hassenstein-Reichardt相关器的可学习、可证Lipschitz推广；证明单个加性层无法一致表示有序成对交互而三维TM状态可以；每层TM带来两级时间嵌套，并给出高阶构造TM-k与保持三性质的堆叠规则。实例化为Clock-Free Event(CFE)层，事件数线性复杂度，并给出点过程的无拓扑变体与预注册时钟鲁棒性协议。

Result: 初步开发集实验：TM状态在DVS128 Gesture上较同构加性状态高3.5–9.1分，在SHD和Speech Commands上分别高24.5和30.6分。

Conclusion: 事件更新可交换性是切分不变与时间戳连续的统一充要条件；TM模型以时间中介的非交换性同时获得鲁棒性与时序敏感性，CFE层线性复杂度可实现并显著优于加性基线。

Abstract: Event cameras, spiking cochleas and similar sensors emit asynchronous events, yet most learning systems first bin them into frames or packets, so the output depends on how the stream was sliced. Networks whose state is updated exactly at every event and evolves in closed form between events are invariant to this slicing. We ask what more makes the output (i) independent of the processing order of simultaneous events and (ii) continuous in the time stamps, even when two events cross in time, while (iii) staying sensitive to temporal order. For arbitrary nonlinear event models we prove that (i) and (ii) are each equivalent to pairwise commutation of the event updates, and that once updates commute, all order dependence comes from their non-commutation with the inter-event dynamics and vanishes linearly in the time lag. This identifies a class of time-mediated non-commutative (TM) models and yields a resolution-robustness bound for any model. We construct the minimal TM layer, a learnable, provably Lipschitz generalization of the Hassenstein-Reichardt correlator; prove that no single additive layer can uniformly represent ordered pair interactions, whereas a three-dimensional TM state can; show that each TM layer adds two levels of temporal nesting versus one for additive layers; and give a single-layer higher-order construction (TM-k) and a stacking rule preserving all three properties. We instantiate these results as the Clock-Free Event (CFE) layer, linear in the number of events, give a topology-free variant for temporal point processes with closed-form likelihoods, and specify a preregistered clock-robustness protocol with a physical-time threat model for spike-retiming attacks. In preliminary development-set experiments, the TM state beats an otherwise identical additive state by 3.5-9.1 points on DVS128 Gesture and by 24.5 and 30.6 points on SHD and Speech Commands.

</details>


### [315] [Learning Lotteries with Minimal Stakeholder Violations from Membership Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37828)
*Nicholas Teh,Paul W. Goldberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究将m个候选系统版本混合成彩票分配给n个代理（利益相关方），每个代理在未知半空间内接受彩票。目标是最小化拒绝代理的数量，给出计算复杂性、精确算法、抽样近似的LP方法与下界结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI开发者通常有多个候选系统版本并可将其混合部署（如A/B测试）以随机版本响应请求。每个利益相关方（安全团队、监管者、拥有私有测试数据的客户）仅在其期望性能满足自身未知标准时才接受混合方案，而开发者只能通过二值成员查询获知是否可接受。此前Choo等（ICML 2026）求解所有代理均接受的彩票，但在安全与有用性要求冲突时未必存在，因此需改为最小化被拒绝代理数量。

Method: 将问题建模为对m个备选项、n个代理选择彩票（概率分布），每个代理在未知半空间中接受，并回答二值成员查询。首先证明即使在所有半空间已知且效用为0/1时问题仍是APX-hard；随后设计精确算法：m为常数时多项式时间，在常数η下存在与阈值相距η以上的最优彩票时为准多项式时间。对只能查询部分代理的情形，采用对代理均匀抽样以优化全体，并给出与n无关的样本量、加性与相对保证，以及任意m下的多项式时间线性规划方法；同时分析仅查询K个不同代理的确定性算法下界。

Result: 问题在一般情形下APX-hard；m为常数时存在多项式时间精确算法，满足η间隔条件时存在准多项式时间算法；均匀抽样优化给出与n无关样本量下的加性与相对保证，线性规划给出任意m的多项式时间方法；对于m≥3，仅查询K个不同代理的确定性算法无法保证少于n−K个额外拒绝，且该界可达，即对未查询代理无法提供任何保证。小规模合成实验表明最坏情况界在随机实例上偏保守。

Conclusion: 在利益相关方接受标准未知且仅可通过二值查询获知的设定下，最小化拒绝代理数的彩票选择问题在一般情况下计算困难（APX-hard），但在m较小或有间隔假设时存在精确算法；抽样与线性规划提供可扩展的近似方案，而仅查询有限代理则存在本质性下界。实验结果提示理论上最坏情况界较为保守，实际随机实例中表现更好。

Abstract: An AI developer often has several candidate versions of a system and can deploy a mixture of them, sending each request to a randomly chosen version, as in A/B testing.
