### [521] [Search-Guided Reasoning Trace Curation for Verilog Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37706)
*Matthew DeLorenzo,Kevin Tieu,Prithwish Jana,Piyush Jha,Dileep Kalathil,Vijay Ganesh,Jeyavijayan Rajendran*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MCTS-SFT：用蒙特卡洛树搜索构建Verilog生成的结构化推理轨迹，提升SFT数据质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM生成Verilog的训练流程多蒸馏自然语言推理轨迹，中间设计决策结构松散，且仅依据最终RTL正确性进行筛选，监督信号与中间决策脱节。

Method: 提出verifier-guided框架MCTS-SFT，将轨迹构建形式化为中间推理状态上的搜索，用MCTS把完整Verilog rollout的功能反馈回传至早期设计决策；其中Plan-MCTS在紧凑硬件设计计划（接口、时序、状态、行为、更新规则）空间上搜索，并研究plan-preserving supervision（保留搜索得到结构状态作为SFT目标）。

Result: Plan-MCTS功能轨迹产出率最高（84.2%正确轨迹，对比一次性结构化规划81.9%、无引导树搜索82.0%）；相同轨迹与Verilog输出下，保留显式计划使pass@10从52.56%升至57.7%；6000条轨迹研究中，相较全响应CoT蒸馏pass@10最高提升3.7点，生成长度减少约50%（VerilogEval-v2）。

Conclusion: 结构化硬件规划、验证器引导搜索与显式中间状态监督是互补机制，可构建更有效且token高效的Verilog生成训练数据。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have improved Verilog generation. However, most training pipelines distill natural-language reasoning traces whose intermediate design decisions are weakly structured and are primarily selected according to the correctness of the final generated RTL. We present MCTS-SFT, a verifier-guided framework for curating reasoning traces for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of Verilog generation models. MCTS-SFT formulates trace construction as search over intermediate reasoning states and uses Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to propagate functional feedback from complete Verilog rollouts to earlier design decisions. Within this framework, we introduce Plan-MCTS, which searches over compact hardware-design plans that explicitly represent interfaces, timing, state, behavior, and update rules. We further study plan-preserving supervision, in which the searched structured state is retained as part of the downstream SFT target. Our experiments find that Plan-MCTS achieves the highest functional trace yield, with 84.2% correct traces compared with 81.9% for one-shot structured planning and 82.0% for unguided tree exploration. For identical Plan-MCTS trajectories and Verilog outputs, retaining the explicit searched plan during SFT raises pass@10 from 52.56% to 57.7%, demonstrating that the representation of intermediate design decisions materially affects downstream learning. In a separate 6,000-trace study, MCTS-curated supervision improves pass@10 over full-response chain-of-thought distillation by up to 3.7 points while reducing downstream generation length by approximately 50% on VerilogEval-v2. These results demonstrate that structured hardware planning, verifier-guided search, and explicit intermediate-state supervision provide complementary mechanisms for constructing more effective and token-efficient training data for Verilog generation.

</details>


### [522] [zkDuel: Characterizing SumCheck Prover Kernels across GPU Programming Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37710)
*Samarth Narang,Alhad Daftardar,Brandon Reagen*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: zkDuel基准对比Triton与CUDA实现zkPHIRE SumCheck：CUDA相对Triton的中位加速比随域宽从32位3.5x降至256位1.4x；用tl.reduce替换原始块归约后Triton内核时间差距缩至8%以内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SumCheck是零知识证明中的核心证明者原语，其表并行结构天然适合GPU；但随着有限域位宽增大，算术密集度上升，而现有工作缺乏对"用Triton而非CUDA编程SumCheck"成本的系统量化研究。

Method: 构建zkDuel基准：对25个zkPHIRE衍生约束提供Triton与CUDA的匹配实现，并加入诊断多项式，覆盖32/64/128/256位素域；采用独立CPU参考验证与跨后端校验和门控；在NVIDIA H100与A100上运行共800组配置并进行性能剖析，进一步用tl.reduce替换原始块归约、引入专用点插值优化。

Result: H100上800组配置中758组校验和一致完成；CUDA相对Triton中位优势由32位3.5x降至256位1.4x，且Triton在19个大表配置上更快；A100上差距由4.4x降至1.6x。剖析显示小域差距主要来自主机启动开销与Triton原始块归约中的冗余模加，而多位Montgomery运算增长会稀释其相对成本。替换归约后两卡上Triton内核中位时间均在CUDA的8%以内，专用点插值使256位求值内核提升1.55–1.75x。

Conclusion: 在密码学常用域宽下，Python嵌入式DSL（Triton）可接近CUDA性能，二者差距随算术强度上升而收敛；但最大规模全展开约束仍暴露编译器可扩展性瓶颈。

Abstract: SumCheck is a central prover primitive in zero-knowledge proofs, exposing table-parallel work that maps naturally to GPUs but becomes increasingly arithmetic-intensive as finite fields widen. We study how this shift affects the cost of programming SumCheck in Triton rather than CUDA. Our benchmark, zkDuel, provides matched implementations of 25 zkPHIRE-derived constraints alongside diagnostic polynomials, covering 32-, 64-, 128-, and 256-bit prime fields, with independent CPU-reference validation and cross-backend checksum gating. Of 800 configurations attempted on an NVIDIA H100, 758 complete with matching checksums. CUDA's median advantage over Triton falls from 3.5x at 32 bits to 1.4x at 256 bits, and Triton is faster on 19 large-table configurations; the same convergence appears on an A100, where the gap falls from 4.4x to 1.6x. Profiling shows that the small-field gap largely reflects host launch overhead and redundant modular additions in Triton's original block reduction, whose relative costs diminish as multi-limb Montgomery work grows. Replacing that reduction with tl.reduce brings Triton's median kernel time within 8% of CUDA on both GPUs, while specialized point interpolation improves 256-bit evaluation kernels by 1.55-1.75x. At cryptographic widths, these results show that a Python-embedded DSL can approach CUDA performance, although the largest fully unrolled constraints still expose compiler-scalability limits.

</details>


### [523] [The Code Behind the Layout: AI Agents for Analog Layout Generators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38426)
*Minxing Chu,Anhang Li,Martins Atilla,Ruichen Qi,Mehdi Saligane*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 在SKY130上对gLayout的受控实验表明：直接用LLM绘制版图的主要障碍是时间与token成本，而基于生成器框架的主要优势是可复用性；模型在"从设计意图所属族的生成器源码入手、并在最可能失败的族成员上验证每次编辑"的路线上最有效，族测试结果还可作为监督信号蒸馏到本地模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟版图仍以手工为主、自动化困难。gLayout等生成器框架把版图表达为程序（参数化、DRC感知的生成器），但编写生成器仍需专家投入。前沿LLM已能从设计意图直接绘制版图几何，由此引出两个实际问题：(1) 若模型能自行绘制版图，生成器框架还剩什么价值；(2) 让模型在生成器框架上工作是否优于从零绘制版图。

Method: 在SKY130工艺上对gLayout开展受控实验，对比"LLM直接绘制版图"与"LLM基于生成器框架编写/修改生成器代码"两种范式，分析二者的时间成本、token成本与有效性；进而考察"从设计意图所属族的生成器源码出发"以及"在最可能失败的族成员上测试每次编辑"这一策略，并将族级测试结果作为监督信号用于训练本地模型。

Result: 直接绘制版图的主要瓶颈是时间与token开销；生成器框架的核心价值在于可复用性——经过验证的原语使每次模型编辑足够小、易于校验，参数化使一次编辑可在整个族版图上被评估。基于生成器源码、并在高风险族成员上验证编辑的策略最有效：一次经验证的修改即可改进该生成器产出的所有版图。族测试结果作为监督可让本地模型学到跨族泛化的编辑，显著降低推理成本。

Conclusion: 生成器框架并非被LLM取代，而是与之互补：LLM应作为生成器代码的开发者，在其可复用、可校验的原语与参数化族上工作，而非从零绘制版图；配合族级验证与测试结果蒸馏，可在保证可复用改进的同时大幅降低推理成本。

Abstract: Analog layout remains largely manual and hard to automate. Generator frameworks such as gLayout express layouts as programs, producing layouts from parameterized, design-rule-aware generators; however, writing such generators still takes expert effort. Large language models (LLMs) could now write generator code, and frontier models can even draw layout geometry from design intent. This raises a practical question: if a model can draw the layout itself, what does a generator framework still contribute, and is applying these models to a generator framework better than having them draw a layout from scratch? Through controlled experiments on gLayout in SKY130, we find that the main obstacle to drawing a layout directly is its time and token cost, and that the main advantage of a model building on a generator framework is reusability. Its verified primitives keep each model edit small enough to check, and its parameters allow a single edit to be evaluated across an entire family of layouts. Accordingly, a model is most effective when it develops the layout from the generator source of the family that the design intent belongs to, and tests each edit on the family members most likely to fail, so that one verified change improves every layout the generator produces. The results of these family tests can then serve as supervision for a local model, which learns edits that hold across the family at a fraction of the inference cost.

</details>


### [524] [GI-RTL-Fuzz: Grammar-Informed RTL Generation with LLMs for End-to-End Differential Simulator Fuzzing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38489)
*Ziyue Zheng,Zhi Qu,Yangdi Lyu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: GI-RTL-Fuzz 是一个语法引导的模糊测试框架，利用 LLM 并结合 BNF 文法覆盖信息生成高质量 RTL 测试用例，通过差分测试对主流 Verilog 仿真器进行缺陷挖掘。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RTL 仿真器是现代 IC 设计流程的基础工具，但作为复杂软件常存在严重缺陷，会破坏仿真准确性，因此需要系统化地对仿真器进行压力测试。

Method: 以 BNF 文法覆盖信息作为引导信号，指导 LLM 生成能够探索复杂及少被测试的语言特性的 RTL 测试用例；再对不同 RTL 仿真器开展差分测试以识别不一致行为。

Result: 在主流 Verilog 仿真器的 lint 检查过程与仿真结果中，发现了大量此前未知的不一致（缺陷）。

Conclusion: 将文法覆盖反馈与 LLM 生成能力相结合，可有效提升 RTL 测试用例的针对性，差分测试是发现仿真器缺陷的有效手段。

Abstract: Register-Transfer Level (RTL) simulators are fundamental to modern IC design workflows, yet like any complex software, they frequently contain critical bugs that compromise simulation accuracy. To systematically stress-test these tools, we introduce GI-RTL-Fuzz, a grammar-informed fuzzing framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate high-quality RTL test cases. Our key innovation is guiding the LLM's generation process using Backus-Naur Form (BNF) grammar coverage information, enabling the exploration of complex and rarely-tested language features. By performing differential testing against different RTL simulators, our framework uncovered a significant number of previously unknown inconsistencies in both the linting process and simulation results of major Verilog simulators.

</details>


### [525] [Exploring and optimizing the Vivado Flow on large FPGA designs: A Practical Analysis of Strategies and Their Impact on Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38575)
*Kachkachi Nor Eddine*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文比较Vivado多种时序指令与实现策略，在两个测试设计上评估其在时序、面积与运行时间上的表现，以找出最高效的时序收敛流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FPGA设计中的时序收敛对高性能应用至关重要，Vivado虽提供多种优化策略，但为具体项目挑选最佳配置仍具挑战性，缺乏针对性的比较性指导。

Method: 系统梳理Vivado的时序指令（directives）与实现策略，并以两个测试用例——NQR谱仪SoC-FPGA与用于高能物理粒子探测器的数字读出ASIC原型——为平台，对不同的策略与配置进行横向比较。

Result: 在两个测试设计中对比了各策略与配置在时序（timing）、面积（area）和运行时间（runtime）三项指标上的差异，识别出不同配置的效果差异。

Conclusion: 通过实验比较可确定针对给定设计更高效的Vivado实现流程，为在时序、面积与运行时间之间取舍的策略选择提供实践参考。

Abstract: Achieving timing closure in FPGA designs is crucial, especially for high-performance applications. The Vivado Design Suite offers several strategies for optimization, but finding the best configuration for a given project remains challenging. This paper explores the various Vivado's timing directives and strategies to improve performance across timing, area, and runtime. Through two test-case designs, an NQR spectrometer SoC-FPGA and a digital readout ASIC prototype for high energy physics particle detector's, different strategies and configurations are compared to identify the most efficient flow.

</details>


### [526] [IMPACT: Constraint-Aware Search for Imperfectly Factorized Accelerator Mappings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39040)
*Konstantinos Stavrakakis,Ilgaz Er,Theofilos Spyrou,Dimitrios Stavrakakis,Stephan Wong,Georgi Gaydadjiev,Said Hamdioui*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: IMPACT：用遗传算法+约束感知修复算子在整个映射空间中搜索DNN加速器高效映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 张量运算到硬件的映射（切分、排序、并行化）构成组合爆炸的搜索空间；多数映射违反硬件约束，剩余多数又低效。现有方法要么只搜索子空间（排除最优解），要么全空间随机采样（大量不可行解），难以自动获得高效映射。

Method: 将遗传算法与约束感知的修复算子（constraint-aware repair operator）结合：对每个不可行映射不丢弃，而是修复为可行映射，从而在完整空间内高效搜索。

Result: 在灵活加速器上，EDP、时延、能耗在全部DeepBench负载上均优于SOTA mapper；在约束严格、可行映射稀少的CIM加速器上，相比最强基线在五个网络上EDP降低66%、时延降低47%、能耗降低18%，并与手工专家映射相当。

Conclusion: IMPACT在灵活与强约束两类加速器上都能自动找到高效映射，并将开源发布。

Abstract: The efficiency of Deep Neural Network (DNN) accelerators depends on how each tensor operation is mapped onto the hardware. A mapping specifies how the computation is tiled across the memory hierarchy, ordered, and parallelized across the processing elements. These choices form a combinatorially large search space, where efficient mappings are hard to find. Most violate hardware constraints, and most remaining mappings underutilize the hardware. Existing mappers either search only part of this space to keep the search tractable, excluding the most efficient mappings, or sample the full space randomly, so most mappings they evaluate are infeasible. We present IMPACT, a mapper that searches the full space. IMPACT pairs a genetic algorithm with a constraint-aware repair operator that converts each infeasible mapping into a feasible one instead of discarding it. On a flexible accelerator, IMPACT outperforms state-of-the-art mappers in EDP, latency, and energy on every DeepBench workload. On a compute-in-memory (CIM) accelerator, whose constraints leave few mappings feasible, it reduces EDP by 66%, latency by 47%, and energy by 18% over the strongest prior mapper across five networks, and rivals hand-crafted expert mappings. Across flexible and highly constrained accelerators, IMPACT finds efficient mappings automatically. IMPACT will be released as open source.

</details>


### [527] [Energy-Efficient FPGA Implementation of an End-to-End Cosine-Domain CNN Using High-Level Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39268)
*Sana Fatima,Ab Al-Hadi Ab Rahman,Ibrahim Yousef Alshareef,Farhad Khodadadi,Nuzhat Khan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 本文提出端到端余弦域CNN（CD-CNN）架构，在高层次综合（HLS）下于FPGA实现，以实值DCT域特征提取替代复值频谱运算，显著提升边缘AI推理的能效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CNN计算开销大，难以部署于低功耗设备以满足高速边缘AI需求；已有全频谱傅里叶域CNN（FD-CNN）依赖复值运算与层间逆变换，资源与能耗开销高。

Method: 构建端到端CD-CNN，中间特征提取采用实值DCT域表示，避免复值算术及频谱层间的中间逆变换；基于HLS在Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA上实现，并在相同网络与实现约束下与全频谱FD-CNN对比。

Result: 在MNIST与94类ASCII数据集上，CD-CNN降低了归一化资源占用并提升推理吞吐；能效分别达112.91 frames/J（MNIST）与101.27 frames/J（ASCII），较全频谱FD-CNN提升1.51×与2.76×；相较此前基于GPU的全频谱CD-CNN实现，能效提升12.96×。

Conclusion: 实值DCT域频谱处理在降低资源开销与提升能效方面具有优势，适用于能效敏感的边缘AI部署。

Abstract: The computational cost of conventional Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) limits their deployment in low-power devices for high-speed edge AI applications. This paper presents an end-to-end cosine-domain CNN (CD-CNN) architecture for energy-efficient FPGA inference using high-level synthesis (HLS). The proposed architecture performs intermediate feature extraction using real-valued DCT-domain representations, avoiding complex-valued arithmetic and intermediate inverse transforms between spectral layers. The design is implemented on a Xilinx Kintex UltraScale+ XCKU5P FPGA and evaluated against a fully spectral Fourier-domain CNN (FD-CNN) under consistent network and implementation constraints. Experiments on the MNIST and 94-class ASCII datasets show that the CD-CNN reduces normalized resource utilization and improves inference throughput on both datasets. Its energy efficiency reaches 112.91 frames/J for MNIST and 101.27 frames/J for ASCII, corresponding to improvements of $1.51\times$ and $2.76\times$, respectively, over the fully spectral FD-CNN architecture. Furthermore, compared to the previous GPU-based fully spectral CD-CNN implementation, the proposed end-to-end FPGA implementation improves energy efficiency by $12.96\times$. These results demonstrate the potential of real-valued spectral processing in the DCT domain for energy-efficient edge AI deployment.

</details>


### [528] [Learning to Formulate: Agentic Hardware-Software Co-Design of AI Infrastructure through Progressive Optimization and Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39380)
*Yi Ding,Li Shang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出 Formulaic 流程：由语言模型智能体撰写数学化的"模板"形式化，交给求解器优化，并由验证与实测检验假设与结果，从而打破AI基础设施软硬件分层边界实现软硬件联合设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI基础设施（芯片与软件）按层设计：分层使系统可控，却预先固化优化器可考虑的选项，需芯片与软件协同改动才能获得的收益在优化开始前即被排除在形式化之外。语言模型智能体虽可重访这些边界，但其提议本身无法证明设计的正确性或最优性。

Method: Formulaic 采用分工式流程：智能体负责写形式化，数学求解器在形式化内优化，验证与测量检查假设与结果。智能体从计算图逐步向芯片细化问题，每一步是一个"模板"——带正确性条件的程序族；并采用墙式松弛（wall relaxation）通过为约束软件的硬件上限定价来搜索芯片设计空间。

Result: 在 NVIDIA GB10 上，智能体撰写的模板运行完整 Qwen3-8B 层比 SGLang 快 1.075×；在模拟 Ventus GPU 研究中，联合设计将 Qwen2.5-0.5B 最差场景周期降至参考的 0.428（纯软件方案为 0.934）；在五步 GEMM 细化链上，复用证明使校验加速 2.51×。

Conclusion: 该工作以若干独立研究而非单一端到端流程的形式迈出第一步，表明"智能体写形式化+求解器优化+验证测量"的分工可在保持正确性可检验的同时，实现跨层软硬件联合优化并获显著收益。

Abstract: AI infrastructure, the chips and software that train and serve AI models, is designed in layers. Layers make the system manageable, but they also fix which choices an optimizer can consider. Gains that need the chip and its software to change together are excluded before optimization begins: the formulation leaves them out. Language-model agents make it possible to revisit these boundaries, but an agent's proposal cannot show by itself that a design is correct or optimal. We present Formulaic, a flow that divides the work. The agent writes the formulation, a mathematical solver optimizes within it, and verification and measurement check its assumptions and results. The agent refines the problem step by step, from the computation graph toward the chip. Each step is a template: a family of programs with the conditions under which they are correct. Wall relaxation searches the chip by pricing the hardware limits that bind the software. This paper takes a first step, through separate studies rather than one end-to-end run. On NVIDIA GB10, templates the agent wrote run complete Qwen3-8B layers $1.075\times$ faster than SGLang. In a simulated Ventus GPU study, joint design cuts the worst-scenario cycles of Qwen2.5-0.5B to 0.428 of the reference, against 0.934 for software alone. On a five-step GEMM refinement chain, reusing proofs makes checking $2.51\times$ faster.

</details>


### [529] [OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39395)
*Vishal Saxena,Soumyajit Mandal*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出OPERA：由通用LLM智能体在开源工具链下完成CMOS运放从指标到后仿签核的全流程设计，在SKY130中成功设计共源共栅偏置与六种运放，全部版图DRC/LVS通过且15个PVT角均达标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟电路从规格到签核版图极少能无人工迭代地自动完成；现有LLM智能体仅通过优化器循环确定器件尺寸，且止步于原理图，未闭环到版图与后仿。

Method: OPERA采用"专家教学"范式：先由设计者向智能体传授gm/ID方法（将指标映射为跨导与最小电流、按器件角色从特性化查找表选gm/ID、由方程定尺寸，仅留少量可搜索旋钮，保持设计可解释）；再让智能体学习gLayout框架与版图实践经验，编写可复用的版图生成器，在设计师设定的检查闸口处闭环版图与寄生提取。

Result: 在SKY130中设计共享恒gm偏置及六种运放（5T、折叠共源共栅、套筒式OTA；Miller、折叠共源共栅、套筒式两级），目标为fun≥50 MHz、PM≥60°、1 pF负载下SR 25 V/μs、DC增益30–60 dB。六个版图均DRC干净、LVS匹配，提取网表在全部15个PVT角满足指标（fun≥53.7 MHz、PM≥62.1°、SR≥27.9 V/μs）。基准网表已开源。

Conclusion: 专家教学式LLM智能体可将模拟设计流程延伸至后仿签核，兼具可解释性与可复用性，并发布AMPICBench基准以支撑后续研究。

Abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. In SKY130, the agent designed a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps (5T, folded-cascode and telescopic OTAs; Miller, folded-cascode and telescopic two-stage) for fun >= 50 MHz, PM >= 60 degrees, SR 25 V/μs into 1 pF and a minimum dc gain of 30 to 60 dB. All six layouts are DRC-clean and LVS-matched, and their extracted netlists meet every target at all 15 PVT corners ( fun >= 53.7 MHz, PM >= 62.1 degrees, SR >= 27.9 V/μs). The benchmark netlists are released at https://github.com/AMPICLab/AMPICBench.

</details>


### [530] [Energy-Efficient Memristor Accelerator for Depression Detection with a CNN-LSTM Hybrid Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39420)
*Jiaqi Liu,Yun Yu,Fenglin Xi,Shenjian Zhang,Shenghao Liao,Wenze Zheng,Mingxuan Hu,Yangbin Chen,Xinhong Chen,Chun Zhao*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种统一的ReRAM存内计算加速器，将CNN-LSTM-attention-MLP各阶段集成于交叉阵列框架中，用于抑郁症音频筛查，相比CPU/GPU分别实现32.1倍与9.3倍时延降低、约160倍与140倍能耗降低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 抑郁症早期筛查需要高效分析音频与语音数据，而传统CPU与GPU平台执行CNN-LSTM推理时存在高时延与高能耗问题，因此需要专用加速方案。

Method: 设计统一ReRAM存内计算（PIM）加速器，在基于交叉阵列的框架内集成卷积、循环、注意力与MLP阶段，减少空间与时间分支间的中间数据搬移；CNN采用im2col向量化映射，LSTM门计算通过拼接输入-状态向量重构并映射至ReRAM交叉阵列；同时给出模块级负载分解、参数敏感性分析及与代表性ReRAM/PIM加速器的同负载对比。

Result: 相比CPU与GPU基线，时延分别降低32.1倍与9.3倍，能耗分别降低约160倍与140倍；通过简化权重扰动测试，在未训练流水线与合成类频谱输入下刻画了ASLF敏感性；任务级预测精度与鲁棒性尚待评估。

Conclusion: 该统一ReRAM PIM架构在CNN-LSTM-attention负载上显著优于CPU/GPU的效率表现，验证了存内计算用于抑郁症音频筛查的潜力，但端到端精度与鲁棒性仍需后续验证。

Abstract: Early screening of depression requires efficient analysis of audio and speech data, while conventional CPU and GPU platforms incur high latency and energy consumption for CNN-LSTM inference. To address this challenge, we propose a unified resistive RAM (ReRAM) processing-in-memory accelerator for a CNN-LSTM attention workload. The architecture integrates convolutional, recurrent, attention, and multi-layer perceptron (MLP) stages within a crossbar-based framework, reducing intermediate data movement between spatial and temporal branches. CNN operations are mapped through im2col-based vectorization, while LSTM gate computations are reformulated using concatenated input-state vectors and mapped onto ReRAM crossbars. We further provide module-level workload breakdown, parameter sensitivity analysis, and matched-workload context against representative ReRAM/PIM accelerators. Experimental results show 32.1 times and 9.3 times latency reduction over CPU and GPU baselines, respectively, with about 160 times and 140 times energy reduction. Simplified weight-perturbation tests characterize ASLF sensitivity in an untrained pipeline with synthetic spectrogram-shaped inputs. Task-level prediction accuracy and robustness remain to be evaluated.

</details>


### [531] [APPlace: Co-Optimizing Device Locations and Access Points for Routing-Aware Analog Placement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39515)
*Bingyang Liu,Xiaohan Gao,Souradip Poddar,David Z. Pan*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: APPlace 是一个布线感知的模拟版图全局布局框架，将器件位置与接入点（AP）选择在全局布局阶段联合优化，并配合保持该结构的合法化阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟/混合信号版图中寄生与失配严重影响电路性能，布局阶段尤为关键。现有解析布局方法以中心点线长代理优化器件坐标，把接入点选择留给布线；但模拟电路中布线引脚是延伸的终端金属而非固定点，最优AP取决于相邻器件位置，因此仅优化坐标会针对路由器实际不会使用的连接点进行优化。

Method: 在全局布局中同时优化器件位置与AP选择（布线感知、AP协同优化），随后进行合法化阶段以保留全局布局建立的结构，形成完整的APPlace流程。

Result: 在四个真实模拟基准上，APPlace 在可比版图面积下取得优于代表性基线的整体后布局性能；消融实验显示，去除AP协同优化会使OTA类基准的CMRR最多下降13 dB，并使比较器延迟增加23%。

Conclusion: 将AP选择前移至全局布局与器件位置联合优化，可显著改善模拟电路的后布局性能，验证了布线感知布局表述的必要性。

Abstract: Analog layout automation remains challenging in Analog/Mixed-Signal circuit design, because parasitics and mismatches introduced during layout strongly affect circuit performance. Placement is especially critical among the layout stages, as it constrains the routing solution space and the achievable post-layout performance. Existing analytical placement methods optimize device coordinates under center-based wirelength proxies and leave access point (AP) selection to routing. In analog circuits, however, a routing pin is an extended piece of terminal metal rather than a fixed point, and the best AP on it depends on where the other connected devices are placed, so a coordinate-only placement optimizes for connection points that the router will not use. We present APPlace, a routing-aware analog placement framework that co-optimizes device locations and AP selections during global placement, followed by a legalization stage that preserves the structure established by global placement. Experimental results on four real-world analog benchmarks show that APPlace achieves better overall post-layout performance than representative baselines at comparable layout area. Ablation studies further show that removing AP co-optimization causes up to a 13 dB CMRR loss among the OTA benchmarks and a 23% increase in comparator delay.

</details>


### [532] [LLM Agent-Based Design of RISC-V CPUs with FPGA-in-the-Loop Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39570)
*Leo Itoh,Junichiro Kadomoto*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出一种让LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选设计并利用板级性能测量指导设计决策的开发环境，将单周期RV32I核演进为三发射乱序RV32IM核，最终达5.61 CoreMark/MHz@130MHz（Artix-7），同等候选评估含实现过程比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍，并揭示短测中"性能提升"候选的长期性能退化问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPU候选的长时间RTL仿真耗时数小时，而短时诊断运行又可能遗漏执行后期才出现的性能退化，评估成本高，延缓了基于LLM智能体的CPU开发中的设计决策。

Method: 构建开发环境：由LLM智能体在FPGA上实现CPU候选，并以板上实际性能测量作为设计决策依据；在人工监督下将一个单周期RV32I核迭代为三发射乱序RV32IM核；对同一候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代，将FPGA评估（含实现）与单线程RTL仿真进行对比。

Result: 最终设计在Artix-7 FPGA上以130 MHz达到5.61 CoreMark/MHz；对同一候选运行8000次CoreMark迭代时，FPGA评估（含实现）比单线程RTL仿真快9.6倍；某案例中板上测量发现一个在短时诊断运行中表现更优的候选存在长期性能退化，该结果指导了候选选择，并促成基于RTL的根因分析与修复。

Conclusion: FPGA板级测量可显著降低LLM智能体驱动CPU设计的评估成本与决策延迟，并能捕获短时仿真易漏的长时性能退化现象，具备实用价值。

Abstract: Long-run RTL simulation of CPU candidates can take hours, while short diagnostic runs may miss performance degradation that emerges later in execution. This evaluation cost can delay design decisions in LLM-agent-based CPU development. We present a development environment in which LLM agents implement CPU candidates on an FPGA and use on-board performance measurements to guide design decisions. We applied it to the human-supervised development of a single-cycle RV32I core into a three-wide out-of-order RV32IM core. The final design reaches 5.61 CoreMark/MHz at 130 MHz on a Artix-7 FPGA. For the same CPU candidate running 8,000 CoreMark iterations, FPGA evaluation, including implementation, was 9.6x faster than single-threaded RTL simulation. In one case, board measurements revealed long-run performance degradation in a candidate that improved in a short diagnostic run. The result guided candidate selection and led to RTL-based root-cause analysis and a fix.

</details>


### [533] [MRUD: Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit Number Systems for High-Performance Arithmetic Units](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39638)
*Samaneh Rahimi,Ali Azarpeyvand*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出首个面向高基数的广义最大冗余无符号数字(MRUD)数制体系，将UDR从基数2推广到基数2^h并保持无进位加法，配套完整编码、运算、转换与硬件架构，在45nm下相对MRSD与常规架构实现显著延迟/面积/功耗与吞吐优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MRSD等有符号冗余数制虽可无进位加法，但因正负位并存导致乘法开销大；UDR在基数2已有潜力，但尚未推广到高基数，缺乏通用框架与硬件实现。

Method: 构建广义MRUD数制，覆盖数字编码、位扩展、加/减/乘运算、符号取反、正/反向转换算法、上溢/下溢检测，并给出有符号与无符号MRUD的硬件架构；在FreePDK 45nm库下评估RRR、BBR、BBB三种乘法器模式及MAC单元。

Result: 相较MRSD，MRUD延迟降低最多30%、面积缩小26%、功耗降低87%；BBR模式下32×32操作数较最佳常规架构延迟降低最多43%；MAC中仅在末尾做一次反向转换，吞吐较DesignWare高最多64%、较Wallace高150%以上。

Conclusion: MRUD实现了高基数冗余算术，在乘法器与MAC上性能显著提升，是传统有符号冗余数制的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Signed digit redundant number systems such as Maximally Redundant Signed Digit (MRSD) enable carry-free addition but introduce significant overhead in multiplication due to the presence of both positive and negative bits. While Unsigned Digit Redundant (UDR) systems have shown promise in radix-2, their extension to higher radices remains unexplored. This work presents the first generalized Maximally Redundant Unsigned Digit (MRUD) number systems for high-radix arithmetic, extending UDR representations from radix-2 to radix-$2^h$ while preserving carry-free addition. The proposed framework includes digit encoding, digit extension, arithmetic operations (addition, subtraction, and multiplication), sign inversion, forward/reverse conversion algorithms, overflow/underflow detection, and hardware architectures for both signed and unsigned MRUD representations. Unlike MRSD, which is inherently limited to signed arithmetic, MRUD supports both signed and unsigned representations, similar to conventional binary systems. Evaluations across three multiplier modes---RRR (Redundant inputs, Redundant output), BBR (Binary inputs, Redundant output), and BBB (Binary inputs, Binary output)---as well as Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, using the FreePDK 45nm library, demonstrate that MRUD achieves up to 30\% lower delay, 26\% smaller area, and 87\% lower power than MRSD. In BBR mode, MRUD achieves up to 43\% delay reduction over the best conventional architecture for 32$\times$32 operands, while in Multiply-Accumulate (MAC) units, performing reverse conversion only once at the end yields up to 64\% higher throughput than DesignWare and over 150\% higher than Wallace. These results demonstrate that MRUD enables high-radix redundant arithmetic with significantly improved multiplier and MAC performance, making it an efficient alternative to conventional signed digit redundant number systems.

</details>


### [534] [Caerus: Prefetching by Thinking Globally and Acting Locally](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39797)
*Jacky Wong,Jacob Alexandrou,Yinting Huang,Luke Panayi,Lev Mukhanov,Sam Ainsworth,Paul Kelly*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: Caerus：一种在多个不重叠的全局偏移上做PC局部过滤的偏移预取器，兼顾全局模式覆盖与高准确率，SPECspeed 2017几何平均加速8.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有偏移预取器存在两难：BOP采用单一全局偏移、及时性好但缺乏上下文敏感（per-PC）的准确率跟踪，导致DRAM流量显著增加、性能有时令人失望；最先进的Berti采用PC局部的偏移提取，准确率与性能优秀，但难以捕获全局内存访问模式，在不少场景下反而不如BOP等简单全局偏移预取器。因此需要一种同时融合全局模式覆盖与PC级准确率的方案。

Method: Caerus从全局内存访问轨迹中提取多个偏移，并以“最大化组合覆盖率”为目标进行训练：每个偏移仅在其未被此前已学习偏移覆盖的访问上训练，从而得到多个非重叠（互补）的全局偏移；随后对每个提取出的偏移进行PC局部过滤，按其是否能为任意PC覆盖未来访问来逐PC跟踪准确率，从而在应对复杂delta模式的同时保持高准确率。

Result: 在SPECspeed 2017上取得8.3%的几何平均加速，比Berti高2.0%，同时硬件开销与DRAM流量开销均较低。

Conclusion: 通过“全局多偏移提取+PC局部准确率过滤”的组合，Caerus克服了BOP（全局但无上下文跟踪）与Berti（PC局部但缺全局视野）各自的局限，在低开销下实现了更高的预取性能。

Abstract: Modern processors rely heavily on data prefetching to bridge the growing performance gap between computation and memory accesses. In offset prefetching, prefetches are issued at an address delta relative to the most recently observed access, selecting deltas that have exhibited high coverage in the recent access-stream history. The Best-Offset Prefetcher (BOP) exemplifies this approach by selecting a single uniformly-issued global offset that delivers timely prefetches. However, its lack of context-sensitive accuracy tracking results in significantly increased DRAM traffic and sometimes disappointing performance. Conversely, Berti, the state-of-the-art offset prefetcher, achieves impressive prefetching performance and accuracy. However, its Program-Counter (PC)-local approach to extracting offsets limits its ability to capture global memory patterns, meaning there are many scenarios where simpler global offset prefetchers, such as BOP, outperform it.
  Observing the limitations of contemporary offset prefetchers, we present Caerus: an offset prefetcher that employs PC-local filtering on multiple non-overlapping globally derived offsets. Caerus extracts multiple offsets from the global memory trace and maximizes their combined coverage by training each offset only on accesses not already covered by previously learned offsets. The accuracy of each extracted offset is tracked per-PC based on whether it can cover future accesses for any PC. This allows Caerus to address complex delta patterns while maintaining high accuracy. In SPECspeed 2017, Caerus gains a geomean speedup of 8.3%, outperforming Berti by 2.0% while achieving low hardware and DRAM-traffic overhead.

</details>


### [535] [LAMP: LLM-Driven Analog Placement through Adaptive Tool Composition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39882)
*Zecheng Xu,Guanhua Chen,Yumao Wu,Keren Zhu*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出以LLM充当版图工程师的模拟电路布局框架：通过可组合的布局组件（约束管理、布局与合法化、可布性与电性能轻量评估），LLM基于初始与演化设计的多模态检查点自主选择组合组件、构建并修订布局流程，同时调整布局层次（重开模块或将器件划分重组），并以经验技能提供可复用设计知识。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟布局需要在面积、匹配、可布性与电性能之间做电路相关的权衡；依赖预定义目标与固定布局流程难以平衡这些权衡，需要一种能按设计情境自适应决策的布局方法。

Method: 构建LLM驱动的布局框架：将布局能力封装为可组合组件（约束管理、布局与合法化、可布性与电性能的轻量评估）；利用初始与演化设计的多模态检查点，由LLM选择并组合组件以构造和修订自有布局流程；支持层次自适应（重开模块、器件划分与重组）使局部布局响应全局需求；引入经验技能提供可复用设计知识以指导决策。

Result: 在两个SMIC 180 nm电路上的评估表明，该框架减小了布局面积，并改善了大多数实测的后布局性能指标。

Conclusion: 以LLM作为布局工程师、通过可组合组件与多模态反馈自主构建并动态修订布局流程，是替代固定流程处理模拟布局多目标权衡的可行途径，可在面积与后布局性能上取得改进。

Abstract: Analog placement requires circuit-specific trade-offs among area, matching, routability, and electrical performance. Balancing these trade-offs through predefined objectives and fixed placement flows remains difficult. In this paper, we propose an analog placement framework in which a large language model (LLM) acts as a layout engineer through composable placement components. These components support constraint management, placement and legalization, and lightweight evaluation of routability and electrical performance. Using multimodal checkpoints of the initial and evolving design, the LLM selects and combines components to construct and revise its own placement flow. It also adapts the placement hierarchy by reopening modules or partitioning and regrouping devices, allowing local layouts to respond to global design needs. An experience skill provides reusable design knowledge to guide these decisions. Evaluation on two SMIC 180 nm circuits shows that the framework reduces placement area and improves most measured post-layout performance metrics.

</details>


### [536] [NORmal: Architecting 3D Ferroelectric NOR Flash as Main Memory -- From Co-Fabricated BEOL Arrays to 200B-Class Multi-Agent LLMs in a Smartphone](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40000)
*Zhuoran Li,Chen Gu,Zhuohang Bian,Haochen Yu,Yibo Zhao,Xuxiao Yang,Zhaori Cong,Jinshan Yue,Qing Luo,Di Geng,Ling Li,Youwei Zhuo*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出NORmal，首个面向3D铁电NOR闪存的主存架构，将BEOL 3D FeNOR阵列通过DRAM仿真桥接入未修改的LPDDR6总线，作为字节可寻址、确定性时序的rank，按可变性与生命周期（而非热度）放置智能体状态，在手机端原位服务200B级模型与持久规划器上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 手机端智能体团队（大规划器+并行worker、长时间会话）需要200B级模型与远超手机DRAM容量多倍的上下文。现有分层将flash视为存储：UFS无法支撑逐token权重流式加载，移动HBF需重新设计SoC且无法承受持续KV写入。作者进而指出的根本门槛是：非易失存储器要作为普通rank挂上未修改的LPDDR6总线，其访问延迟必须落在DRAM时序窗口内，而现有NAND层级均不满足。

Method: 1) 流片并实验表征BEOL 3D FeNOR阵列，共集成高密度3-bit MLC与快速、高耐久、可原位写入的SLC，感测延迟低于7.5 ns；2) 通过阵列下方的DRAM仿真桥、错峰bank读与零周期权重swizzling、posted SLC写，把共制造阵列变成LPDDR6接口上字节可寻址、时序确定性的load/store rank；3) 在該rank与DRAM之间按可变性和生存期而非访问热度放置智能体状态，原位承载200B级模型与持久规划器上下文，并按智能体阶段动态划分subchannel。

Result: 在生产级智能体trace的服务级模拟中：比UFS offloading快8.9×–28.0×；与无限DRAM理想相差0.4%以内；在超过256K token的会话上比HBF快2.8×–6.3×，每token内存能耗低8.1×–17.8×。

Conclusion: 满足DRAM时序窗口的3D FeNOR可作为LPDDR6主存rank，使手机端智能体团队摆脱对UFS/HBF的妥协；面向智能体工作负载的状态放置策略（按可变性/生命周期）与阶段化subchannel划分，可在近乎无限DRAM的理想性能下支撑200B级模型与超长上下文。

Abstract: Smartphone agents increasingly work as teams, in which a large planner directs parallel workers across long sessions. Running such a team on the device requires 200B-class models and contexts that exceed phone DRAM many times over, yet existing tiers treat flash as storage: UFS starves per-token weight streaming, and mobile High-Bandwidth Flash (HBF) needs a redesigned SoC and cannot absorb continuous KV writes. We show that a non-volatile memory can join an unmodified LPDDR6 bus as a plain rank only if its access latency fits the DRAM timing window, a condition no NAND tier meets. We present NORmal, to our knowledge the first main-memory architecture for 3D ferroelectric NOR flash. We have fabricated and experimentally characterized back-end-of-line (BEOL) 3D FeNOR arrays that co-integrate dense 3-bit MLC and fast, high-endurance in-place-writable SLC with sub-7.5 ns sensing. NORmal turns these co-fabricated arrays into a byte-addressable, deterministic-timing load/store rank on an unmodified LPDDR6 interface through an under-array DRAM-emulation bridge, staggered bank reads with zero-cycle weight swizzling, and posted SLC writes. Across this rank and DRAM, NORmal places agent state by mutability and lifetime rather than by hotness, serving 200B-class models and persistent planner contexts in place while dynamically partitioning subchannels across agent phases. In serving-level simulation on production agent traces, NORmal is 8.9$\times$--28.0$\times$ faster than UFS offloading, within 0.4% of an unlimited-DRAM ideal, and 2.8$\times$--6.3$\times$ faster than HBF on sessions beyond 256K tokens, with 8.1$\times$--17.8$\times$ less memory energy per token.

</details>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [537] [A 3D measurement workflow for assessing replication quality and tool degradation in moulded microfluidic channels](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39046)
*Mehmet Oğulcan Güngör,Jérôme Charmet,Ender Yıldırım*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 提出无需切片的整体微通道复制保真度评估工作流：将母模与复制件的3D扫描配准到同一网格，转换为局部斜率图并以通道内部斜率相关系数RQ_d量化保真度，可区分形状变化与尺寸变化并定位偏差，配套开源软件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模具的复制（如3D打印嵌件的注塑）需检验微通道从母模到聚合物复制件的转移保真度。传统方法仅用单一截面的宽深比，既无法反映侧壁形状，又依赖取截面的位置，评估不完整、不稳定。

Method: 对母模与复制件进行3D扫描并配准至公共网格；将各高度图转换为局部斜率图；在通道内部计算两斜率图的相关系数RQ_d，同时输出通道尺寸、高度误差图与斜率误差图；在已知退化程度的合成通道及三种树脂SL打印嵌件的注塑实验（15组嵌件-制件对、20次注射磨损试验）中验证，并开发开源软件。

Result: 合成通道侧壁逐渐圆化时RQ_d持续下降，而高度相关系数趋于饱和；15组SL嵌件-制件对中RQ_d为0.17–0.91，高度相关系数将10个成形良好通道的差异压缩在0.03以内；20次注射过程中某嵌件因侧壁磨损RQ_d由0.90降至0.72，而高度相关系数仍高于0.93，说明RQ_d对侧壁形状损失更敏感。

Conclusion: RQ_d结合高度/斜率误差图可分离并定位形状与尺寸偏差，支持模具材料比较、工具磨损检测及判断偏差源于成形前还是成形中；方法仅需母模与复制件的配准3D扫描，可推广至其他基于模具的复制工艺。

Abstract: Mould-based replication, such as injection moulding with 3D-printed inserts, needs a check of how faithfully microchannels are transferred from master to polymer replica. It is usually limited to a width or depth ratio from one cross-section, which misses the sidewall shape and depends on where the section is taken. We present a workflow that assesses the whole channel from 3D scans of master and replica, without sectioning. The scans are registered on a common grid, and each height map is converted into a map of local slope. The correlation of the two slope maps over the channel interior, RQ$_d$, is reported with the channel dimensions and height- and slope-error maps. These outputs separate a change of shape from a change of size and locate it. A user can thereby compare mould materials, detect tool wear, and tell whether a deviation arose before or during moulding. On synthetic channels with known degradation, RQ$_d$ fell steadily as the sidewalls were rounded, whereas the height correlation levelled off. For injection moulding with stereolithography-printed inserts in three resins, RQ$_d$ ranged from 0.17 to 0.91 over fifteen insert-to-part pairs. The height correlation placed the ten well-formed channels within 0.03. Over a twenty-shot run, one insert's RQ$_d$ fell from 0.90 to 0.72 as its sidewalls wore, while its height correlation stayed above 0.93. We developed open-source software that implements the workflow. Because the workflow needs only registered 3D scans of a master and its replica, it can in principle be applied to other mould-based processes.

</details>


### [538] [800 $^\circ$C Air-Ambient Operation of Extreme-Bandgap Al$_{x}$Ga$_{1-x}$N (x>0.6) Digital and Random-Alloy Channel HEMTs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39053)
*Abdullah Al Mamun Mazumder,Tariq Jamil,Mafruda Rahman,Muhammad Ali,Ankit Malik,Anthony Joyce,Patrick Darmawi-Iskandar,Chandan Joishi,Mansura Sadek,James G. Fiorenza,Manoj Kumar Chandra Mohan,Grigory Simin,Tomás Palacios,Asif Khan*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 对比蓝宝石衬底上AlGaN数字合金(DA)短周期超晶格与随机合金(RA)沟道MOSHEMT的高温(室温~800°C)特性，DA沟道器件热稳定性更优，为高温电子学提供新平台。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估AlGaN沟道HEMT在高温电子学中的可行性，并检验数字合金（超晶格）沟道相较随机合金沟道在高温下的稳定性优势。

Method: 在蓝宝石衬底上制备两种MOSHEMT：RA器件采用掺杂n⁺-85%Al势垒与高掺杂n⁺⁺-Al0.86→0.20Ga0.14→0.80N反向渐变层(RGL)形成表面欧姆接触；DA器件采用Al0.62Ga0.38N短周期超晶格沟道、二元AlN势垒及选择性再生长n⁺⁺-GaN源漏接触。对两者在室温至800°C范围内进行电学表征对比。

Result: 800°C时DA器件饱和漏电流由460降至172 mA/mm（降幅62.6%），RA由338降至98 mA/mm（71.0%）；DA亚阈值摆幅459 mV/dec，优于RA的550 mV/dec；DA阈值电压漂移<±10%，RA>±19%；DA在800°C下ON/OFF比>10⁴，RA仅约10³。

Conclusion: 数字合金(短周期超晶格)沟道HEMT在高温下表现出更优的热稳定性、阈值电压稳定性与开关比，是有前景的高温电子学新平台。

Abstract: This work demonstrates the high-temperature (room to 800 $^\circ$C) operation of thin Al$_{0.62}$Ga$_{0.38}$N digital alloy (DA) short-period superlattice (SPSL), and random alloy (RA) Al$_{0.64}$Ga$_{0.36}$N channel MOSHEMTs on sapphire. The RA devices employ a doped $n^{+}$-85%-Al barrier and a highly doped $n^{++}$-Al$_{0.86\rightarrow0.20}$Ga$_{0.14\rightarrow0.80}$N reverse-graded layer (RGL) for surface ohmic contact formation, whereas the DA devices employ a binary AlN barrier and selectively regrown $n^{++}$-GaN source/drain contacts. At 800 $^\circ$C, the DA channel devices exhibit better thermal stability: their saturated drain current decreases from 460 to 172 mA/mm (62.6%) compared with 338 to 98 mA/mm (71.0%) for the RA channel, and a lower subthreshold swing (459 for DA versus 550 mV/dec for RA). All tested DA devices also exhibit superior threshold-voltage stability ($<\pm 10\%$ versus $>\pm 19\%$ for RA) and maintain an ON/OFF current ratio >$10^4$ at 800 $^\circ$C, compared with ~$10^3$ for RA, thus establishing the DA channel HEMTs as a promising new platform for high-temperature electronics.

</details>


### [539] [A guide to enriched continuum modeling: advances on wave propagation in metamaterials through the relaxed micromorphic framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39836)
*Jendrik Voss,Svenja Hermann,Mohammad Sarhil,Patrizio Neff,Angela Madeo*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 该文提出用松弛微极模型（RMM）这一富化连续体框架系统建模机械超材料的色散行为，由Bloch-Floquet数据辨识频率无关本构参数，并讨论色散关系的结构、截止与渐近性质以及从无限周期介质到有限尺寸试样的过渡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典连续体无法描述机械超材料的色散与带隙特征，而直接对周期微结构做Bloch-Floquet分析虽精确却难以用于宏观边值问题；同时现有富化连续体模型在参数辨识、色散关系适用性及有限样品边界效应方面缺乏系统处理。

Method: 采用松弛微极模型（RMM）作为富化连续体建模框架；通过将解析的特征关系与后续数值优化相结合，从周期超材料的Bloch-Floquet色散数据中辨识频率无关的本构参数；进而分析所得色散关系的结构、截止频率与渐近行为；最后讨论由无限周期介质向有限尺寸试样过渡时的单胞截取问题，并考察零拉格朗日项、有效界面力与表面拉格朗日等纳入边界效应的途径。

Result: 给出了基于Bloo-Floquet色散数据的频率无关RMM本构参数辨识流程；明确了所获色散关系的结构特征、截止行为与渐近极限及其局限；并识别出有限样品建模中相关的界面与表面贡献机制（零拉格朗日项、有效界面力、表面拉格朗日）。

Conclusion: RMM可作为机械超材料色散行为的系统性连续体建模工具，其参数可由色散数据稳健辨识；但其色散关系存在结构性的截止与渐近局限，且从无限周期介质推广到有限尺寸试样时，单胞截取方式与表面/界面项的引入对边界效应描述至关重要。

Abstract: This contribution provides a systematic framework for modeling the dispersive behavior of mechanical metamaterials by an enriched continua approach using the relaxed micromorphic model (RMM). We give the identification of its frequency-independent constitutive parameters from Bloch-Floquet dispersion data of the periodic metamaterial by combining analytical relations for characteristic features with a subsequent numerical optimization. Particular emphasis is placed on the underlying structure and limitations of the resulting dispersion relations, including their cut-offs, and asymptotic behavior. Finally, the transition from infinite periodic media to finite-size specimens is addressed, highlighting the role of the microscopic unit-cell cut and discussing null-Lagrangian contributions, effective interface forces, and surface Lagrangians as approaches to incorporate boundary effects.

</details>

### [540] [LRMoE: Demand-Side Load Re-Calibration for Efficient MoE Training on Memory-Constrained Nodes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37720)
*Jiaming Hu,Zhida Jiang,Zhaolong Xing,Yu Li,Zhen Chen,Ke Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LRMoE是一个内存感知的MoE训练系统，通过前向规划专家保留配额与放置、反向按负载重校准指标筛选token-expert对，并结合容量感知路由与物理压缩，减少反向通信、计算与缓冲需求，在Qwen3-30B-A3B与GLM4.5-106B-A12B上相对SYMI将达到固定loss的MoE层累计训练时间降低21.2–44.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏MoE虽具备可扩展容量，但路由不均衡导致计算与通信瓶颈；现有放置与复制方法通过增加专家副本重分配负载，却与token相关缓冲区争抢有限的GPU显存。

Method: 前向阶段在资源约束下规划专家保留配额与放置，且保留全部被路由计算；反向阶段用负载重校准指标估计每个token-expert对对专家更新的贡献，并在配额内筛选；容量感知路由将保留对分配到原专家的可用实例；最后物理压缩形成更小的通信负载与可变尺寸分组GEMM。

Result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B和GLM4.5-106B-A12B上，相对SYMI，达到固定loss目标的MoE层累计训练时间减少21.2–44.8%。

Conclusion: 通过联合重校准反向需求与平衡保留负载的内存感知设计，LRMoE在保持全部前向路由计算的前提下显著降低反向开销并加速MoE训练，且优于现有负载重分配方案。

Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models offer scalable capacity for Web applications, but uneven routing creates computation and communication bottlenecks. Existing placement and replication methods redistribute this workload, yet additional expert copies compete with token-related buffers for limited GPU memory. We present LRMoE, a memory-aware MoE training system that jointly recalibrates backward demand and balances the retained workload. During forward execution, it plans retention quotas and expert placement under resource constraints while preserving all routed computations. During backpropagation, a load recalibration metric estimates each token-expert pair's contribution to the expert update and selects pairs within these quotas. A capacity-aware routing algorithm distributes retained pairs among eligible instances of their original experts. Physical compaction then forms smaller communication payloads and variable-size grouped GEMMs, reducing backward traffic, computation, and execution-buffer demand. Experiments on Qwen3-30B-A3B and GLM4.5-106B-A12B show that LRMoE reduces cumulative MoE-layer training time to fixed-loss targets by 21.2-44.8% relative to SYMI.

</details>


### [541] [Amortized Localized Posterior Inference for Model Calibration with Application to an Ocean Turbulence Closure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37731)
*Exaucé Luweh Adjim Ngarti,Élise Arnaud,Léo Nicoletti,Victor Trappler,Arthur Vidard*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出基于高斯权重的局部化后验族与条件归一化流摊销推理，用以处理模型差异与上下文不确定性下的参数标定，并在Branin-Hoo孪生实验与k-ε湍流闭合应用中验证其优于全局后验标定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单一标定参数在模型差异存在时难以在整个上下文域内重现物理响应；同时观测与上下文的不确定性会影响标定，需要被纳入并量化。因此需要一种随上下文变化的局部化标定方法。

Method: 按观测与目标上下文的接近程度对似然加权，构造局部化后验族；用高斯局部化权重并通过协方差膨胀引入上下文不确定性，在域边界处做反射处理，并可选择对上下文采样不均进行校正；用条件归一化流以摊销变分推断近似该后验族；在给定上下文测度下积分局部化后验得到边缘化参数分布。

Result: Branin-Hoo孪生实验中，在均匀与偏斜上下文分布下比较全局与局部推理，局部化降低了报告的聚合预测误差；单列海洋模型中k-ε湍流闭合（以大气表面强迫为上下文）的应用表明，局部后验标定相比确定性标定与全局后验标定降低了温度与纬向速度误差。两个孪生实验均设计为允许局部补偿。

Conclusion: 局部化后验标定能够有效应对模型差异与上下文不确定性，在合成与物理应用中均优于全局标定；边缘化局部后验可给出与上下文测度一致的参数分布。

Abstract: Model discrepancy may prevent a single calibration parameter from reproducing a physical response across the context domain. In addition, uncertainties in observations and contexts affect calibration and must be accounted for and quantified. We construct a family of localized posteriors by weighting observation likelihoods according to their proximity to a target context. Gaussian localization weights incorporate context uncertainty through covariance inflation, with reflection at domain boundaries and an optional correction for uneven context sampling. A conditional normalizing flow approximates the family of posteriors through amortized variational inference. Integrating the localized posteriors under a prescribed context measure gives the marginalized parameter distribution. In a twin experiment with the Branin-Hoo model, we compare global and localized inference under uniform and skewed context distributions. Localization reduces the reported aggregate predictive errors relative to the global posterior. An application to the k-$ε$ turbulence closure in a single-column ocean model, with atmospheric surface forcing as context, shows that localized posterior calibration reduces temperature and zonal-velocity errors relative to deterministic and global-posterior calibration. Both twin experiments are constructed to admit local compensation.

</details>


### [542] [ThinkJev: One Thought, Every Budget for Calibrated Typed Decisions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37732)
*Xiaolu Ding,Kai Yang,Dongdong Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ThinkJev 用同一个开放混合思考模型构建快慢双系统：System 1 直接读取选项字母概率，System 2 在缓存提示上思考后读取同一位置概率，并由带统计保证的接受检验在无训练条件下决定何时升级，从而仅在思考有益处付出秒级成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型的许多应用最终归结为封闭选项上的"打分类决策"，单次前向传播读取概率虽快（毫秒级）但在算术、计数、日期比较等多步决策上常出错；先思考可修正错误但每决策耗时秒级。因此需要"只在有效处思考"的自适应机制。同时，直接用 System 1 自身置信度决定是否思考效果不佳，因为模型最不确定的决策往往并非思考能修正的那一类。

Method: 基于单一开放混合思考模型构建双系统：System 1 在直接回答时读取选项字母概率；System 2 在同一缓存提示上思考后读取相同的字母概率，故升级不重复计算，且两系统输出同一选项集上的概率。由于思考任意 token 数后均可读取字母，一次采样思考即给出所有思考预算下的答案。无需训练，仅通过带标签开发集上的统计检验，在保证被接受答案误差率低于目标值的条件下允许 System 1 独立作答；其余样本采用"答案一旦置信即停止思考"的提前终止策略。

Result: 在 5% 目标误差率下，Qwen3.5-27B 在 8359 个测试决策中有 24.5% 由 System 1 独立作答，实测误差 3.9%（Qwen3.5-4B 与 9B 分别为 6.5% 与 0.0%）。其余样本采用置信即停的思考策略达到 81.6% 准确率，对比"总是思考"的 82.7%，仅消耗 72% 的思考 token。仅凭 System 1 置信度决定是否思考的收益更小。在 JevBench 公开条目上，Qwen3.5-27B 的思考比例为 29.4%，准确率与所列两个思考 API 无显著差异（探索性结论）。

Conclusion: ThinkJev 表明，借助缓存复用与统计检验校准的接受规则，可在无训练前提下实现"快慢结合"的选项级决策服务，在小幅准确率损失下大幅节省思考开销，且公开基准上与商业思考 API 表现相当；代码与数据生成器已开源。

Abstract: Many uses of language models end in a typed decision: a choice among a closed set of options, whose probabilities code can act on. Reading those probabilities from one forward pass is fast but often wrong on decisions that take several steps, such as arithmetic, counting, and date comparison. Letting the model think first fixes most of these errors, but costs seconds per decision instead of milliseconds. To pay for thinking only where it helps, ThinkJev builds a fast and a slow system from one open hybrid-thinking model that can answer directly or after a thought. System 1 reads the model's probabilities for the option letters when it answers directly; System 2 reads the same letters after the model has thought on the same cached prompt, so escalating repeats no work and both systems give probabilities over the same options. Because the letters can be read after any number of thought tokens, one sampled thought also gives the answer under every thinking budget. Without training, ThinkJev lets System 1 answer alone only where a statistical test on labeled dev data guarantees that its accepted answers stay under a target error rate. At a 5% target, Qwen3.5-27B answers 24.5% of 8359 test decisions this way with a realized error of 3.9% (Qwen3.5-4B and 9B: 6.5% and 0.0%). For the rest, stopping each thought as soon as its answer is confident reaches 81.6% accuracy, against 82.7% for always thinking, with 72% of the thought tokens. Choosing when to think from System 1's confidence alone saves less, because the decisions System 1 is least sure of are often not the ones thinking fixes. On the public items of JevBench, an independent benchmark of typed-decision services, Qwen3.5-27B thinks on 29.4% and is not distinguishable in accuracy from the two thinking APIs listed (exploratory). Code and data generators are available at https://github.com/ding-xiaolu/ThinkJev.

</details>


### [543] [OpenFrontiers: A Collection of Open Research Problems and a Benchmark for Scientific Rediscovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37739)
*Jiarui Yao,Ruida Wang,Tong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 OpenFrontiers，一个跨学科资源：包含 12,151 道开放研究问题的结构化语料库，外加一个数学领域"回溯式"基准（200 题，110 题于 2026 年被解决、90 题仍开放，均配 Lean 4 形式化陈述，经自动探针与两次独立评审；子集 HQ-50 按质量分进一步筛选），并给出三条件（闭卷、冻结检索、实时联网）下的形式化证明评测协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究级问题缺乏系统化汇集，且对 LLM 在研究级问题上的能力评测仍很困难；缺少可形式化评分、有文档化解答的评测子集来度量"研究级再发现"能力。

Method: 构建开放研究问题语料库（记录问题陈述、背景、进展等）；构建含已解/未解问题的回顾性基准，全部使用 Lean 4 形式化并经自动探针检查和两次人工独立评审，HQ-50 为高质量子集；评测协议在隔离沙箱中用两个独立检查器对形式化证明评分，设置闭卷、冻结检索、实时联网三种条件，在标准化预算下评测 7 个 LLM 智能体。

Result: 在 HQ-50 上，闭卷条件下再发现极少，40 道已解题中最多解决 7 道；实时联网条件下的成功主要反映对已发表解答的检索能力而非自主推理。

Conclusion: OpenFrontiers 将广泛的研究问题语料库与可形式化评分、含解答记录的评测子集相连接，为度量研究级再发现、研究面向当前开放科学问题的进展提供了基础。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown increasing promise in research-level problem solving, yet a comprehensive collection of such problems is still missing, and evaluating them on research-level problems remains challenging. We introduce OpenFrontiers, a cross-disciplinary resource that combines a structured corpus of open research problems with a retrospective benchmark of recently resolved problems in mathematics. The corpus records problem statements, context, progress, and other information for 12,151 problems. The benchmark contains 200 problems, 110 resolved in 2026 and 90 still open, each with a Lean~4 statement checked by automated probes and two independent reviews; a subset HQ-50 further filters based on quality score, etc. Our evaluation protocol grades formal proofs with two independent checkers in an isolated sandbox under closed-book, frozen-retrieval, and live-web conditions. Evaluating seven LLM agents on the HQ-50 subset under a standardized budget, we find that closed-book rediscovery is rare, at most 7 of 40 resolved problems, whereas live-web success mostly reflects retrieval of published solutions. By linking a broad research-problem corpus to a formally graded evaluation subset with documented solutions, OpenFrontiers provides a foundation for measuring research-level rediscovery and studying progress toward solving currently open scientific problems. The dataset and benchmark could be found in https://huggingface.co/collections/FlippyDora/openfrontiers.

</details>


### [544] [WebAnything: From the Wild Web to Scalable Agent Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37786)
*Tianci Xie,Zikun Cai,Chaoyun Zhang,Pinxue Guo,Bingxuan Li,Rui Zheng,Hang Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: WebAnything 全自动框架，可从真实 URL 重建源 grounded、可复用的 Web 环境，无需逐站点工程，产出 244 个工件并验证训练与评测增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web agent 需要多样、可执行、可重置的网站环境以支持可复现的训练与评测。人工辅助镜像需逐站点工程；生成式构造易偏离指定真实网站；采集回放受限于采集内容与回放能力，交互覆盖有限。因此需要一个无需逐站点人工实现、初始授权后免修复的自动化方案。

Method: 提出 WebAnything 全自动框架：Explorer-Builder 采集浏览器可观测的结构、资源与交互结果；独立验证器检查冻结候选项，指导局部修复或针对性源重采集。在 14 个应用域、53 个类别上构建 244 个网站工件，支撑 12,984 个已执行且被接受的任务；并在 5,856 条交互轨迹上微调 Qwen3.5-9B。

Result: 与人工辅助的 WebHarbor 相比，三项保真度指标总体得分更高，盲审 12 胜 2 平 0 负。微调 Qwen3.5-9B 后，REAL 成功率提升 9.9 个百分点，Odysseys-Easy 的 Rubric Avg 与 Task Avg 分别提升 6.25 与 6.32 个百分点，固定 harness 下 WebArena-Verified 总体成功率提升 13.33 个百分点。

Conclusion: WebAnything 实现了从真实 URL 到可复用网站环境的全自动重建，避免逐站点人工实现与后续修复，在保真度上优于人工辅助方案，并能有效提升 Web agent 的训练与评测表现，代码已开源。

Abstract: Web agents require diverse, executable, and resettable website environments for reproducible training and evaluation. Human-assisted mirrors demand per-site engineering, while generative construction can diverge from specified real websites. Capture-and-replay preserves observations, with interaction coverage constrained by captured content and replay capabilities.
  We present WebAnything, a fully automated framework that reconstructs source-grounded, reusable Web environments from real URLs without per-site manual implementation or repair after initial setup and authorization. An Explorer-Builder collects browser-observable structures, resources, and interaction outcomes; an independent verifier checks frozen candidates and guides local repair or targeted source recapture.
  We construct 244 website artifacts across 14 application domains and 53 categories, supporting 12,984 executed and accepted tasks. Compared with human-assisted WebHarbor, WebAnything achieves higher aggregate scores on three fidelity metrics, with 12 wins, two ties, and no losses in a blind audit. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on 5,856 interaction trajectories improves REAL success by 9.9 percentage points, Odysseys-Easy Rubric Avg and Task Avg by 6.25 and 6.32 percentage points, and WebArena-Verified Overall success by 13.33 percentage points under the fixed harness. Code: https://github.com/china-qijizhifeng/Web-Anything

</details>


### [545] [What Does an Ontology Catch? Curated, LLM-Generated and Data-Derived Ontologies as Checkers of LLM Agents over Knowledge Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37809)
*Michal Orzechowski,Rund Tawfiq,Tomasz Kosciolek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文把"本体论检查器"本身作为研究对象，系统比较精编本体、LLM生成本体与数据挖掘本体在LLM智能体回答Web知识图谱问答时的判定表现，量化其误检与漏检的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作默认"形式化模式=可靠裁判"，将本体论检查包裹在LLM智能体外部用于校验答案，但检查器本身也会出错（漏检错误、误标正确答案并诱导智能体去"修正"）。精编本体的成本是否值得、它与LLM撰写或数据挖掘得到的模式相比孰优孰劣，此前未知。

Method: 跨三类本体来源（精编、LLM生成、数据派生），三种使用方式（仅作提示上下文、仅作检查器、两者兼用），以及开源权重与闭源智能体；在公开图谱与近10^9三元组的私有图谱上，分别统计本体派生检查所捕获的错误与被误标为错的正确答案。

Result: 不同来源在"捕获错误"与"虚警"之间存在不同权衡；精编模式按原样使用时可能与其自身数据矛盾；结构检查会漏掉部分错误。在UniProt上，精编本体标记出的正确答案多于数据派生本体和"掩码标识符后由LLM从数据摘要生成的本体"；在真实智能体答案上，其告警仅比随机标注略更精确。

Conclusion: 形式化本体作为裁判的可靠性被高估，精编本体并不必然优于廉价替代方案，其检查在真实答案上的精确度接近随机水平；需重新审视本体论检查的成本收益，并考虑多源组合与向智能体提供检查器具体反馈的潜在收益。

Abstract: LLM agents that answer questions over Web knowledge graphs are increasingly wrapped in checks derived from the graph's ontology, on the assumption that a formal schema makes a reliable judge. Yet a checker can be wrong as well: it can miss errors, and it can flag correct answers and push the agent into "fixing" them. Whether a curated ontology is worth its cost as such a judge, and how it compares with an ontology an LLM writes or a schema mined from the data, is unknown. We make the checker itself the object of study. Across curated, LLM-generated and data-derived ontologies, used as prompt context, as a checker, or both, and across open-weight and proprietary agents on public graphs and a private graph of nearly $10^{9}$ triples, we account for what ontology-derived checks catch and what they wrongly flag. We show how each source trades caught errors against false alarms, how a curated schema used as published can contradict its own data, which errors structural checks miss, and whether combining sources or giving the agent the checker's specific feedback pays off. On UniProt, the curated ontology flags more correct answers than either an ontology derived from the data or one an LLM derives from a summary of the data with masked identifiers. On real agent answers, its flags are only marginally more precise than random flags.

</details>


### [546] [Measuring Where Intent Gets Lost in Agentic Smart Contract Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37830)
*Abhinav Goel,Agostino Capponi,Alfio Gliozzo,Chaitya Shah*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出以“执行一致性”为核心的方法评估AI生成的智能合约是否忠实实现需求，并进一步提出“先问需求、再写代码”的elicitation-first架构，证明前置澄清问题比事后审查或修补更能恢复描述中缺失的需求。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理能从自然语言描述生成可运行的代码，但“能运行”不等于“符合要求”。智能合约运行在区块链上、涉及资金转移且部署后不可修改，这种偏差代价极高。因此需要回答两个问题：如何检验AI编写的合约行为是否符合预期，以及需求行为在何处丢失。

Method: 1）基于执行而非主观判断的评测：将相同交易序列分别在AI生成的合约与应被复现的原始合约上重放，统计两者行为一致的比例；对每种评分工具注入人为错误检验其敏感性；与“不看描述独立编写的答案键”对比；对评分器做审计直到已知错误答案无法通过。2）提出elicitation-first架构：生成代码前，代理向客户提出一份简短的需求清单；用独立编写的可执行答案键校验合约；将分歧返回客户而非静默改写代码。在三种AI模型上验证。

Result: 常见方法（AI评审器、标准分析工具）会漏检明显错误，评分口径的选择也显著影响结论；仅检查所有系统都包含的函数会掩盖约一半的流水线间差异。前置提问的收益远大于事后审查或打补丁，且跨三种模型一致；自动化安全修复常常破坏原本符合要求的行为。少量精心设计的问题即可恢复短描述所遗漏的大部分需求，且其价值可在没有原始合约的情况下被估计。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是智能合约合成领域首个在生成之前收集缺失需求、并用独立编写的可执行模型校验结果的研究。其经验可推广到任何“AI代理将请求转化为程序”的场景。作者开源了工具、600个任务及全部实验结果。

Abstract: AI agents can now write software from a plain-English description, but code that runs is not the same as code that does what was asked. This gap matters most for smart contracts, the programs behind Web3 applications that move money on a blockchain and cannot be fixed once deployed. We ask how to check whether an AI-written contract behaves as it should, and where the requested behavior gets lost.
  We design an evaluation built on execution rather than opinion. We replay the same transactions on an AI-written contract and on the original it should reproduce and measure how often they agree. We test every grading tool on planted mistakes, compare against an answer key written without the description, and audit our own scorer until known wrong answers cannot pass. Common methods, such as AI judges and standard analysis tools, miss obvious mistakes, and scoring choices matter too. Checking only the functions every system includes hid about half the difference between pipelines.
  We then propose an elicitation-first architecture. Before writing code, the agent asks the client a short checklist of questions, checks the contract against an independently written executable answer key, and returns disagreements to the client instead of silently rewriting code. Asking first matters far more than reviewing or patching afterwards, across three AI models, while automated security fixes often break requested behavior. A few well-chosen questions recover much of what a short description omits, and their value can be estimated without the original contract. To our knowledge, this is the first study in smart contract synthesis to gather missing requirements before generation and check the result against an independently written executable model. The lessons extend to any setting where AI agents turn requests into programs. We release our tools, 600 tasks and all results.

</details>


### [547] [Detecting Covert Collusion between AI Agents through Partner-Outsider Positive Listening](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37849)
*Kevin Yandoka Denamganaï*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出行为学检测指标PoPLi：通过对比“使用该密码的伙伴”与“被置于其位置的无关智能体”在消息改述前后的动作变化差异，事后回放日志来检测隐蔽串谋信道；在五个条件的模拟市场中，只要存在首字母密码PoPLi即为0.48–0.59，无密码时为-0.10至-0.01，而仅看消息的监控器完全失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 共享秘密约定的AI智能体可用表面无害的消息协调，仅读取消息内容的监控器无法识别此类隐蔽串谋信道，因此需要一种不依赖消息语义解读的检测手段。

Method: 构造行为检验：保持语义不变对消息进行改述，真正的编码伙伴会对具体措辞产生反应，而无关智能体则不会。定义PoPLi为二者在动作变化幅度上的差值，并通过回放已记录的提示在事后计算。实验为含五种条件的模拟市场（无串谋、联合奖励+中性消息、同前但公开声明意图、隐蔽首字母密码、密码+声明意图），并与仅读消息的监控器对比。

Result: 存在密码时PoPLi处于0.48–0.59（95%区间下限均高于0.29），不存在时为-0.10至-0.01。仅读消息的监控器无法区分条件：读取说话者消息的监控器在全部50个市场中均判为“否”，读取所有卖家消息的监控器在10个无串谋市场中误报9个。

Conclusion: PoPLi检测的是私密信道的使用而非串谋本身；它无法识别仅靠激励实现的串谋，也无法识别通过语义承载的密码。

Abstract: AI agents that share a secret convention can coordinate through messages that look innocent, so a monitor that reads only the messages can miss them. We propose a behavioural test: a partner that uses a code reacts to the exact wording of a message, whereas an uninvolved agent placed in its seat does not. Partner--Outsider Positive Listening (PoPLi) is the difference between the two agents in how much their action changes when the message is reworded with its meaning kept, and it is computed after the fact by replaying logged prompts. In a simulated market with five conditions (no collusion, a joint reward with neutral messages, the same with an openly stated intention, a covert first-letter code, and the code with a stated intention), PoPLi is between 0.48 and 0.59 whenever the code is present (95% intervals all above 0.29) and between -0.10 and -0.01 without it. Message-only monitors did not separate the conditions: one reading the speaker's messages answered "no" in all 50 markets, and one reading every seller's messages flagged 9 of 10 markets with no collusion. PoPLi detects the use of a private channel, not collusion as such, and it cannot detect collusion through incentives alone or codes carried by meaning.

</details>


### [548] [Evaluating and improving AI agents for sequencing protocol understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37851)
*Chi-Lam Poon,Michael Goneos,Zezheng Song,Xi Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 LibStructBench——一个基于文档的基准，用于重建测序文库结构与分子工作流；实验表明前沿智能体只能"近似正确"，在分子状态表示与工作流连通性上仍不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学智能体基准很少评估智能体能否依据测序方案重建精确的分子结构与生成工作流，而这一能力对分析定制化测序实验至关重要，因此需要专门的文档落地型基准。

Method: 构建 LibStructBench：以方案文档为唯一依据，任务是重建测序文库结构和分子工作流；并对前沿智能体进行评测，做模型替换 vs. 智能体框架替换的对照分析，以及知识注入（小规模试点）与程序性规则/跨方案示例的自主累积实验。

Result: 智能体多能给出近似正确的重建，但精确重建不可靠，问题集中于分子状态表示与工作流连通性；更换底层语言模型带来的平均性能差异大于更换智能体框架，且仅在分子状态重建上差异显著；额外知识在小试点中提升寡核苷酸家族恢复率，但未提升分子工作流平均分；程序性规则与跨方案示例的自主累积呈非单调验证表现，在测试轨迹中未带来平均留出集分子工作流提升。

Conclusion: 现有智能体在复杂实验方案的分子过程推理上尚不可靠；需发展更可控、可验证的方法来支撑此类科学推理，并为基准设计与智能体架构选择提供参考。

Abstract: Existing scientific-agent benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can reconstruct the exact molecular structures and generation workflows specified by sequencing protocols, a capability critical for analyzing customized sequencing assays. We introduce LibStructBench, a document-grounded benchmark for reconstructing sequencing-library structures and molecular workflows. Our experiments show that frontier agents often produce approximately correct reconstructions but remain unreliable at exact reconstruction, particularly in molecular-state representation and workflow connectivity. Switching the underlying language model produced larger average performance differences than switching agent harnesses, with a statistically significant difference only for molecular-state reconstruction. Additional knowledge improved oligo-family recovery in a small pilot without improving mean molecular-workflow scores. Autonomous accumulation of procedural rules and cross-protocol examples showed non-monotonic validation performance and no mean held-out molecular-workflow improvement in the tested trajectory. These findings highlight the need for more controlled and verifiable approaches to scientific reasoning about molecular processes in complex experimental protocols.

</details>


### [549] [Seq@K: Evaluating Language Models Under Sequential Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37859)
*Thomson Yen,Gilbert Yang,Naimeng Ye,Minghui Chen,Dong Xia,Tianyi Shen,Yechan Jeon,Yaqin Chen,Daksh Mittal,Fangyu Wu,Hongseok Namkoong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 Seq@K 评测协议，衡量模型在 K 次序贯尝试中、每次失败后获得反馈能否解决问题，并在 7 个基准、16 个前沿模型上证明其揭示了与 Pass@K 显著不同的模型选择图景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体的核心新能力是从上下文自然语言反馈中学习并迭代改进答案，这是现代智能体工作流的普遍模式。但社区主要以 Pass@1 / Pass@K 排名模型，这类指标无法刻画模型如何利用此前尝试的反馈。多轮智能体基准关注长程规划，也未单独隔离"从反馈中精炼"这一核心能力。

Method: 提出 Seq@K 评测协议：给定问题，在 K 次序贯尝试内检验模型能否成功求解，且每次失败后向其提供反馈；该协议将"基于反馈的迭代精炼"能力形式化并隔离出来。在 7 个基准与 16 个前沿模型上进行评测，对比 Seq@K 与 Pass@K 下的模型排名与帕累托前沿，并分析 Seq@K 轨迹以刻画精炼行为（如对反馈所提问题的采纳率、对自身答案的固守程度），以及研究反馈性质对迭代精炼的影响。

Result: Seq@K 揭示了明显不同的模型选择格局：(1) 模型排名常常不同；(2) 帕累托前沿存在更高效的配置；(3) 选择最优模型配置带来的收益相对 Pass@K 可能扩大或缩小。轨迹分析可刻画迭代精炼行为，如模型采纳反馈所指问题的速率及其对自身答案的固守程度；反馈的性质会显著影响迭代精炼效果。

Conclusion: Seq@K 为通常在反馈回路中运行的智能系统提供了更忠实的度量指标；实践者需谨慎设计与基准测试迭代智能体系统的反馈回路，并在为这类系统评估模型时纳入 Seq@K。

Abstract: Language-model agents differ fundamentally from prior intelligent systems in their ability to learn from natural language in context. This capability enables agents to iteratively refine their answers in response to feedback, a prevalent mode of operation in modern agentic workflows. However, the community primarily ranks models by metrics such as Pass@1 or Pass@K, which cannot capture how they utilize feedback on prior attempts. We introduce Seq@K, a natural evaluation protocol that measures whether a model can solve a problem within K sequential attempts, provided feedback after each previous failure. Unlike multi-turn agentic benchmarks that examine long-horizon planning, Seq@K isolates and formalizes the core capability of refinement from feedback. We evaluate Seq@K on a suite of 7 benchmarks and 16 frontier models, and show that Seq@K reveals a materially different model-selection landscape: under Seq@K, (1) model rankings often differ, (2) the Pareto frontiers admit more efficient configurations and (3) the gains from choosing the optimal model configuration can widen or shrink relative to those of Pass@K. We further show that analyzing model trajectories under Seq@K helps characterize iterative refinement behavior, such as the rate at which models address issues raised in feedback, or how rigidly they hold onto their own answers. Finally, we study how the nature of feedback affects models' iterative refinement, showing that practitioners must carefully design and benchmark the feedback loops of iterative agentic systems. Together, these results establish how Seq@K offers a more faithful metric for intelligent systems that typically operate in such feedback loop, and the necessity to consider Seq@K in evaluating models for these systems.

</details>


### [550] [What Constitutes Food Similarity? Visual Representations and Retrieval in Indian Cuisine](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37867)
*Saransh Kumar Gupta,Akshadha Sharma,Lipika Dey,Partha Pratim Das,Ramesh Jain*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文指出食物相似性不应仅以身份识别性能衡量，而应考察视觉表示所形成的关系邻域结构；在印度菜数据集上用七种预训练视觉表示评估图像级与菜品级相似性，发现图像级邻域随表示变化很大，菜品级聚合出现共性视觉结构但与食谱相似性对应较弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 食物相似性是检索、推荐、替换等食物计算任务的基础，但现有食物表示通常只用身份保持（identity preservation）来评估，忽略了相似性的关系结构。作者希望探究：不同视觉表示如何将食物组织成关系邻域、这些邻域揭示了或掩盖了哪些烹饪关系、以及这些结构在不同表示间是否一致。

Method: 以扩展的Khana数据集为对象，印度菜作为挑战性场景（视觉相似但烹饪身份不同、同一菜系家族内外观差异大）。选取七种预训练视觉表示，涵盖卷积、Transformer、自监督及图文对齐模型。评估图像到图像检索与图像到菜品邻域，分析菜系家族结构、对比案例及跨表示一致性；并将图像表示聚合为菜品级表示，比较模型间的菜品级视觉相似性，并与同一批菜品的食谱派生相似性对照。

Result: 图像级邻域在不同表示间差异显著，甚至出现跨越菜系家族边界的相似性；菜品级聚合尽管存在局部变异，仍显现出共同的视觉结构，但该结构与食谱派生相似性的对应较弱。

Conclusion: 仅凭识别性能无法刻画关系结构；食物相似性取决于表示、模态与抽象层级，而非食物集合的固定属性。理解这些结构是把多种食物信息模态整合为一致相似性概念的前提。

Abstract: Food similarity underlies retrieval, recommendation, substitution, and other food computing tasks, yet food representations are typically evaluated by identity preservation. We ask what happens to food similarity beyond identity: how different visual representations organize foods into relational neighborhoods, what culinary relationships these neighborhoods reveal or obscure, and how consistently these structures emerge across representations. Indian cuisine provides a challenging setting in which visually similar foods may have different culinary identities, while foods within a culinary family can vary substantially in appearance. Using an expanded Khana dataset and seven pretrained visual representations spanning convolutional, transformer-based, self-supervised, and image-text aligned models, we evaluate image-to-image retrieval and image-to-dish neighborhoods, examining culinary-family structure, contrast cases, and cross-representation agreement. We also aggregate image representations to compare dish-level visual similarity across models and against recipe-derived similarity for the same dishes. Image-level neighborhoods vary substantially across representations, including similarities across culinary-family boundaries. At the dish level, aggregation reveals common visual structure despite local variation, but this structure corresponds less strongly with recipe-derived similarity. These findings show that recognition performance alone cannot characterize relational structure: food similarity depends on representation, modality, and abstraction level rather than being a fixed property of the food collection. Understanding these structures is therefore a prerequisite to combining multiple food information modalities into a coherent notion of similarity.

</details>


### [551] [Verification Learning Theory: A Process Model of Checking and Retention in AI-Assisted Judgment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37875)
*Christoph Trattner*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出"验证学习理论"(VLT)，将AI助手的即时即刻帮助与延迟独立表现之间的潜在权衡形式化：感知可靠性决定证据核查，核查经历决定规则保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确的AI辅助虽能改善当下的判断，却会削减练习独立完成任务所需操作的机会，可能损害延迟的、无辅助的独立表现。作者需要一个形式化框架来解释并预测这种"当下受益—长期受损"的权衡。

Method: 构建VLT模型：将感知到的助手可靠性与证据核查相联结，将核查历史与规则使用的保持相联结。模型严格形式假设任务需求与感知可靠性仅通过核查影响学习，且每次真实核查带来等量学习。通过模拟考察该假设的后果与参数依赖性，并与加工深度理论、反馈编码理论进行预测对比。

Result: 模型预测：即使未观察到助手出错，感知到的易错性也能改善延迟的无辅助判断；而当核查已被要求并实际执行时，该优势消失。核查历史对特定规则的增益与预测可作为进一步检验。模拟仅展示理论承诺的后果与参数依赖，不构成实证验证；与竞争理论的预测在部分情形下可区分，部分情形下观察等价。

Conclusion: VLT为AI辅助下的学习权衡提供了可检验的形式化框架，指明了可检验机制的关键实验，并将"已练习规则的保持"与"识别新论断适用哪条规则"这一更广泛问题区分开来。

Abstract: Accurate AI assistance can improve immediate judgments while reducing opportunities to practise the operations needed for independent performance. Verification Learning Theory (VLT) formalises this possibility for claim-evaluation practice followed by correct, independent, rule-specific feedback. The model links perceived assistant reliability to evidence checking and links the history of those checks to retained rule use. Its strict form assumes that task demands and perceived reliability influence learning only through checking, with equal learning per genuine check. It therefore predicts that perceived fallibility can improve delayed unaided judgment even without observed assistant errors, and that this advantage disappears when checking is already required and performed. Rule-specific gains and forecasts from checking histories provide further tests. Simulations examine the consequences and parameter dependence of these commitments; they do not constitute empirical validation. Comparisons with depth-of-processing and feedback-encoding accounts identify where predictions diverge and where the accounts remain observationally equivalent. The framework specifies experiments that can test the proposed mechanism and separates retention of practised rules from the broader problem of recognising which rule applies to a new claim.

</details>


### [552] [The Anatomy of Socio-Demographics in Pluralistic Offensiveness Modeling: When and Where It Helps, and the Role of Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37896)
*Yifan Wang,Leixin Zhang,Jinyi Mu,Yu Wang,Mayank Jobanputra,Isabel Valera,Vera Demberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文系统分析了社会人口学信息在多元冒犯性建模中何时、何层次以及通过何种机制带来收益，发现收益在个体层面小且不稳定、在群体与总体层面更清晰，且显式推理（分解为基线+人口学偏移）是有效利用该信息的关键。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主观判断（如冒犯性）在个体间差异显著，纳入标注者社会人口学信息的多元建模被视为捕捉该差异的途径；但已有研究关于此类信息的收益结论不一，亟需系统分析其有效性及作用机制。

Method: 在三个多标注者数据集上，使用提示式与训练式LLM：(1) 对比个体/群体/总体层面的评估；(2) 采用"总体基线 + 人口学特定偏移"的推理与预测格式，并通过干预验证各分量估计的作用；(3) 对比直接人口学条件化与显式推理文本—人口学交互两种引导方式。

Result: 人口学收益在个体预测上小且不一致，在群体和总体层面更明显（聚合削弱了掩盖系统性信号的个体特异变异）；收益来自基线与偏移两个分量，干预显示更优的分量估计能改善最终预测；显式推理在基线、偏移及最终预测上均优于仅条件化，后者很少产生有信息量的偏移。

Conclusion: 既往研究证据混杂可能部分源于个体层面的评估方式；社会人口学信息的价值同时取决于评估层次与模型被引导使用该信息的方式。

Abstract: Subjective judgments such as offensiveness often vary substantially across individuals, motivating pluralistic modeling approaches that incorporate annotators' socio-demographic information to capture this variation. However, prior findings on the benefits of socio-demographic information for pluralistic modeling are mixed, calling for a systematic analysis of both its effectiveness and the mechanisms through which it improves prediction. In this work, we study $\textbf{when}$ and $\textbf{where}$ socio-demographics benefit pluralistic offensiveness modeling, as well as $\textbf{the role of explicit reasoning}$ in leveraging this information. Across three multi-annotator datasets with prompted and trained LLMs, we first show that demographic gains are small and inconsistent for individual predictions but become clearer at the group and population levels, because aggregation attenuates the idiosyncratic variation that masks small but systematic demographic signals. Second, using a reasoning and prediction format that explicitly decomposes individual judgment into an overall baseline and a demographic-specific deviation, we show that the gains arise from both components: demographic information improves baseline estimation and enables meaningful demographic-specific shifts, and interventions show that better component estimates improve final predictions. Finally, comparing direct demographic conditioning with explicit reasoning about how the text interacts with annotator demographics, we find that reasoning yields more accurate baseline and shift estimates as well as final predictions, whereas conditioning alone rarely produces informative shifts. These results suggest that the mixed evidence in prior work may partly stem from individual-level evaluation, and that the value of socio-demographic information depends on both how it is evaluated and how models are guided to use it.

</details>


### [553] [FilingLoop: Evaluating and Evolving LLM Agents for Corporate Disclosure Review and Revision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37905)
*Wentao Zhang,Yilei Zhao,Guangyan Gan,Shuo Sun,Lin William Cong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FilingLoop——基于SEC历史往来函件的交互式基准与自进化智能体框架，用于公司披露文件审查与修订；通过过程性学习将需求级反馈转化为角色指导，使需求满足率从24.28%提升至27.96%、完整评论解决率从16.90%提升至20.75%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SEC EDGAR等披露库支持投资者查阅公司文件，但用语言模型智能体辅助审查需具备三项交互能力：在相关文件间发现未明示的缺陷、获取缺失的公司事实、验证修订满足有证据支撑的要求。现有金融问答评测难以体现这些交互能力。

Method: 构建FilingLoop基准：基于美国证券交易委员会历史往来函件，从96家公司重建380个以IPO审查为主、信息约束各异的任务；由独立于执行智能体的评估器依据6,099条合格要求对最终文件与回复打分，并审计无依据主张与有害修订。框架将单案例内的迭代审查—修订与跨案例的过程性学习耦合，把需求级评估反馈转化为角色特定指导，不更新模型权重；更新仅影响后续案例，从而在不重试已评分任务的前提下评估过程性适应。

Result: 在评估流上，进化使需求满足率由24.28%升至27.96%，完整评论解决率由16.90%升至20.75%，总成本相比固定策略变体仅增加5.8%。

Conclusion: FilingLoop将智能体发现的关注点、获取的公司事实与所做修订相连接，并提供需求级反馈以改进后续审查任务中的过程。

Abstract: Public disclosure repositories such as SEC EDGAR support informed investment through web access to corporate filings. Supporting their review with language model agents requires discovering unstated deficiencies across related documents, acquiring missing company facts, and verifying that requested revisions satisfy evidence-backed requirements. Existing financial question-answering evaluations provide limited evidence of these interactive capabilities. We introduce \textbf{FilingLoop}, an interactive benchmark and a self-evolving agent framework for corporate disclosure review and revision. Grounded in historical U.S.\ Securities and Exchange Commission correspondence, FilingLoop reconstructs 380 predominantly IPO review tasks from 96 companies under distinct information constraints. An evaluator separate from the acting agents scores final filings and responses against 6,099 eligible requirements and audits unsupported claims and harmful revisions. Our framework couples iterative review and revision within each case with procedural learning across cases, converting requirement-level evaluation feedback into role-specific guidance without updating model weights. Updates affect only subsequent cases, allowing procedural adaptation to be assessed without retrying scored tasks. On the evaluated stream, evolution increases requirement fulfillment from 24.28\% to 27.96\% and full comment resolution from 16.90\% to 20.75\%, with a 5.8\% increase in total cost over the fixed-policy variant. FilingLoop connects the concerns an agent discovers with the company facts it obtains and the revisions it commits, providing requirement-level feedback for procedures used in later review tasks.

</details>


### [554] [Beyond Low-Pass Dynamics: Frequency-Selective Spiking Reservoirs with Resonant Neurons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37906)
*Aurora Micheli,Claudio Gallicchio,Nergis Tomen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出HRF-Res：用异构谐振-发放（HRF）神经元替换LIF神经元构建脉冲储备池（液态状态机），通过频率选择性内在振荡动力学提升时序频率表征能力，在十个基准上达到脉冲储备池方法中的SOTA精度，并比等价非脉冲振荡储备池能耗低至19倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有脉冲储备池几乎全部依赖LIF神经元，其低通动力学难以区分不同时间频率上的编码信息，限制了表征判别性。

Method: 将液态状态机中的LIF神经元替换为异构HRF神经元群体；利用HRF的内在振荡动力学与输入频率选择性响应，使储备池捕获频率特异的时序模式，同时保持事件驱动稀疏脉冲计算。

Result: 相比LIF储备池获得更具判别性的表征和更高分类精度；能耗较等价非脉冲振荡储备池最多低19倍；在时间序列、序列图像、音频脉冲序列与神经形态视觉共十项基准上取得脉冲储备池方法中的最优精度。

Conclusion: 在脉冲储备池中引入频率选择性动力学可提升表征质量与分类性能，同时保持其固有能效，说明神经元动力学异质性是改进脉冲储备池的关键设计维度。

Abstract: Spiking reservoir computing combines the training efficiency of fixed recurrent reservoirs with the energy efficiency of event-driven inference, where computation is triggered by sparse spikes rather than executed densely at every timestep. However, existing spiking reservoirs almost exclusively rely on Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons, whose low-pass dynamics limit their ability to distinguish information encoded at different temporal frequencies. We introduce HRF-Res, a liquid state machine in which LIF neurons are replaced by a heterogeneous population of Harmonic Resonate-and-Fire (HRF) neurons. These neurons exhibit intrinsic oscillatory dynamics and selectively respond to input frequencies, enabling the reservoir to capture frequency-specific temporal patterns. The result is more discriminative representations and higher classification accuracy than LIF-based reservoirs, achieved without sacrificing the energy efficiency of spiking computation, with up to 19x lower energy consumption than an equivalent non-spiking oscillatory reservoir. Evaluated on ten benchmarks spanning time series, sequential images, audio spike trains, and neuromorphic vision, HRF-Res achieves state-of-the-art accuracy among spiking reservoir methods. These results demonstrate that introducing frequency-selective dynamics into spiking reservoirs improves representational quality and classification performance while preserving their inherent energy efficiency.

</details>


### [555] [SciGame: Let Agents Play the Scientific Discovery Games in the Real and Counterfactual World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37919)
*Yusheng Zhao,Bowei He,Xue Liu,Mingxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SciGame基准：将科学文献转为结构化“科学卡片”，生成原版与维度一致的反事实环境，在候选引导的辨识与开放式发现两种设置、三种先验协议下评测LLM智能体的定律归纳能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有科学发现基准存在问题：把定律推断与编程混在一起，以数据拟合分数而非对未见输入的预测来评分，且未将经验证据与预训练先验区分开，导致无法干净评估智能体真正的归纳能力。

Method: 构建SciGame受控基准：每张卡片给出同任务接口下的一对Original与维度一致Counterfactual环境；含Historical（经典定律）与Temporal（模型知识截止后发表的文献）两个集；评测设置分为候选引导的Identification与开放式Discovery；每设置下运行Prior-only、Fixed、Adaptive三种协议；在5个前沿模型上实验。

Result: 三项发现：(1) 一旦支配关系被改变，熟悉的先验反而损害性能；(2) 自适应实验对最强模型有帮助，但在有限预算下损害较弱模型；(3) 好的解释可能掩盖定量失败；即使证据解读正确，恢复精确符号形式仍是主要瓶颈。
