This raises a natural question: can it reason rigorously about an unknown world? We introduce the Algebraic World Model (AWM), a framework that turns interaction with unfamiliar environments into explicit mathematical models supporting formal reasoning. AWM explores the environment and develops executable Python hypotheses, continually testing and revising them against observations. It then structures these hypotheses into typed objects and shared rules, simplifies their structure through category-theory-guided transformations, and formalizes the resulting model in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility. AWM can formally prove that a goal is unreachable, even beyond explored trajectories. On two impossible game levels, it constructs closed, kernel-checked Lean proofs excluding every legal winning sequence in all six runs, while Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Astra, equipped with coding tools, produce none in twelve baseline runs. Four of AWM's six initial bounds are correct, compared with one for Opus 5.5 and none for GPT-6 Astra; given only feedback that a cheaper win exists, AWM revises its rules and constructs new proofs, reaching six of six correct bounds. Moreover, AWM produces interpretable mathematical models whose rules can be inspected and tested step by step. Across all 25 public ARC-AGI-3 games, these models enable Lean to replay the winning trajectories of all 183 levels and generalize beyond observed play, predicting unseen transitions and detecting changes in game mechanics. With Claude Opus 5, AWM clears all levels with a score of 99.9, while its certified winning trajectories use only 43% of the human baseline's actions.

</details>


### [689] [Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40551)
*Alan Sorani,Ashvni Narayanan,Michael Shalyt,Tali Monderer,Rotem Kalisch,Hila Barkan,Elyasheev Leibtag,Shachar Weinbaum,Carsten Schneider,John Campbell,Ido Kaminer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文分析Ramanujan Challenge（研究级数论问题基准）的提交结果，比较不同AI模型、CAS与形式化工具的表现，并提出一个AI辅助的证明评估流程，以可靠地大规模判定自然语言证明、CAS代码与Lean形式化的正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI数学能力提升使有意义的基准从大学题目与奥赛题转向研究级数学。Ramanujan Challenge以数论研究级问题（含未发表结果与开放猜想）构成基准，需要系统评估提交质量，同时暴露了大规模可靠判定复杂证明这一新难题。

Method: 对Challenge提交进行实证分析，度量不同AI模型、计算机代数系统（CAS）和形式化工具的相对成功率；并设计AI辅助评估流水线，针对自然语言证明、CAS代码和Lean形式化，从语义与逻辑正确性两个层面进行判定。

Result: 发现与官方解答概念上不同的正确提交，并给出其中一个已发表开放猜想的证明。相比单次LLM判定，所提流水线将自然语言证明的假阳性判定率从23%降至6%，将支撑代码的判定准确率从46%提升至58%。

Conclusion: 该工作为大规模评估研究级数学提供了方法论，可推广至数学与AI for Science的更广领域。

Abstract: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics. The Ramanujan Challenge is a benchmark comprised of research-level problems in number theory, including unpublished results and open conjectures. It presented concrete formulas for mathematical constants whose correctness can be checked numerically, while their proofs may require non-obvious mathematics. Here, we analyze the Challenge submissions, measuring the relative success of different AI models, Computer Algebra Systems (CAS), and formal tools. We find correct submissions that are conceptually distinct from the official solutions, and a proof of one of the published open conjectures. Evaluating the submissions exposed a second challenge: judging complex proofs reliably at scale. We introduce an AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, CAS code, and Lean formalizations that assesses semantic and logical correctness. Compared with the conventional one-shot LLM judgment, our pipeline reduces false-positive verdicts on natural language proofs from 23% to 6% and improves judgment accuracy on supporting code from 46% to 58%. This approach provides a methodology for evaluating research-level mathematics at scale, with potential applications across mathematics and AI for science.

</details>


### [690] [Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40535)
*Ziyi Guan,Yael Tauman Kalai,Ron Rothblum,Zoe Xi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"可回卷交互式证明"(RIP)模型：验证者可将证明者回卷到交互先前状态并从该处继续，用于弱验证者监督强AI系统。针对对少量oracle答案扰动鲁棒的计算构造了相对化RIP，效率优于不含诚实证明者假设的先前方案且不使用密码学，并完成实现与MNIST初步实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可扩展监督需要弱验证者检验更强AI系统计算的输出。现有相对化交互式证明方案中，debate效率高但依赖"两个强模型中至少一个诚实"的假设；去除该假设的方案计算开销大幅上升。作者希望在不假设诚实证明者、也不使用密码学的前提下，获得更高效的可扩展监督验证协议。

Method: 引入可回卷交互式证明（RIP）：当证明者是AI模型时，验证者可保存模型状态快照，之后恢复到先前交互状态继续对话。基于此能力，对"输出对改变小比例oracle答案具有鲁棒性"的计算类构造相对化RIP。

Result: 构造中诚实证明者运行时间为原计算的线性时间；验证者在一次性预处理之后，运行时间接近输入长度的线性（输入可远小于计算本身）。作者实现了协议，报告了初步MNIST实验，并表明RIP可比一个已部署的先进证明系统更快。

Conclusion: RIP作为一种新的可扩展监督工具具有独立价值：只要验证者控制证明者所在机器（如可信硬件或可做检查点的虚拟机），回卷即可实现。

Abstract: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems. One proposed approach uses relativizing interactive proofs, in which a weak verifier checks the output of a complex oracle-aided computation by interacting with one or more powerful provers. A prominent example is debate, which is highly efficient but assumes that one of two powerful AI models, or provers, is truthful. For certain classes of oracle-aided computations, this assumption can be removed, but at substantially greater computational cost.
  In this work, we introduce \emph{rewindable interactive proofs} (RIPs), a new model of relativizing interactive proofs for scalable oversight. In an RIP, the verifier may rewind the prover to an earlier state of the interaction and continue from there. This is possible when the prover is an AI model, since the verifier can save a snapshot of the model's state and later restore it. We construct a relativizing RIP for computations whose outputs are robust to changing a small fraction of oracle answers. Our construction is more efficient than prior relativizing proofs that do not assume a truthful prover, and it uses no cryptography.
  In our construction the honest prover runs in time linear in that of the original computation, and the verifier, after a one-time preprocessing step, runs in time nearly linear in the input length (which can be much smaller than the computation itself). We implement our protocol, report a preliminary MNIST experiment, and show that an RIP can be faster than a state-of-the-art deployed proof system.
  RIPs may be of independent interest. Rewinding is possible whenever the verifier controls the prover's machine, for example when the prover runs on trusted hardware or in a virtual machine whose state can be checkpointed.

</details>


### [691] [Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40563)
*Eric Rudolph,Philipp Steigerwald,Jens Albrecht*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较大语言模型（Mixtral 8x7b，4-bit量化）与真人扮演的咨询来访者在教育性角色扮演中的表现，基于句子级的咨询沟通模式分析，发现两者在会话动态与咨询师行为上既有相似也有差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新手咨询师需要大量角色扮演练习，但真人来访者扮演成本高、不易规模化，因此需评估LLM模拟来访者能否替代或补充真人角色扮演。

Method: 先录制新手咨询师与真人同伴（扮演来访者）的角色扮演会话，再进行人与Mixtral 8x7b（4-bit量化）模拟来访者的会话；对全部互动以句子为单位用咨询沟通模式编码系统进行分析，考察（1）LLM生成回应在多大程度上复现真实对话动态，（2）咨询师面对真人与LLM来访者时沟通行为是否不同。

Result: 两种情境下咨询沟通模式的使用既存在相似性也存在差异，说明LLM模拟在会话动态上具有部分真实性，同时咨询师行为会随来访者类型而变化。

Conclusion: LLM驱动的角色扮演练习具有提升咨询胜任力的潜力，并指出了虚拟来访者模拟需进一步改进的方向。

Abstract: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players. Initially, we recorded role-playing sessions, where novice counsellors interacted with human peers acting as clients, followed by role-plays between humans and clients simulated by Mistrals Mixtral 8x7b using 4-bit quantization. These interactions were analysed with a counselling communication pattern system at sentence level. We investigated two key questions: (1) to what extent LLM-generated responses replicate authentic conversational dynamics and (2) whether counsellors' communication behaviour differs when interacting with human versus LLM-simulated clients. The findings highlight both similarities and differences in the application of counselling patterns across scenarios, showing the potential of LLM-based role-playing exercises to enhance counselling competencies and to identify areas for further refinement in virtual client simulations.

</details>


### [692] [VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40578)
*Qiushi Sun,Da Yu,Alexander Knop,Amer Sinha,Lingpeng Kong,Ben Kao,Ravi Kumar,Pritish Kamath*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: VeriCUA：将任务完成验证建模为跨平台、跨模态的智能体探索式动态取证与评估框架，统一在线/离线设置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建与扩展跨桌面、移动、Web的计算机使用智能体（CUA）需要可靠的任务完成验证，用于数据筛选、评测与强化学习。现有自动化方法有两类：用VLM直接判定轨迹，或生成程序检查应用状态。二者都只依赖数字环境的局部视图——VLM受限于给定观测，生成程序受限于可访问状态，可能遗漏决定性证据、导致判定缺乏支撑；此外针对不同平台与访问条件定制验证器还会带来额外工程成本。

Method: 提出平台无关的验证框架VeriCUA，把验证视为在统一流程中进行的动态证据收集与评估。验证器先检查可用上下文构建任务rubric（评分细则），再针对未满足的要求自适应选择GUI检查或代码检查，并按显式证据规则融合两类发现。

Result: 在多种平台与访问设置下，与参考标签的一致性优于对比基线；离线场景在困难样本上增益最大，在线场景对虚假“已完成”声明的拒绝能力更强。分析表明增益来自互补证据与测试时探索。

Conclusion: 验证应构成从局部观测扩展到主动探索的动态取证过程；统一框架可替代按平台/访问方式定制的分离验证器，缓解局部视图导致的证据缺失问题。

Abstract: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Typical automated approaches prompt vision-language models (VLMs) to judge trajectories or generate programs to inspect application state. However, both rely on partial views of complex digital environments. VLM judges are restricted to supplied observations, while generated programs depend on accessible state. These views can omit decisive evidence or leave completion judgments unsupported. Tailoring separate verifiers to different platforms and access settings adds further engineering cost. We present VeriCUA, a platform-agnostic framework for verification through agentic exploration. It treats verification as dynamic evidence gathering and assessment within a shared procedure for online and offline settings across platforms and observation modalities. After inspecting the available context to construct a task rubric, the verifier selects GUI or code checks for unresolved requirements and combines their findings under explicit evidence rules. Experiments show improved agreement with reference labels over the compared baselines across these settings, with the largest offline gains on hard cases and stronger rejection of false completion claims online. Further analyses connect these gains to complementary evidence and test-time exploration.

</details>


### [693] [Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40545)
*Daniel Strauß,Zhenshan Bing,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出将检索建模为"对地址空间的持久局部遍历"，分离内容与地址，用成本正则化的索引目标（边际价值形式产生吸引与排斥两种压力），并在 MiniGrid Memory 上以最简固定几何实例验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文模型在每个前向传播中重复求解高度相关的检索问题；注意力/全局检索保留大存储但每次都要重新搜索，循环压缩则靠"提前决定保留什么"回避搜索。二者都未利用相邻检索步的有用记忆可能高度重叠这一事实。

Method: 把记忆内容与其地址分离：效用由检索内容所揭示的信息定义，几何只决定到达该信息的代价。据此构造成本正则化的索引目标——在局部邻域内保留信息价值，同时对每个被"本地可达"的记忆计费；其边际价值形式自然导出吸引压力（互补记忆在增量价值超过检索成本时应可共同检索）与排斥压力（冗余记忆不应仅因各自有用而占据同一检索集）。实验仅测试最简单的固定几何实例：持久局部遍历头。

Result: MiniGrid Memory 上，五 token 上下文下持久局部遍历头在 0.59M 训练步达到 0.95 平均回报；高斯绝对地址需 0.94M，类别式绝对地址需超过 2M。

Conclusion: 实验未检验学习到的几何与重复检索，仅作为原理性验证，支持"有状态检索比无状态检索更易学习"的假设；完整方法仍需进一步实验。

Abstract: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve. Neither mechanism directly exploits that useful memories at neighbouring retrieval steps may substantially overlap. We propose an alternative in which retrieval is a persistent local traversal through an address space. We separate a memory's content from its address. Utility is defined by the information revealed by retrieving the content, while geometry determines only how cheaply that information can be reached. This leads to a cost-regularised indexing objective that preserves information value inside local neighbourhoods while charging for every memory made locally accessible. Its marginal-value form gives both attractive and exclusion pressures. Thus, complementary memories should be co-retrievable when the additional value exceeds retrieval cost, whereas redundant memories should not occupy the same retrieval set solely because they are individually useful. As a proof of principle, we test only the simplest fixed-geometry instance on MiniGrid Memory. A persistent local traversal head reaches $0.95$ mean return after $0.59$M training steps with a five-token context, compared with $0.94$M for Gaussian absolute addressing and more than $2$M for categorical absolute addressing. The experiment does not test learned geometry or repeated retrieval. Instead, it motivates the hypothesis that stateful retrieval may be easier to learn than stateless. To test the full proposed method further experimentation is necessary.

</details>


### [694] [Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40556)
*Qiaoyu Zheng,Weike Zhao,Yanjie Fan,Ye Cao,Mengqi Jiang,Xiao Zhou,Xiaoman Zhang,Pengcheng Qiu,Yongguo Yu,Yanfeng Wang,Ya Zhang,Chaoyi Wu,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ClinGeX——一个通过任务检索与依赖感知编排调用105个可执行技能的大语言模型智能体，用于缓解临床基因组解读瓶颈；在223例时间留出基准上任务级一致率达71.7%（最强基线45.7%），并在45名专业人员的人机协作实验中显著提升病例级解读一致性并缩短解读时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床基因组分析需专家整合不断演化的指南、数据库与计算证据，随着测序普及，这一复杂且劳动密集的流程已成为基因组信息及时用于临床决策的主要瓶颈。

Method: 开发LLM智能体ClinGeX，将105个经人工整理的"可执行技能"通过任务特定检索与依赖感知编排进行组合；评估包括：(1) 223例时间留出基准与专家参考分类对比；(2) 三条件、平衡设计的人机协作研究，45名临床基因组专业人员评估135例临床来源病例（无AI、DeepSeek辅助、ClinGeX辅助）；(3) 为期一个月、11名资深人员的探索性真实世界非干预评估，收集96个自选分析片段反馈。

Result: 基准测试中ClinGeX达到71.7%的时间留出任务级宏平均一致率，最强对比方法为45.7%；人机协作研究中，ClinGeX辅助在标准级变异分析、罕见病基因组解读与分子肿瘤决策中的原始病例级一致率分别为51.1%、57.8%、64.4%，对应对照条件为15.6%、31.1%、20.0%，且在全部场景中降低自报解读时间；真实世界评估中报告结论采纳频繁并节省时间。

Conclusion: 可执行领域技能是增强专家基因组解读的一条有前景的路径。

Abstract: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence. As sequencing has become increasingly accessible, this complex and labor-intensive process has become a major bottleneck to the timely use of genomic information in clinical decision-making. To fill this gap, we developed ClinGeX, a large-language-model agent that composes 105 curated executable skills through task-specific retrieval and dependency-aware orchestration. On 223 temporally held-out benchmark cases, ClinGeX achieved 71.7\% macro-averaged task-level concordance with expert reference classifications, compared with 45.7\% for the strongest comparator. In a three-condition, counterbalanced human-AI collaboration study, 45 clinical genomic professionals assessed 135 clinically derived cases under routine (no AI assistance), DeepSeek-assisted and ClinGeX-assisted conditions. ClinGeX assistance increased raw case-level concordance across criterion-level variant analysis, genomic interpretation in rare disease and molecular oncology decision-making (51.1\%, 57.8\%, 64.4\% versus 15.6\%, 31.1\%, 20.0\% in comparator conditions) and reduced reported interpretation time in all scenarios. During an exploratory one-month real-world non-interventional assessment, 11 experienced professionals submitted feedback on 96 self-selected analysis episodes and reported frequent conclusion adoption and time savings. These findings support executable domain skills as a promising approach to augment specialist genomic interpretation.

</details>


### [695] [FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40560)
*Di Wu,Ling Liang,Haizhao Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出 FARMS——一个将计算数学转化为 AI 可用的“计算知识”的可信高效基础框架，通过源材料准备、可复用表示与语义审查，把形式化陈述与来源语境、算法含义及定量保证关联起来，在 171 个随机数值线性代数和数值偏微分方程目标中，157 个被流水线接受，平均成本约 0.85–2.29 美元/目标，并以热流求解与波动响应压缩为例说明经 Lean 检验的蕴涵可将来源陈述连接到计算技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化计算科学有望通过选择、改编和开发数值方法来加速科学发现，但这一前景要求 AI 系统能够解释并复用带有显式保证的数学知识。现有工作缺乏将计算数学高效、忠实地转化为 AI 可复用的、具备形式化保证的“计算知识”的基础设施。

Method: 提出 FARMS 框架，包含三大组件：源材料准备（source preparation）、可复用表示（reusable representations）与语义审查（semantic review），将形式化陈述与来源语境、算法含义和定量保证相连接。在随机数值线性代数与数值偏微分方程共 171 个目标上进行评估，并利用经 Lean 检验的、从显式来源前提出发的蕴涵关系，将选定陈述与计算技能关联。

Result: 171 个目标中 157 个被流水线接受；平均估计成本为每目标 0.85–2.29 美元（跨不同来源）；通过热流求解与波动响应压缩两个示例展示了 Lean 检验蕴涵可将来源陈述连接到计算技能的能力。

Conclusion: FARMS 为可信的自动化计算科学提供了一个可负担、可复用的知识基础，使 AI 系统能够以带显式保证的方式解释与复用计算数学知识。

Abstract: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees. Here we present FARMS, a faithful and efficient foundation that transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready computing knowledge. FARMS connects formal statements to source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees through source preparation, reusable representations and semantic review. Across 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical partial differential equations, 157 were accepted by the pipeline, with mean estimated costs of US \$0.85-2.29 per target across sources. Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises connect selected statements to computational skills, illustrated by a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression. FARMS therefore supports an affordable, reusable knowledge foundation for trustworthy automated computational science.

</details>


### [696] [Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40588)
*Leonidas Raghav*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文验证了对智能体激活值施加线性探针，可在其输出写出之前预测"即将泄密/屈服"的行为，预警信号真实存在但范围短、区分度有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体共享信道与凭据时，同伴可施压使目标智能体违反操作者规则，构成串谋的第一步。现有输出过滤器只能检查已生成内容，缺乏事前的预警手段。作者追问：监管者能否在输出生成前判断智能体"即将屈服"？

Method: 构建受控多智能体场景：6 个情境下，同伴最多用 20 轮施压诱导目标泄露秘密（如部署令牌）。在每次模型调用的激活层面训练线性探针，于输出写出前读取激活做判定；对照基线包括零样本决策模型监控器，以及在相同调用上训练的 bag-of-words 分类器。

Result: Qwen3-32B 留出回合上，在标记 5% 良性调用的阈值下，探针捕获 82% 泄密调用；同等误报率下零样本决策模型监控器仅 26%。gpt-oss-20b 上对其推理内容做探针达 AUROC 0.91。但 bag-of-words 分类器表现接近，说明增益主要来自有监督标签而非激活信息；探针亦会标记"被允许的披露"，即更多是在读取"即将披露"而非"违规"；预警为短程，且任何告警即中止会误停多数良性情节，二次文本检查也无法补救。

Conclusion: 生成前预警在原理上可行，可为监管者提供先于消息传播或招募扩散的干预窗口；但当前探针主要反映披露意图而非规则违背，假阳性成本高、预警时窗短，尚不足以支撑直接中止策略，需更细粒度的标签与更强的区分手段。

Abstract: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in? We show that a linear probe on the agent's activations can, in a controlled multi-agent setting. Across six scenarios, a peer presses a target for up to 20 rounds to reveal a secret, such as a deploy token; the target often refuses, then gives in. Read at each model call before its output is written, the probe picks out the one that leaks. On held-out Qwen3-32B episodes, at a threshold set to flag 5% of benign calls, it catches 82% of leaking calls. At a similar flag rate, a zero-shot decision-model monitor catches 26%. On gpt-oss-20b, a probe on its reasoning reaches AUROC 0.91. A bag-of-words classifier trained on the same calls comes close, so most of the gain comes from training on labels, not activations. The probe also flags permitted disclosures: it reads the coming disclosure more than the violation. The warning is short-range, and halting on any alarm would stop most benign episodes, which a second text check does not fix. A warning raised before generation could let an overseer stop an agent that is about to give in, ahead of others acting on its messages or recruitment spreading through a swarm.

</details>


### [697] [Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40589)
*El Mustapha Mansouri,Eikichi Kimura,Masato Koga,Keigo Arai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出一个由LLM智能体组成的自主研究实验室，智能体之间可相互评审并可中止或改变研究方向；以金刚石量子自旋系综为载体，完成从选题、理论推导到实验验证的全流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI系统虽能承担部分研究角色，但可能得出证据不支持的结论，缺乏自我审查与纠错机制，距离"全流程自主研究实验室"仍有差距。

Method: 构建基于大语言模型的多智能体系统，智能体相互评估彼此工作，可生成并否决研究问题、要求独立的理论校验、设计用于挑战自身结论的实验。以金刚石中的量子自旋系综为对象，推导预测给定族微波脉冲序列响应所需的最少校准参数数目，进行计算验证并设计区分竞争预测的实验。

Result: 初始实验与理论预测一致，但重复参考测量显示采集期间信号存在漂移，智能体据此判定结果不确定，在不放宽接受标准的前提下修改测量协议；修正后的实验满足验收标准并支持理论预测。

Conclusion: 协作式AI智能体能够自主选择研究问题、推导理论结果并进行实验检验，展示了自主科研闭环的可行性，且内置的相互审查与严格验收标准可有效避免过度结论。

Abstract: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal. Recent AI systems take on several research roles, but may draw conclusions that the evidence does not support. Here, we present an autonomous research laboratory in which agents based on large language models assess one another's work and can stop or redirect investigations. They can generate and reject research questions, require separate theoretical checks and conduct experiments designed to challenge their claims. We demonstrate these capabilities by investigating ensembles of quantum spins in diamond. The agents derived the minimum number of calibration settings needed to predict responses to a defined family of microwave pulse sequences. They checked the result computationally and designed experiments to distinguish competing predictions. An initial experiment agreed with the theoretical predictions, but repeated reference measurements showed that the signal was drifting during data collection. The agents therefore treated the result as inconclusive and revised the measurement protocol without relaxing the acceptance criteria. The revised experiment met those criteria and supported the theoretical predictions. This study demonstrates that collaborating AI agents can select research questions, derive theoretical results and test their predictions experimentally.

</details>


### [698] [Wavelet Phase Diffusion for Structurally and Semantically Consistent Sim-to-Real Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.21628)
*Kaiwen Wang,Frank Bieder,Yinzhe Shen,Carlos Fernandez,Jan-Hendrik Pauls,Omer Sahin Tas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出小波相位扩散（ψ-PD），在双树复小波包变换域注入相位并引入低频随机化，实现无配对数据训练、低开销的仿真到真实图像/视频翻译，兼具真实感与结构语义一致性，并支持实例级翻译。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sim2Real 翻译需同时弥合外观差异并保持结构与语义一致性：条件控制法空间对齐但控制模块开销大；配对数据法真实感强但依赖复杂合成管线且易改变几何与语义；免训练编辑法无学习外观先验、感知质量受限；现有保相位扩散受傅里叶全局频谱耦合影响，产生振铃、边界泄漏等空间伪影。

Method: 核心为两个组件：(1) 在双树复小波包变换（DTCWPT）域操作，利用局部化小波包实现空间自适应相位注入，避免全局频谱干扰；(2) 低频随机化（LFR）替换低频包，使模型脱离合成光照先验，获得分布内的真实外观。二者均可在无配对开放域数据上训练，推理开销可忽略；空间局部性支持实例级翻译（单目标/区域独立翻译而背景不变）。

Result: 在 vKITTI→KITTI 图像翻译上，真实感与语义一致性优于既有方法，同时保持有竞争力的结构对齐；在 CARLA 视频翻译上，真实感接近配对数据方法，并使 VLM 规划器的 ADE 与 FDE 分别降低 5.4% 与 5.1%。

Conclusion: 以局部化小波包相位控制替代傅里叶域全局耦合，可在无配对数据、低推理开销下同时提升 Sim2Real 翻译的感知真实度、结构语义一致性与下游规划性能，并拓展出实例级可控翻译能力。

Abstract: Simulation-to-reality translation must bridge the appearance gap between synthetic and real domains while preserving structural and semantic consistency. Conditioning-based methods achieve spatial alignment but introduce computationally expensive control modules. Paired-data methods achieve realism but rely on complex synthesis pipelines, often altering scene geometry and semantics. Training-free editing methods avoid both constraints but lack a learned appearance prior, limiting their perceptual quality. Recently proposed phase-preserving diffusion presents a promising alternative, but Fourier-domain formulations are constrained by global spectral coupling. This coupling induces spatial artifacts such as ringing and boundary leakage, thereby degrading structural and semantic consistency. We introduce Wavelet Phase Diffusion, which addresses this through two components. First, we operate in the Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Packet Transform domain, whose localized wavelet packets enable spatially adaptive phase injection without global spectral interference. Second, Low-Frequency Randomization (LFR) replaces the low-frequency packet, decoupling the model from the synthetic illumination prior and enabling in-distribution real-world appearance. Both components train on unpaired open-domain data, and introduce negligible inference overhead. The spatial locality further enables instance-level translation, where individual objects or regions are translated to photorealistic appearance independently while the surrounding scene remains untranslated. On vKITTI $\to$ KITTI image translation, $ψ$-PD outperforms prior methods in realism and semantic consistency while maintaining competitive structural alignment. For CARLA video translation, $ψ$-PD approaches the realism of paired-data methods while reducing VLM planner ADE and FDE by $5.4\%$ and $5.1\%$, respectively.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [699] [Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform: Data-Adaptive Window-Length Selection for Time-Frequency Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37795)
*Manan Mittal,Kanad Sarkar,Ryan M. Corey,John R. Buck,Andrew C. Singer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出Universal STFT（U-STFT），将分析窗长建模为数据自适应的状态变量，用三阶Rényi熵打分候选窗长，并以格型路径聚合实现线性复杂度与对数遗憾界，从而顺序化解时频分辨率折中，并保证精确重叠相加重构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STFT存在固有分辨率折中：短窗时间定位好但频率分辨率差，长窗频率分辨好但时间分辨率差。传统做法需预先固定或人工选择窗长，无法随信号局部特性变化而自适应调整，因此需要一种能在时变信号上顺序、自适应地解决该折中的变换框架。

Method: 将分析窗时长设为数据自适应状态变量，用以索引当前观测区间内所含的跳数；每帧用归一化三阶Rényi熵对候选窗长库打分以量化联合时频集中度；用窗长格型（trellis）以每帧线性复杂度聚合O(3^M)个候选窗长调度；再对候选库做后验期望，由傅里叶变换线性性得到等价于单一自适应有效窗的STFT；并采用包络归一化合成流保证精确重叠相加重构。

Result: 理论上获得相对任意含k次分辨率变化、共M帧的事后窗长调度的累积混合损失遗憾界O((k+1)log M)。在合成信号与海洋生物声学信号上验证了自适应分辨率跟踪、增强的频谱集中度以及精确的时域可逆性。

Conclusion: U-STFT以序列决策视角将窗长选择转化为自适应状态跟踪问题，在保持STFT线性性与精确可逆性的同时，以低复杂度获得接近事后最优的时频分辨率调度，适用于非平稳、瞬时与谐波并存的实际信号分析。

Abstract: The short-time Fourier transform (STFT) characterizes the local frequency content of time-varying signals by evaluating the discrete Fourier transform over a sliding analysis window. The STFT is governed by a fundamental resolution trade-off: a short window localizes rapid transients in time at the cost of frequency resolution, whereas a long window resolves closely spaced harmonics at the expense of temporal resolution. The Universal Short-Time Fourier Transform (U-STFT) resolves this trade-off sequentially by modeling the analysis window duration as a data-adaptive state variable that indexes the number of hops included in the current observation interval. At each frame, a bank of candidate window durations is scored using normalized order-three Rényi entropy to quantify joint time-frequency concentration. A window length trellis aggregates the resulting $\mathcal{O}(3^M)$ candidate window schedules with linear complexity per frame, guaranteeing a cumulative mix-loss regret bound of $\mathcal{O}((k+1)\log M)$ relative to any hindsight window schedule with $k$ resolution changes over $M$ frames. By linearity of the Fourier transform, posterior expectation across the candidate bank yields a single spectrum equivalent to an STFT evaluated with a data-adaptive effective window, while an envelope-normalized synthesis stream guarantees exact overlap-add reconstruction. Evaluations on synthetic and marine bioacoustic signals demonstrate adaptive resolution tracking, enhanced spectral concentration, and exact time-domain invertibility.

</details>


### [700] [Doppler-Shannon Association in Vehicular Networks: A Stochastic Geometry Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37928)
*Ashutosh Balakrishnan,Francois Baccelli,Sanjoy Kumar Jhawar,Philippe Martins*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文提出随机几何框架，将多普勒频移通过相干时间建模进物理层网络性能，推导2D/3D PPP下多普勒统计，提出多普勒感知效用与最优BS关联策略，证明"多普勒-香农"关联优于经典香农关联。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统蜂窝网多采用最近距离BS关联，但车联网中BS与UE高移动性导致多普勒频移，使衰落信道呈现强时变特性，最近距离关联不再是物理层性能最优；需从随机几何角度定量刻画多普勒对关联与覆盖/中断的影响。

Method: 1）在二维与三维PPP模型下研究多普勒频移的统计特性，分析其分布及几何影响因素；2）提出多普勒感知效用，建模时间选择性衰落链路中由多普勒引起的可达香农速率；3）基于该效用解析推导UE达到给定QoS的中断概率与覆盖概率；4）提出在LOS条件下同时考虑BS运动方向、衰落增益与欧氏距离的最优BS关联策略，超越最近距离关联。

Result: 最近BS不再是最优关联，导致与BS关联的覆盖划分呈非凸镶嵌结构；解析与仿真表明需要多普勒频移校正以补充理想SNR香农性能；所提多普勒-香农关联在网络性能上解析及仿真均优于经典香农关联。

Conclusion: 在车联网中将多普勒频移效应纳入随机几何建模可显著改善关联策略与覆盖/中断性能；基于多普勒感知效用的关联设计优于传统最近距离与纯香农速率关联。

Abstract: Historically, in cellular networks, the user equipment (UE) association with a base station (BS) has been largely confined to nearest BS association strategies. Unlike cellular networks wherein the BSs are static, vehicular networks are prone to high mobility, resulting in the UE experiencing a Doppler shift. The Doppler shift further results in the fading channel exhibiting high temporal variability. In this work, we present a novel stochastic geometry framework, modeling the effects of the Doppler shift on the physical layer network performance through the coherence time. First, the statistics of the Doppler shift are studied in a two- and three-dimensional Poisson point process (PPP) setting. The distribution and the geometric factors influencing the Doppler shift are analyzed. Next, we propose Doppler shift aware utilities, modeling the Doppler shift induced Shannon rate achievable in time-selective fading links. Through these utilities, we analytically study the outage and coverage probabilities for a UE to achieve a given quality of service. These probabilities are computed based on the optimal BS association in vehicular networks, which goes beyond the closest Euclidean distance. In the UE-BS line of sight, the novel BS association policies factor the BS direction of motion and the fading gain, in addition to the Euclidean distance. We show that the nearest BS is no longer the optimal BS association, resulting in non-convex coverage tessellations associated with the BSs. Our analytical and simulation results illustrate the need for a Doppler shift correction, complementing the ideal SNR based Shannon performance. The network performance achieved through the proposed Doppler-Shannon based association is proved, analytically as well as through simulations, to be superior to the classical Shannon based association.

</details>


### [701] [Neuroscience of Improvisation Across Music and Other Domains: A Survey and Outlook](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37958)
*Levina Perzhilla,Muhammad Mahboob Ur Rahman,Tareq Y. Al-Naffouri*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该综述通过PRISMA式检索量化了即兴神经科学研究集中于音乐的失衡（111项研究中70.3%涉及音乐即兴或一般心理测量学创造性），系统整合音乐领域的脑成像证据并扩展至舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育、治疗与专业实践，指出目前不存在跨领域的即兴"通用神经标志"，并展望可穿戴EEG-fNIRS与闭环BCI以"专家化门控控制问题"框架助力音乐即兴研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 即兴行为广泛存在于音乐、舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育与治疗等领域，但其神经科学研究几乎仅局限于音乐，导致既有综述或"以音乐为中心"、或"局限于单一构念"，缺乏跨领域、系统性的证据整合。

Method: 开展PRISMA式文献检索并统计研究领域分布；对音乐即兴部分，系统梳理fMRI、EEG、fNIRS、超扫描、神经反馈与脑刺激研究，明确标注证据一致处与异质处；对舞蹈、戏剧、体育、教育、治疗与专业实践等域，则汇总以行为学、质性及仿真为主的研究。

Result: 111项研究中70.3%聚焦音乐即兴或一般创造性心理测量。一致证据包括：额叶参与随经验变化（经验依赖性）、额叶alpha与theta功率升高；异质证据包括：外侧前额叶活动方向、半球偏侧化、alpha功率的解释。整体上，无论音乐域内还是跨域，均未出现即兴的通用神经标志。

Conclusion: 即兴缺乏普适神经签名，应避免单一构念化的神经推断；未来应发展可穿戴EEG-fNIRS传感与闭环脑机接口（以证据较充分的音乐即兴为切入点），将其建模为专家化门控控制问题，作为刻意练习的可能补充，并明确列出其他领域尚需补齐的证据。

Abstract: Improvisation (or Improv), the real-time generation of novel, context-appropriate action, occurs in music, dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice. Its neuroscience, however, has been studied almost exclusively for music, where most quantitative neuroimaging evidence lies. A PRISMA-style search done by authors quantifies this imbalance: of 111 identified studies, 70.3\% concern musical improvisation or general psychometric creativity. This explains why earlier surveys are either music-centered or confined to a single construct. This survey addresses that gap in two ways. First, for music, it organizes findings from functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI), electroencephalography (EEG), functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS), hyperscanning, neurofeedback, and brain stimulation, and reports transparently where the evidence agrees (e.g., experience-dependent changes in frontal engagement, increased frontal alpha and theta power) and where it is heterogeneous (e.g., the direction of lateral prefrontal activity, hemispheric lateralization, the interpretation of alpha power). Second, it extends the review to dance, theater, sport, education, therapy, and professional practice, where behavioral, qualitative, and simulation-based studies predominate. Overall, the current evidence does not point to a universal neural signature of improvisation within music domain or other domains. We conclude with an outlook on wearable EEG--fNIRS sensing and closed-loop brain--computer interfaces for musical improvisation, the domain with sufficient evidence, formulated as an expertise-gated control problem and discussed as a possible complement to deliberate practice, and we list the evidence needed for other domains.

</details>


### [702] [A Subsample Time-Delay Estimator with a Farrow Structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.37980)
*Hugh L. Kennedy*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于变分数延迟(VFD)FIR滤波器组的宽带信号亚采样时延估计新方法，利用Farrow结构将MSE表示为滤波器延迟的多项式，其局部极小值对应未知时延；在中高SNR下优于GCC。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典亚采样时延估计(TDE)问题中，广义互相关(GCC)等方法在非低信噪比条件下精度有限，需要一种针对两相邻传感器接收宽带信号的、精度更高的TDE方案。

Method: 定义基于均方误差(MSE)的不相似性度量，用有限冲激响应(FIR)的变分数延迟(VFD)滤波器组对其进行评估；采用Farrow结构实现滤波器组，使MSE功率可表示为关于滤波器延迟的多项式函数，从而以该多项式的局部极小值定位未知信号时延。

Result: Monte-Carlo仿真表明，在SNR不低于约10 dB（即非低信噪比）条件下，所提估计器性能优于广义互相关(GCC)技术。

Conclusion: 基于VFD滤波器组与Farrow结构的多项式化MSE准则为宽带亚采样时延估计提供了有效且精度更优的替代方案，适用于中高信噪比场景。

Abstract: A novel solution to the classical problem of subsample time-delay estimation (TDE) for a wideband signal received by two adjacent sensors is described. A mean squared-error (MSE) measure of dissimilarity is defined and evaluated using a variable fractional-delay (VFD) filter bank with a finite impulse response (FIR). Using a filter bank with a Farrow structure allows the MSE power to be expressed as a polynomial function of the filter delay with a local minimum at the unknown signal delay. In Monte-Carlo simulations, the proposed estimator outperforms the generalized cross-correlation (GCC) technique when the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is not low (less than 10 dB).

</details>


### [703] [Forward-Backward Map Matching for Airborne Magnetic Anomaly Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38047)
*Joseph O'Leary,Tapio Simula,Tom Kimpson,Corey Davey,Wenchao Li,Andrew D. Greentree,Allison Kealy*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 将磁异常图匹配建模为链式因子图推断，用前向-后向算法逐段求解，得到候选位置的离散后验及其香农熵，作为无真值歧义诊断量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空磁异常导航可作为GNSS的被动、抗干扰替代方案；但现有图匹配算法或假设高斯后验（EKF）、或依赖蒙特卡洛采样（粒子滤波）、或丢弃后验不确定性只保留单一最优路径（Viterbi）。

Method: 把图匹配表述为链式因子图上的推断问题，按段使用前向-后向算法求解，给出候选位置上的离散后验，并计算各时刻的香农熵 H_t。在 Renfrew_395 地图上以 10^3 次合成试验、10^3 条飞行路径评估，并以分段级熵阈值作为误差预警判据。

Result: 中位位置误差 32.7 m，比中位惯性漂移 362 m 低 91%；中位误差较 EKF 与粒子滤波低 43%。分段熵阈值在 10% 虚警率下可检出 47% 误差超过两个地图网格的分段，以及 94% 误差超过三个网格的分段。

Conclusion: H_t 为地图条件导航歧义提供了一个无需真值的诊断量，可用于在线评估匹配可靠性。

Abstract: Airborne magnetic anomaly navigation provides a passive, unjammable alternative to Global Navigation Satellite Systems positioning by matching magnetometer measurements against a lithospheric magnetic anomaly map. Existing map-matching algorithms either assume a Gaussian posterior (extended Kalman filter), require Monte Carlo sampling (particle filter), or discard posterior uncertainty in favour of a single optimal path (Viterbi algorithm). Here we formulate map matching as inference on a chain-structured factor graph and solve it segment by segment using the forward-backward algorithm, which yields a discrete posterior over candidate positions and its Shannon entropy $H_t$ at time $t$. Over the \texttt{Renfrew\_395} map, $10^3$ synthetic trials yield a median position error of $32.7$ m, $91\%$ below the median inertial drift of $362$ m. On these trials and $10^3$ flight paths, the median error is $43\%$ below the extended Kalman filter and particle filter. Across these paths, a threshold on segment-level entropy detects $47\%$ of segments with errors above two map cells and $94\%$ of those above three, at a $10\%$ false-alarm rate. The foregoing results indicate that $H_t$ provides a truth-free diagnostic of map-conditioned navigation ambiguity.

</details>


### [704] [Covariance Learning for Direction-of-Arrival Estimation with Sparse Linear Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38123)
*Majdoddin Esfandiari,Esa Ollila,Geert Leus,Daniel P. Palomar*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文提出基于协方差学习（CL）的网格化与无网格DOA估计器，适用于任意稀疏线阵（SLA），在联合估计噪声方差的同时优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协方差学习通过最小化阵列测量的Type-II（边缘）负对数似然来估计源功率与传感器噪声方差，但需将其扩展到任意稀疏线阵几何下的DOA估计，并兼顾网格化与无网格实现。

Method: 网格化估计器在角度网格上以连续凸近似（SCA）最小化Type-II目标，并用标量二分搜索估计噪声方差；无网格估计器随后用牛顿法在连续域上对每个网格DOA进行精化。

Result: 在六传感器嵌套阵仿真（含九个信源的欠定情形）中，所提DOA估计器在联合估计传感器噪声方差的情况下仍优于现有先进方法。

Conclusion: CL框架可统一给出适用于任意SLA的网格化与无网格DOA估计，SCA加二分搜索与牛顿精化的组合在欠定条件下仍具竞争力。

Abstract: Covariance learning (CL) estimates source powers and sensor-noise variance by minimizing the Type-II (marginal) negative log-likelihood of the array measurements. We develop both grid-based and gridless CL direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimators applicable to arbitrary sparse linear array (SLA) geometries. The grid-based DOA estimator minimizes the Type-II objective on an angular grid via successive convex approximation (SCA) and estimates the noise variance by a scalar bisection search. The gridless DOA estimator then refines each grid-based DOA over the continuum using a Newton method. Simulations on a six-sensor nested array, including an underdetermined case with nine sources, show that the proposed DOA estimators outperform state-of-the-art methods, despite jointly estimating the sensor noise variance.

</details>


### [705] [Two-Layer Microwave Linear Analog Computer (MiLAC)-Aided Multi-User MIMO Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38213)
*Xiaohua Zhou,Tianyu Fang,Matteo Nerini,Yijie Mao,Bruno Clerckx*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出双层微波线性模拟计算机（MiLAC）辅助的多用户MIMO收发架构，理论上证明其可等效实现任意全数字发射波束成形器，并给出散射矩阵与功率分配的联合优化框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究表明，单个无损互易MiLAC在发射端无法在多用户场景下达到全数字波束成形性能，需要新的架构突破这一限制。

Method: 基于多端口微波网络理论建立符合物理规律的通用模型，并在单边、完美匹配放大器假设下导出简化模型；证明双层MiLAC可等效任意全数字发射波束成形器、单层MiLAC接收机可达到与全数字线性合并器相同的可达速率；推导全数字波束成形器/合并器到MiLAC模拟实现的闭式映射，并构建和速率最大化的功率分配与散射矩阵联合优化框架。

Result: 理论分析得到验证；所提双层MiLAC设计在数值仿真中达到与全数字方案相同的和速率性能。

Conclusion: 双层MiLAC架构可在保持模拟域处理低功耗优势的同时消除单层方案的性能瓶颈，是替代全数字与混合波束成形的可行方案。

Abstract: Microwave linear analog computer (MiLAC)-aided beamforming, which performs signal processing directly in the analog domain, has recently emerged as a promising alternative to fully digital and hybrid beamforming for multi-antenna systems. However, existing studies have shown that a single lossless and reciprocal MiLAC at the transmitter cannot, in general, attain the performance of fully digital beamforming in multi-user scenarios. To overcome this limitation, we propose a two-layer MiLAC-aided transmit beamforming architecture for downlink multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) networks. Leveraging multiport microwave network theory, we first establish a general physics-compliant model of the proposed architecture, and then derive a simplified model under the assumptions of unilateral and perfectly matched amplifiers. We prove that, with lossless and reciprocal MiLACs, the two-layer MiLAC-aided transmitter can realize any fully digital transmit beamformer, while a single-layer MiLAC-aided receiver can attain the same achievable rate as a fully digital linear combiner. We then derive closed-form mappings from fully digital transmit beamformers and receive combiners to their corresponding MiLAC-aided analog implementations. Based on these equivalence results, we formulate a sum-rate maximization problem for the considered multi-user MIMO network and develop an optimization framework for jointly designing the power allocation and scattering matrices of the MiLAC-aided transceivers. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and show that the proposed two-layer MiLAC-aided design attains the same sum-rate performance as its fully digital counterpart.

</details>


### [706] [Adaptive Orbit-Aided Vector Tracking for Orbit Determination of LEO Satellites](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38380)
*Zihong Zhou,Bing Xu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出自适应轨道辅助矢量跟踪（OAVT）算法，将GNSS矢量跟踪环与低精度轨道动力学模型松耦合，用于CubeSat在单频码基接收、信号间歇及高动态条件下的可靠定轨。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LEO-PNT应用中CubeSat可靠定轨需求迫切，但星载定轨受限于单频GNSS码基接收机、信号间歇接收和高动态轨道条件，传统标量跟踪环与独立矢量跟踪在降级条件下易失锁或无法给出有效解。

Method: 以GNSS矢量跟踪环（VTL）为主导航估计器，与低精度轨道动力学模型（ODM）进行松耦合，由ODM提供辅助位置与速度伪量测；通过基于GNSS应力水平及ODM与GNSS解残差一致性的自适应协方差分配，调节ODM的贡献权重。

Result: 标称条件下OAVT保留VTL相对STL的精度优势：三维位置RMSE由STL的2.631 m降至1.081 m，三维速度RMSE由0.3985 m/s降至0.1023 m/s。降级条件下鲁棒性显著优于STL与单独VTL：完全信号中断时三维位置RMSE保持在8.27 m，渐进信号丢失与重捕时10.17 m，可见性变化时26.65 m；而STL无法给出有效解、单独VTL失锁。

Conclusion: OAVT在仅适度增加计算负担的前提下显著提升解的鲁棒性与状态连续性，适用于CubeSat定轨及未来LEO-PNT任务。

Abstract: Reliable orbit determination for CubeSats is essential for emerging low-Earth-orbit positioning, navigation, and timing (LEO-PNT) applications. However, onboard orbit determination remains constrained by single-frequency GNSS code-based receivers, intermittent signal reception, and highly dynamic orbital conditions. This paper proposes an adaptive orbit-aided vector tracking (OAVT) algorithm for LEO-PNT CubeSat orbit determination under these conditions. The method employs a GNSS vector tracking loop (VTL) as the primary navigation estimator and loosely couples it with a low-fidelity orbital dynamics model (ODM), which provides auxiliary position and velocity pseudo-measurements. The contribution of the ODM is regulated through adaptive covariance assignment based on GNSS stress and the residual consistency between the ODM and GNSS solutions. Under nominal conditions, OAVT preserves the accuracy advantage of VTL over the conventional scalar tracking loop. The 3D position root-mean-square error (RMSE) is reduced from 2.631\,m for STL to 1.081\,m, while the 3D velocity RMSE decreases from 0.3985\,m/s to 0.1023\,m/s. Under degraded conditions, OAVT provides substantially greater robustness than both STL and standalone VTL. The 3D position RMSE remains bounded at 8.27\,m during a complete signal outage, 10.17\,m during gradual signal loss and reacquisition, and 26.65\,m under variable visibility, whereas STL fails to produce valid solutions and standalone VTL loses lock. These results demonstrate that OAVT substantially improves solution robustness and state continuity with only a moderate increase in computational burden, making it suitable for CubeSat orbit determination and future LEO-PNT missions.

</details>


### [707] [Beyond Fresnel Approximation: Exact Airy Beamforming for Near-Field THz Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38395)
*Fangjie Shen,Weidong Mei,Aoran Liu,Peilan Wang,Zhi Chen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文针对太赫兹通信中视距(LoS)遮挡问题，基于精确焦距离表达式与焦散(caustic)几何提出更准确的Airy波束成形设计，联合优化弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距离与转向角，以最大化接收信号功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太赫兹通信中LoS遮挡会严重降低传统聚焦波束性能；Airy等弯曲波束可在近场沿曲线传播绕过障碍，但现有无线通信Airy波束设计多用Fresnel近似计算焦距离，在大转向角或短传播距离下不准确。

Method: 采用精确焦距离表达式与对应焦散几何构建Airy波束成形设计；以接收端对准与避障为约束，联合优化弯曲曲率、虚拟焦距离和转向角以最大化接收功率。对产生的非凸问题，先用几何预处理缩小弯曲曲率可行域，再构建两层优化框架：外层优化弯曲曲率，内层优化其余两参数。

Result: 基于级联几何-波信道模型的数值结果表明，所提方法比传统Airy波束设计获得更高的接收信号功率，并在不同遮挡比例下相较传统聚焦波束具有互补优势。

Conclusion: 精确焦距离与焦散几何建模能有效提升Airy弯曲波束在太赫兹遮挡场景下的性能，Airy波束与聚焦波束可按遮挡比例互补使用。

Abstract: Line-of-sight (LoS) blockage can severely degrade the performance of conventional focused beams in terahertz (THz) communications. Recently, bending beams (e.g., Airy beams) have attracted increasing attention due to their ability to bypass obstacles by propagating along curved trajectories under near-field propagation conditions. However, existing Airy-beam designs in wireless communications often rely on the Fresnel approximation for the focal distance, which becomes inaccurate at large steering angles or short propagation distances. To address this limitation, this letter proposes a more accurate Airy beamforming design method based on the exact focal-distance expression and the corresponding caustic geometry. Specifically, we jointly optimize the bending curvature, virtual focal distance, and steering angle to maximize the received signal power subject to receiver-alignment and obstacle-avoidance constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we first use geometric preprocessing to narrow the feasible range of the bending curvature. Then, a two-layer optimization framework is developed with the outer and inner layers optimizing the bending curvature and the other two parameters, respectively. Numerical results based on the cascaded geometrical and wave channel model demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher received signal power than conventional Airy-beam designs and offers complementary advantages over conventional focused beams under different blockage ratios.

</details>


### [708] [Movable Beyond-Diagonal RIS for ISAC: Optimal Placement and Pareto Boundary](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38483)
*Chandan Kumar Sheemar,Sourabh Solanki,Symeon Chatzinotas*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究可移动超越对角（BD）RIS 辅助的通感一体化系统，在秩一视距基站—RIS 信道下推导全连接 BD-RIS 关于用户—目标信道相关性的精确通信—感知 Pareto 边界，并给出最优放置与消除照明折中的最小轨迹孔径判据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可移动 RIS 与超越对角 RIS 各自具备空间与电路层面的自由度，但二者结合在通感一体化中如何权衡通信与感知性能、如何最优布置，尚缺乏理论刻画。

Method: 假设秩一视距 BS–RIS 信道，以用户—目标信道相关性为变量，解析推导全连接 BD-RIS 的精确通信—感知 Pareto 边界；针对视距 RIS 链路证明最大化该相关性等价于最优放置；刻画消除照明折中所需的最小轨迹孔径，并证明达到该阈值时对角 RIS 亦可取得相同最优解；阈值以下采用动态规划并给出可认证的放置精度保证。

Result: 得到全连接 BD-RIS 的闭式 Pareto 边界；给出最优放置准则；确定最小轨迹孔径阈值，并表明该阈值以上移动对角 RIS 即可达到同一最优；阈值以下动态规划可获得有精度认证的放置解；数值结果考察了硬件连接方式、角度失配与 Rician 衰落的影响。

Conclusion: 可移动 BD-RIS 在通感一体化中可通过相关性最大化放置实现性能最优，且在一定轨迹孔径条件下对角结构即可替代全连接结构，为低复杂度硬件设计提供理论依据。

Abstract: This letter investigates integrated sensing and communication using a movable beyond-diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surface (BD-RIS). Under a rank-one line-of-sight BS--RIS channel, we derive the exact communication--sensing Pareto boundary of a fully-connected BD-RIS in terms of user--target channel correlation. For line-of-sight RIS links, maximizing this correlation yields the optimal placement. We characterize the minimum track aperture that eliminates the illumination trade-off and show that a movable diagonal RIS then attains the same optimum. Below this threshold, a dynamic program offers certified placement accuracy. Numerical results examine hardware connectivity, angular mismatch, and Rician fading.

</details>


### [709] [A Parallel Two-Stage Prony Framework for Robust Delay-Doppler Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38484)
*Liangchen Sun,Yutaka Jitsumatsu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于OTFS导频波形的并行双阶（Doppler优先与delay优先）Prony估计框架，实现双选择性信道下的离网格时延-多普勒参数估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离网格（off-grid）条件下，分数时延与分数多普勒失配以及密集多径分量会导致单阶Prony估计产生模糊、分辨率不足和稳定性差的问题。

Method: 基于已知的、具有频移sinc脉冲结构的单导频OTFS波形，构建并行双阶估计框架：同时执行Prony-based多普勒优先与时延优先两种估计流程，并将两者输出的候选路径进行联合融合，利用两种估计次序的互补分辨特性。

Result: 数值结果表明，相比单阶Prony估计器，该框架提升了检测可靠性与估计稳定性，尤其在离网格场景及中低信噪比区间优势明显。

Conclusion: 双阶并行估计加候选路径融合可有效缓解离网格失配与密集多径模糊，是提升OTFS参数估计鲁棒性的有效途径。

Abstract: This paper addresses off-grid physical delay-Doppler parameter estimation based on an orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) pilot waveform over doubly selective channels. Based on a known single-pilot waveform with a frequency-shifted sinc pulse structure, we propose a parallel dual-order estimation framework, in which Prony-based Doppler-first and delay-first procedures are executed concurrently and their candidate paths are jointly fused. The two estimation orders provide complementary resolution characteristics, thereby mitigating ambiguities caused by closely spaced multipath components and fractional delay--Doppler mismatch. Numerical results show that the proposed framework improves detection reliability and estimation stability compared with a single-order Prony estimator, especially in off-grid scenarios and low-to-moderate signal-to-noise ratio regimes.

</details>


### [710] [pCoRev: Physics-Informed Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Reverberation Artifact Suppression in Ultrafast Plane-Wave Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38523)
*Hyunwoo Cho,Yeeun Kwon,Yangmo Yoo,Jinbum Kang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: pCoRev：一种物理信息驱动的无监督对比学习框架，利用组织回声与混响伪影的角度相干性差异，从单角度I/Q帧抑制超快平面波成像中的混响伪影，无需无伪影参考数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 超快平面波（PW）成像中混响伪影抑制困难：缺乏无伪影参考数据，且多径回波与组织信号相似；相干平面波复合（CPWC）仅部分抑制混响，并牺牲了PW成像所追求的高帧率。

Method: 以单角度I/Q帧为网络输入；同一CPWC采集中其余角度提供角度一致的正样本对，残差派生负样本对，并结合相干性引导的自监督，构建无监督物理信息对比学习框架，无需配对的无伪影数据。

Result: 在含31次验证采集的混响体模上，CR、CNR、gCNR分别为38.76±5.40 dB、11.75±1.81 dB、0.932±0.051，优于DAS、DMAS、监督式3D CNN及无监督深度相干学习；单角度输入下CR 32.10±7.79 dB、CNR 10.39±3.02 dB，超过75角度复合DAS（20.45±3.84 dB、8.38±2.00 dB），发射次数少75倍；在4例其他扫描仪临床采集中无需微调即较DAS提升CR 9–21 dB。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的无监督对比学习能有效抑制混响，同时保留超快PW成像的帧率优势。

Abstract: Reverberation artifact suppression in ultrafast plane-wave (PW) imaging remains challenging because artifact-free reference data are generally unavailable and multipath echoes often resemble tissue signals. Coherent plane-wave compounding (CPWC) attenuates reverberation only partially and sacrifices the frame rate that motivates PW imaging. We propose pCoRev, an unsupervised physics-informed contrastive learning framework that leverages the distinct angular coherence characteristics of tissue echoes and reverberation artifacts. A single-angle I/Q frame is the network input, and the remaining angles of the same CPWC acquisition provide angle-consistent positive pairs, residual-derived negative pairs, and coherence-guided self-supervision, so no paired artifact-free data are required. On a fabricated reverberation phantom with 31 validation acquisitions, pCoRev achieved the best contrast ratio (CR), contrast-to-noise ratio (CNR), and generalized CNR (gCNR) of 38.76 +/- 5.40 dB, 11.75 +/- 1.81 dB, and 0.932 +/- 0.051 against delay-and-sum (DAS), delay-multiply-and-sum, a supervised 3D convolutional neural network, and unsupervised deep coherence learning. Because the network is trained on single-angle inputs, it also operates on a single PW transmission: with one angle, pCoRev reached a CR of 32.10 +/- 7.79 dB and a CNR of 10.39 +/- 3.02 dB, exceeding 75-angle compounded DAS (20.45 +/- 3.84 dB and 8.38 +/- 2.00 dB) with 75-fold fewer transmissions. On four clinical acquisitions from other scanners, pCoRev improved CR over DAS by 9 to 21 dB without fine-tuning. These results indicate that physics-informed unsupervised contrastive learning suppresses reverberation effectively while preserving the frame-rate advantage of ultrafast PW imaging.

</details>


### [711] [Finite-State Uncertainty-Aware Widely-Linear Equalization for Aeronautical GMSK Links](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38638)
*Ahmad Tanha,Ali Khalesi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种有限状态、不确定性感知的widely-linear（WL）GMSK均衡算法：利用同步估计及其可靠性描述子从预计算滤波器库中选择，避免在线系数合成，并给出超量MSE的精确刻画与Lloyd型设计条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航空与无人机接收机需在同步不确定、机载算力与存储受限条件下均衡双选择性信道，需要兼顾精度与在线计算成本。

Method: 基于有限记忆Laurent模型的仿射WL滤波器，由条件物理状态矩设计；用同步估计及可靠性描述子路由至少量预存滤波器；推导相对连续边信息自适应的超量MSE精确表达、有限状态设计的Lloyd型条件、局部时频失配证书，以及设计损失与信息损失的正交分解。

Result: 参考信道Eb/N0=8 dB、高同步不确定下，16状态库较点估计WL时变MMSE均衡降低伪符号MSE 51.9%，较后验均值替换降低6.6%；相同分区/路由/存储下，条件矩滤波器较代表状态滤波器MSE降10.1%、ABER降15.6%；18条三径合成信道上MSE降5.3%、ABER降12.9%；16状态接收机仅存储2048个实系数。

Conclusion: 有限状态WL均衡以极小存储与在线开销显著提升同步不确定下的均衡精度，并通过后验积分、鲁棒性扫描与软件计时量化了精度—计算—滤波器库刷新间的权衡。

Abstract: Aeronautical and unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) receivers must equalize doubly selective channels under synchronization uncertainty and limited onboard computation and memory. We propose a finite-state, uncertainty-aware widely-linear (WL) equalization algorithm for Gaussian minimum-shift keying (GMSK) links. The algorithm uses synchronization estimates and their reliability descriptors to select one of a small number of precomputed filters, avoiding repeated online coefficient synthesis. Using a finite-memory Laurent model, we design the stored affine WL filters from conditional physical-state moments. We derive an exact characterization of excess mean-square error (MSE) relative to adaptation to continuous side information, Lloyd-type conditions for finite-state design, local timing--frequency mismatch certificates, and an orthogonal decomposition of design and information losses. On a reference channel at $E_b/N_0=8$~dB under high synchronization-estimation uncertainty, a $16$-state bank reduces pseudo-symbol MSE by $51.9\%$ relative to point-estimate WL time-varying MMSE equalization and by $6.6\%$ relative to posterior-mean (PM) substitution. With identical partitioning, routing, and storage, conditional-moment filters reduce MSE by $10.1\%$ and full-waveform average bit error rate (ABER) by $15.6\%$ relative to representative-state filters. Across $18$ synthetic three-path channels with individually fitted banks, MSE and ABER decrease by $5.3\%$ and $12.9\%$, respectively, relative to PM substitution. The $16$-state receiver stores $2048$ real coefficients. Posterior integration, robustness sweeps, and software timing measurements quantify the tradeoff between equalization accuracy, online computational cost, and bank refresh.

</details>


### [712] [Channel State Information-Free Angle Spoofing for Differential Localization Privacy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38756)
*Lei Lyu,Urbashi Mitra*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种无需CSI的角度欺骗策略，即使窃听者使用差分统计估计发射机位置也有效，可使Eve定位偏差渐近趋于无穷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置欺骗多依赖CSI，且窃听者若采用差分统计（ADoD差）估计角度，欺骗效果可能失效，需要一种对差分统计也鲁棒的CSI-free角度欺骗方案。

Method: 设计预编码矩阵，使Eve对离开角差（ADoDs）的估计产生错误，从而误导其位置估计；合法用户Bob借助少量安全共享的边信息仍能恢复Alice真实位置。论文在伪造几何下基于Eve估计的信道参数，理论分析其定位偏差，并给出预编码关键参数下偏差的渐近行为。

Result: 理论分析表明Eve的定位偏差可随预编码关键参数渐近趋于无穷；仿真显示该方法对Eve引入显著定位误差，且与已有CSI-free欺骗策略组合时Eve性能进一步恶化。

Conclusion: 所提CSI-free角度欺骗策略在Eve采用差分统计时仍有效，可显著且可控地放大其定位偏差，并与现有方法互补叠加。

Abstract: This paper proposes a channel state information (CSI)-free angle spoofing strategy that remains effective even when the eavesdropper (Eve) uses differential statistics to estimate the location of the transmitter (Alice). Specifically, by designing a precoding matrix, Eve incorrectly estimates the angle differences of departure (ADoDs), thereby spoofing Alice's location. Meanwhile, the trusted user (Bob) can still infer Alice's true location with a modest amount of securely shared side information. Given the channel parameters estimated by Eve from the spoofed channel, the resulting localization bias introduced to the eavesdroppers under the spoofed geometric is analyzed. Eve's bias can be driven to infinity asymptotically in a key parameter of the precoder. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed method introduces significant localization errors for Eve. When combined with a prior CSI-free spoofing strategy, further degraded performance is achieved by Eve.

</details>


### [713] [A Sub-Aperture-Based Ray-Tracing Framework for Near-Field U-MIMO THz Communications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38772)
*Federico Ruggeri,Sotiris Droulias,Jiming Chen,Angeliki Alexiou,Jie Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出将射线追踪(RT)扩展到近场(NF)体制的框架：把发射阵列建模为孔径，分割为发射远场贡献的子孔径并借助几何光学(GO)传播，开发Ray-Launching算法，验证其可复现近场U-MIMO THz的波束操控效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: THz通信具有大孔径天线与扩展近场区域，为超大规模MIMO(U-MIMO)的自适应波束操控提供机会；但全波方法计算代价高，而传统基于射线的RT方法通常建立在远场假设下，无法刻画近场波束行为，因此需要将RT拓展至近场体制。

Method: 将发射阵列建模为天线孔径，按可调规则将该孔径划分为若干子孔径，每个子孔径发射远场(FF)贡献，并利用几何光学(GO)传播这些贡献，从而构建近场RT框架；在此基础上开发相应的Ray-Launching算法，并以全波传播结果为基准评估其波束重构精度。

Result: 与全波传播对比表明，通过可调的孔径划分，所提方法能够利用GO射线传播复现近场U-MIMO THz通信中典型的波束操控效应，并具备可控的波束重构精度。

Conclusion: 该工作证明基于子孔径划分与GO传播的RT方法可作为全波仿真的有效替代，用于近场发射阵列的射线级表征与波束操控分析，孔径划分粒度是可调精度—复杂度折中参数。

Abstract: Terahertz (THz) communications are characterized by antennas with large apertures and extended near-field (NF) region, offering the opportunity to develop adaptable beam manipulation strategies, particularly related to ultra-massive MIMO (U-MIMO). While Ray-Tracing (RT) offers an attractive alternative to full-wave methods, conventional ray-based approaches are generally formulated under far-field (FF) assumptions. We propose a technique that extends RT to the NF regime, enabling ray-based NF characterization of transmitting arrays. We model the transmitting array as an antenna aperture and develop a RT framework that partitions the transmitting aperture into sub-apertures emitting FF contributions which can be propagated via geometric optics (GO). We develop a Ray-Launching algorithm based on the proposed framework and assess its beam-reconstruction accuracy against full-wave propagation. The results demonstrate that, through tunable aperture partitioning, the proposed approach can reproduce beam manipulation effects characteristic of NF U-MIMO THz communications using GO ray propagation.

</details>


### [714] [Joint Antenna Position and Beamforming Optimization for Movable Antenna Enabled Near-Field ISAC Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38794)
*Luis Ebner,Alireza Navi,Mohamed-Amine Lahmeri,Sebastian Lotter,Lutz Lampe,Robert Schober*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文研究可移动天线使能的近场通信感知一体化系统，通过联合优化收发天线位置与发射波束赋形，最小化二维点扩散函数的积分旁瓣电平与峰值旁瓣电平加权和，在满足通信速率等约束下显著抑制旁瓣并提升成像分辨能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近场ISAC可同时实现二维雷达成像与多用户下行通信，但固定位置天线阵列的点扩散函数(PSF)存在高旁瓣，导致成像性能下降并产生鬼影目标伪影；而可移动天线(MAs)能在不增加阵元数的前提下提供额外空间自由度以抑制旁瓣。

Method: 构建以二维PSF的积分旁瓣电平(ISL)与峰值旁瓣电平(PSL)加权和为目标、受通信速率、照射功率、发射功率及天线位置约束的联合优化问题，联合优化收发天线位置与发射波束赋形；针对非凸问题，提出结合粒子群优化与遗传算法的混合交替优化(AO)框架求解。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提方案在所考察的阵列构型中取得最低ISL，相比基准方案PSL至少降低5 dB；优化后的阵列可分辨反射率相差6 dB的两个紧密相邻目标，性能优于随机阵列、Mills Cross阵列与矩形阵列，同时满足最小用户吞吐量要求。

Conclusion: 可移动天线为近场ISAC提供有效的空间自由度，通过天线位置与波束赋形的联合优化可在满足通信需求的同时显著抑制二维成像旁瓣、提升多目标分辨能力，验证了MA赋能近场ISAC的可行性与优越性。

Abstract: Near-field (NF) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems enable simultaneous two-dimensional (2D) radar imaging and multi-user downlink communication. However, fixed-position antenna arrays can exhibit high sidelobes in the point spread function (PSF), which degrade imaging performance and cause ghost-target artifacts. Movable antennas (MAs) offer additional spatial degrees of freedom to suppress these sidelobes while meeting communication requirements, without increasing the number of antenna elements. In this paper, we investigate MA-enabled NF ISAC by jointly optimizing the transmit and receive antenna positions and the transmit beamforming to minimize a weighted sum of the integrated sidelobe level (ISL) and peak sidelobe level (PSL) of the 2D PSF, subject to communication-rate, illumination-power, transmit-power, and antenna-placement constraints. To tackle the resulting non-convex problem, we propose a hybrid alternating optimization (AO) framework that combines particle swarm optimization with a genetic algorithm. Our numerical results demonstrate that the proposed scheme achieves the lowest ISL among the considered array configurations and reduces the PSL by at least 5 dB compared with the benchmarks. The optimized array is further shown to resolve two closely spaced targets whose reflectivities differ by 6dB, outperforming random, Mills Cross, and rectangular arrays while satisfying the imposed minimum user-throughput requirements.

</details>


### [715] [Semantic-Assisted Joint Channel Estimation and Symbol Detection for MU-MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38855)
*Hao Chang,Chentao Yue,Haiyao Yu,Yonghui Li,Branka Vucetic,Wibowo Hardjawana*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种语义辅助的联合信道估计与符号检测（Sem-JCED）接收机框架，将LMMSE信道估计、EP符号检测与基于ByT5字节级语言模型的语义纠正器闭环集成，用于MU-MIMO文本传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在MU-MIMO文本传输中，传统联合信道估计与符号检测（JCED）未利用文本语义冗余，性能受限；作者希望借助语义先验提升低信噪比下的检测与估计精度。

Method: Sem-JCED由三部分组成：LMMSE信道估计器、EP符号检测器、基于ByT5字节级语言模型的语义纠正器。外层迭代中，LMMSE利用已知导频与数据符号反馈估计信道，EP检测数据符号；ByT5将数据符号概率映射为字节概率，分别向LMMSE提供软符号统计量、向EP提供语义先验，用于下一轮迭代。

Result: 四用户、四接收天线场景下，达到BER=1×10⁻²所需SNR比传统JCED低约7 dB；在仿真SNR范围内优于具有完美信道信息的最大似然检测。

Conclusion: 语义信息可有效闭环反馈至信道估计与符号检测，显著改善MU-MIMO文本传输的可靠性，并展现超越理想信道ML检测的潜力。

Abstract: This paper presents a semantic-assisted joint channel estimation and symbol detection (Sem-JCED) receiver framework for text transmission in multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) systems. Sem-JCED integrates a linear minimum mean-square error (LMMSE) channel estimator, an expectation propagation (EP) symbol detector, and a semantic corrector based on ByT5, a byte-level language model. At each outer iteration, LMMSE estimates the channel from known pilots and data symbol feedback, and EP detects the data symbols. ByT5 then maps the data symbol probabilities to byte probabilities, which provide soft symbol statistics and semantic priors for feedback to LMMSE and EP, respectively, in the next iteration. Simulation results show that Sem-JCED requires about 7~dB lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) than conventional JCED to reach a bit error rate (BER) of $1\times10^{-2}$ with four users and four receive antennas, and outperforms maximum-likelihood detection with perfect channel knowledge over the simulated SNR range.

</details>


### [716] [xCHEM: SDR-Based Multi-Link Channel Emulator for Real-Time Hardware-in-the-Loop Digital-Twin](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38868)
*Ali Saeizadeh,Gabriele Gemmi,Tamerlan Aghayev,Michele Polese,Pedram Johari,Tommaso Melodia*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出xCHEM，一种基于单块NI USRP X4xx SDR的射频信道模拟器，可在物理电台之间插入可编程信道，支持外部信道模型向FPGA流式传输冲激响应而无需修改固件或中断信号处理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在物理无线电之间构建可编程、可实时重构的射频信道，以支持需要动态信道模型（延迟、衰减、多径、多普勒）的无线实验，同时避免固件重编译与信号处理中断带来的开销。

Method: 采用单块USRP X4xx的流式数据通路，在四个射频接口上实现六个独立可配置的方向性信道；每信道使用稀疏FIR滤波器，以存储器实现的延迟将延迟跨度与乘法器资源解耦；实/复变体分别支持32和16个非零抽头，最大延迟16666.62 ns、分辨率4.069 ns；通过系数缩放与算术右移控制衰减；FPGA系数引擎生成多普勒频移。

Result: 硬件实测延迟均方根误差9.5 ps（全跨度）、衰减误差0.11 dB；多径延迟恢复误差在一个采样内；多普勒频移±1 Hz至±1 MHz，载波偏置校准后相对量化命令的平均频率误差低于0.032 Hz；200 Hz时相比1 kHz主机更新，近载波杂散降低53.3 dB。

Conclusion: xCHEM以单台SDR实现了高精度、可重构、低杂散的射频信道模拟，验证了存储器型延迟结构与FPGA系数引擎在延迟、衰减、多径与多普勒等方面的有效性。

Abstract: This paper presents xCHEM, a radio-frequency channel emulator that inserts programmable channels between physical radios using a single NI USRP X4xx software-defined radio. External channel models stream impulse responses to its field-programmable gate array without firmware changes or interruption of signal processing. A streaming datapath implements six independently configurable directional channels across four radio interfaces. Each channel uses a sparse finite impulse response filter whose memory-backed delays decouple delay span from multiplier resources. The real and complex variants support 32 and 16 nonzero taps, respectively, with a maximum delay of 16666.62 ns and 4.069 ns resolution. Coefficient scaling and arithmetic right shifts control attenuation. Hardware measurements show root-mean-square errors of 9.5 ps in delay over the full span and 0.11 dB in attenuation. Multipath delays are recovered within one sample. An FPGA coefficient engine produces tested Doppler shifts from +/-1 Hz to +/-1 MHz with mean frequency errors below 0.032 Hz relative to quantized commands after carrier-offset calibration; at 200 Hz, it reduces the measured near-carrier spur by 53.3 dB compared with 1 kHz host updates.

</details>


### [717] [Learning Latent Fields in Multiobject Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38898)
*Shaoxiu Wei,Bhaskar Rao,Florian Meyer*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种贝叶斯多目标跟踪框架，直接将物体状态与原始复数信号通过基于物理的叠加强度模型关联，用条件归一化流对潜在信号功率场建模并在运行时无标签训练，在无线电与声学实验中优于基于检测的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在预处理阶段将复数信号压缩为检测或强度图，丢弃了关于物体与传播环境的潜在相关信息。作者希望绕过这一压缩，直接从原始复数信号进行多目标跟踪。

Method: 构建贝叶斯多目标跟踪框架：以物理阵列流形（如雷达导向矢量或匹配场处理的replica vectors）结合潜在场，将物体状态映射到原始复数信号；潜在场为一族上下文相关的信号功率分布，刻画物体与传播环境效应并在物体与时间间共享；用条件归一化流参数化，运行时通过最大化由贝叶斯模型推导的ELBO进行无标签训练，实现学习与推断的序贯耦合。

Result: 在仿真以及真实无线电和声学实验中验证，空间尺度从米级到公里级；结果表明该方法优于基于检测的方法。

Conclusion: 将物理阵列流形与可学习的潜在功率场结合的贝叶斯叠加强度模型，可在不使用标注数据的情况下直接从原始复数信号进行多目标跟踪，并在多场景多尺度下超越检测式方法。

Abstract: Multiobject tracking using measurements from ar- rays of wireless sensors is a key task in applications ranging from autonomous navigation to public safety. Many existing methods compress raw complex-valued signals into detections or intensity maps during preprocessing, thereby discarding poten- tially relevant information about the objects and the propagation environment. We propose a Bayesian framework for multiobject tracking that relates object states to raw complex-valued signals via a physics-based superpositional model. The model combines a physics-based array manifold, such as radar steering vectors or the replica vectors of matched-field processing, with a latent field. This latent field is a family of context-dependent signal- power distributions that captures the effects of the objects and the propagation environment and is shared across objects and time. It is parameterized by a conditional normalizing flow, which is trained during runtime without labeled data by maximizing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) derived from the Bayesian model. Learning and inference are thus coupled in a sequential framework. We evaluate the method in simulation and in real-world radio and acoustic experiments, with spatial scales ranging from meters to kilometers, and show that it outperforms detection-based methods.

</details>


### [718] [Waveform Bandwidth and Frequency Diversity in FDA-MIMO Range-Angle Estimation: A CRLB Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39011)
*Guoqing Xia,Qu Luo,Yu Liu,Pei Xiao,Cicek Cavdar,Emil Björnson*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文建立带宽感知的CRLB框架，刻画波形RMS带宽与FDA频率分集对FDA-MIMO雷达距离-角度联合估计的共同影响，并给出闭式近似与三因子耦合分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDA-MIMO雷达同时通过阵元载频偏置引入距离相关相位分集和通过发射波形延迟携带距离信息，但两种机制如何共同决定距离-角度估计精度缺乏定量刻画。

Method: 基于保留波形延迟与FDA频偏的Nyquist采样观测模型，将未知准静态复散射系数作为冗余参数消去后推导等效Fisher信息矩阵（EFIM），进而得到闭式CRLB近似，并对归一化互信息的平方作三因子分解以分析距离-角度耦合。

Result: 波形RMS带宽与FDA频率分集独立增大均降低距离CRLB；在固定非零波形带宽下，FDA频率分集使角度CRLB增大，而波形RMS带宽使其减小；在固定总频谱预算下，距离CRLB随FDA频谱分配比例呈内部极大值，角度CRLB单调递增。数值结果验证了闭式近似与趋势预测。

Conclusion: 波形带宽与FDA频率分集在距离-角度估计中的作用不对称且存在频谱分配权衡，所提CRLB框架可为FDA-MIMO雷达波形与频偏设计提供定量依据。

Abstract: Frequency-diverse array multiple-input multiple-output (FDA-MIMO) radar introduces range-dependent phase diversity through element-dependent carrier-frequency offsets, in addition to the delay information carried by transmitted waveforms. This paper develops a bandwidth-aware Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) framework to characterize how these two mechanisms jointly affect range-angle estimation. Starting from a Nyquist-rate sampled observation model that retains waveform delays and FDA frequency offsets, we derive an equivalent Fisher information matrix (EFIM) after eliminating an unknown quasi-static complex scattering coefficient as a nuisance parameter. We derive closed-form CRLB approximations that reveal the interplay between waveform root-mean-square (RMS) bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity. A three-factor decomposition of the squared normalized cross-information further characterizes range-angle coupling. Results show that when increased independently, both waveform RMS bandwidth and FDA frequency diversity reduce the range CRLB, but FDA frequency diversity increases the angle CRLB at fixed nonzero waveform bandwidth, whereas waveform RMS bandwidth reduces it. Additionally, under a fixed aggregate spectral budget, the range CRLB exhibits an interior maximum, whereas the angle CRLB increases monotonically with the FDA spectral-allocation fraction. Numerical results corroborate the closed-form approximations and the predicted trends.

</details>


### [719] [Stability-Performance Trade-off in Maritime Integrated Sensing, Communication, and Computation: A Lyapunov-Guided Dual-Timescale Hierarchical RL Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39082)
*Ruoguang Li,Yu Wang,Bingxin Tian,Benedetta Picano,Yingyang Chen,Xiaomin Chen,Li Wang,Guangjie Han,Zhu Han*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 面向海洋环境的UAV-USV协同通感算一体化(ISCC)系统，引入海杂波与浪致横摇建模，建立两端数据排队模型，以长期平均能耗最小化为目标联合优化关联、轨迹、波束成形、时间分配、卸载比与算力分配，提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层SAC(LTH-SAC)框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海上智能服务需求增长使UAV-USV协同与无线ISCC成为关键，但海洋环境难以直接套用陆基ISCC模型，且感知、通信、计算争夺同一时空资源，在资源受限的海洋场景中性能折衷尤为严重。

Method: 构建多UAV海面目标探测并向USV部分卸载数据的ISCC系统；在感知模型中引入海杂波、在通信模型中引入浪致USV横摇；在UAV与USV两侧建立数据排队模型以刻画感知数据生成、无线卸载与计算执行的动态耦合；以长期平均系统能耗最小为目标联合优化UAV-目标关联、UAV轨迹、波束成形、时间分配、卸载比例与计算资源分配；利用决策在更新频率与时间敏感性上的差异，提出Lyapunov引导的双时间尺度分层软演员-评论家(LTH-SAC)框架，将长期问题转化为一系列队列感知的在线子问题并实现跨时间尺度协调。

Result: 仿真结果验证了所提框架的有效性，并表明其能够在感知、通信与计算之间平衡稳定性—性能折衷。

Conclusion: 面向海洋ISCC场景，通过环境特异性建模与排队耦合刻画，结合Lyapunov优化与双时间尺度分层强化学习，可有效降低长期能耗并协调通感算资源竞争。

Abstract: Driven by the ever-growing demand for intelligent maritime services, cooperative unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) and unmanned surface vehicle (USV) operations, together with wireless integrated sensing, communication, and computation (ISCC), have become pivotal in maritime environments. However, the distinctive maritime environment precludes a direct application of terrestrial ISCC models, while sensing, communication, and computation compete for the same spatio-temporal resources, thus yielding inherent performance trade-offs that become particularly severe in resource-constrained ocean scenarios. To address these issues, we investigate an ISCC system in which multiple UAVs detect targets at the sea surface and partially offload the collected data to a USV for cooperative processing. Characterizing the maritime-specific environment impairments, we incorporate sea clutter and wave-induced USV roll motion into the sensing and communication models, respectively. Moreover, we introduce data queueing models at both the UAVs and the USV to capture the dynamic coupling among sensing-data generation, wireless offloading, and computation execution. The optimization objective is to minimize the long-term average system energy consumption by jointly optimizing UAV-target association, UAV trajectories, beamforming, time allocation, offloading ratios, and computation resource allocation. Given that these decisions differ in update frequency and time sensitivity, we propose a Lyapunov-guided dual-timescale hierarchical soft actor-critic (LTH-SAC) framework, which transforms the long-term problem into a sequence of queue-aware online subproblems and coordinates optimization across the two timescales. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed framework and demonstrate its capability to balance the stability-performance trade-off among sensing, communication, and computation.

</details>


### [720] [Sensing Fast and Distant Targets in Overspread Channels with Zak-OTFS and Modular Arithmetic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39110)
*Andrea Novero,Mudasir Ahmad Sheikh,Danish Nisar,Saif Khan Mohammed,Michele Zorzi,Robert Calderbank*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出在同带宽、同帧长上叠加两帧不同周期 Zak-OTFS 的 DD 帧设计，利用模运算配对解卷绕并给出歧义条件，配合 DS / DS-XC 接收机实现超扩展信道的无歧义雷达感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单 DD 帧感知仅在扩展因子（时延扩展×多普勒扩展）小于 1 时无歧义；无人机、飞机、LEO 卫星、水声等长距离高速场景违反该结晶条件，单帧会产生时延或多普勒混叠。已有方法在常规 DD 帧上附加时频导频，只能在一维解歧义。

Method: 设计由多个具有不同时延/多普勒周期的 DD 基构成的帧，在同一带宽与帧尺寸下共同覆盖超扩展信道；针对两帧情形，对卷绕峰值位置做模运算，通过共同投影与增益进行峰值配对以唯一恢复目标，并推导配对歧义的成立条件。实现上采用两个叠加的 Zak-OTFS 帧，提出两种接收机：双帧感知（DS）直接联合检测；DS-XC 额外做交叉导频干扰消除、联合最小二乘增益重估并剔除鬼影目标。

Result: 随扩展因子增大，两种接收机检测率均接近 1；DS-XC 取得最低虚警率与最低信道 NMSE。100 km 无人机场景中 DS-XC 检出 98% 目标，最优基线为 81%；固定目标数下复杂度随时间带宽积近似线性增长。

Conclusion: 通过多周期 DD 基叠加的两帧设计可突破单帧结晶条件限制，实现超扩展信道下的二维无歧义感知；交叉导频消除与联合增益重估对抑制鬼影、降低虚警与提升信道估计精度起关键作用。

Abstract: Delay-Doppler (DD) modulations, such as Zak-transform-based orthogonal time frequency space (Zak-OTFS) modulation, represent the channel as a sparse set of delay and Doppler shifts, which makes them well suited for radar sensing. Sensing with a single DD frame, however, is unambiguous only when the channel spread factor, i.e., the product of the delay and Doppler spreads, is below one. Long-range mobility scenarios, including drones, airplanes, low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites, and underwater acoustic links, typically violate this crystallization condition, so that a single frame aliases the target delays, Doppler shifts, or both. Existing methods add a time-frequency pilot to a conventional DD frame and resolve the aliasing in only one dimension. We propose a frame design that combines multiple DD bases with different delay and Doppler periods, which together cover an overspread channel, on the same bandwidth and frame size. For two frames, we show that modular arithmetic on the wrapped peak positions uniquely recovers each target by pairing the peaks through their common projection and their gains, and we derive the condition under which this pairing is ambiguous. We implement the design with two superimposed Zak-OTFS frames and propose two receivers: dual-frame sensing (DS), which performs the joint detection directly, and DS with cross-pilot cancellation (DS-XC), which additionally cancels the cross-pilot interference, re-estimates the gains by joint least squares, and removes ghost targets. Both receivers keep a detection rate close to one as the spread factor grows, and DS-XC also achieves the lowest false-alarm rate and channel normalized mean squared error (NMSE). In a 100 km drone scenario, DS-XC detects 98% of the targets, compared with 81% for the best baseline, with a complexity that grows near-linearly with the time-bandwidth product for a fixed number of targets.

</details>


### [721] [Turning Multipath into Positioning Information: Persistent Electromagnetic-Twin DoA Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39111)
*Tuo Wu,Zhentian Zhang,Ye Tian,Hing Cheung So*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种"电磁孪生(ET)"到达角定位方法：用名义平面图提供虚拟路径几何，用稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向校正场，并以RLS在线更新；在50%视距遮挡、1.5°测角误差下RMSE达0.39 m，优于名义几何的0.55 m。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反射路径可在视距(LoS)被遮挡时支持定位，但其效果取决于存储模型对反射方向的预测精度。论文旨在通过持续、物理标定的路径角场提升反射路径方向建模的准确性，从而改善非视距条件下的DoA定位性能。

Method: 1) 以名义平面图生成虚拟路径几何；2) 用已知位置的稀疏参考探针学习紧凑的方向角校正，场阶数与正则化仅由标定数据选择；3) 对用户的无序DoA进行联合位置估计与一对一路径关联，采用关联感知的多起点搜索与鲁棒Gauss–Newton精化；4) 可信探针触发RLS递归更新校正场，无需重处理历史测量；5) 理论分析给出标定秩条件、目标下降性与反射路径的条件信息增益，并区分初始化偏差衰减与定位误差收敛。

Result: 每个工作点500次查询的合成实验：50% LoS遮挡且DoA误差1.5°时，标定后ET的RMSE为0.39 m，名义几何为0.55 m；墙体变化后最终误差0.43 m，冻结标定图为0.63 m。等证据对比显示其他标定方案具竞争力，且滑动窗口更新比配置的RLS在突变下恢复更快。

Conclusion: 结果支持"可复用的方向标定"这一结论，而非某种普遍最优的地图或更新规则；验证仅限于含可信标定标签的合成一阶反射场景。

Abstract: Reflected paths can support localization when line-of-sight (LoS) links are blocked, but their usefulness depends on how accurately the stored model predicts their directions. This paper develops electromagnetic-twin (ET) direction-of-arrival (DoA) localization with a persistent, physically calibrated path-angle field. A nominal floor plan supplies virtual-path geometry, and sparse reference probes at known positions learn a compact directional correction. Field order and regularization are selected from calibration data alone. For each user, unordered DoAs are processed by joint position estimation and one-to-one path association, using assignment-aware multistart search and robust Gauss--Newton refinement. New trusted probes update the stored correction through recursive least squares (RLS), without reprocessing all previous measurements. The analysis establishes calibration rank conditions, objective descent, and conditional information gains from reflected paths, while also distinguishing the decay of initialization bias from the convergence of localization error. Synthetic experiments use 500 queries per operating point. At 50% LoS blockage and $1.5^\circ$ DoA error, the calibrated ET achieves 0.39 m root-mean-square error, versus 0.55 m for nominal geometry. After a wall change, its final error is 0.43 m, versus 0.63 m for a frozen calibrated map. Equal-evidence comparisons show competitive calibrated alternatives and faster abrupt-change recovery with sliding-window updates than with the configured RLS. The results support reusable directional calibration, not a universally superior map or update rule, and validation is limited to synthetic first-order reflections with trusted calibration labels.

</details>


### [722] [An Efficient SIM Beamforming Scheme Based on Physical-Empowered Projected Gradient](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39219)
*Yuzhi Yang,Hao Liu,Tianhao Guo,Jiancheng An,Lu Gan,Chau Yuen,Mérouane Debbah*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 利用TDD信道互易性在空口实现梯度反传，提出物理投影梯度下降(P2GD)框架，在无需显式估计SIM-UE信道的条件下完成波束赋形优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SIM元件无信号处理能力，信道只能间接估计，困难且开销大；信道估计后的预编码优化又是非凸问题，同样难以求解。

Method: 借助TDD互易性以over-the-air方式计算梯度反传，构建梯度优化框架；提出P2GD，在最大化可达和速率的同时引入ZF约束，并据此衍生UE-P2GD与BS-P2GD两种变体；给出收敛性分析与投影梯度技术以保证物理可行性。

Result: 仿真表明，所提方法在少量空口迭代内即可获得多用户系统的次优波束赋形，且每方向信令开销低于显式估计SIM-UE信道的导频成本。

Conclusion: 为SIM系统提供了一种低开销、免显式SIM-UE信道估计的波束赋形方案。

Abstract: Stacked Intelligent Metasurfaces (SIMs) have emerged as a promising technology for next-generation wireless systems. Especially in multi-input multi-output (MIMO) systems, it has the potential to realize complicated wave-domain transformations with low hardware costs and energy consumption. However, SIM-assisted MIMO systems face two major challenges in channel estimation and beamforming. As the SIM elements do not have the signal processing capability, channel estimation can only be conducted in an indirect manner, which makes it challenging. Moreover, the precoding optimization after channel estimation is non-convex and also difficult. Targeting these issues, we exploit the time-division duplex (TDD) channel reciprocity to calculate the gradient backpropagation in an over-the-air manner. Based on this structure, we propose a gradient-based optimization framework that optimizes beamforming without explicitly estimating the SIM--UE channel. The proposed method, namely the physical projected gradient descent (P2GD) method, optimizes the achievable sum rate while incorporating zero-forcing (ZF) constraints. Based on the method of incorporating the ZF restriction, we propose two variations of P2GD, namely user equipment (UE)-P2GD and base station (BS)-P2GD. We also provide a theoretical convergence analysis and projected gradient techniques to ensure physical feasibility. Simulation results show that the proposed approach can achieve suboptimal beamforming in the multi-user system within a small number of over-the-air iterations, using a per-direction signaling budget below the pilot cost of explicit SIM--UE channel estimation. The proposed method provides a low-overhead beamforming scheme for SIM systems without explicit SIM--UE channel estimation.

</details>


### [723] [Anchor-Free Range-Free 3D IoT Localization in Buried Environments with Connectivity-Informed Power Selection and Temporal Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39294)
*Peyman Moeini,Mark Coates*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出3D-PT-PS与3D-PT-PST两种无锚点、无测距的IoT标签定位方法，利用发射功率选择与装载时间弱线索，在矿堆掩埋场景中实现高精度三维定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 井下与露天矿中，随矿石/废石装载掩埋的无线IoT标签可用于物料与品位追踪，但掩埋后常规测距与测量型定位基础设施往往不可用，需要无需锚点、无需RSSI与测距的三维定位方案。

Method: 在3D-PT基础上引入两种扩展：3D-PT-PS从二值导频测量中选择信息量高的发射功率电平；3D-PT-PST进一步将记录的装载沉积时刻作为弱非度量线索进行时间细化。两者均无锚点、无测距，不需RSSI、实测距离、测量锚点、堆体尺寸或材料参数；通过蒙特卡洛仿真考察不同堆体规模与标签密度。

Result: 在5000吨破碎机料仓、125个标签场景下，3D-PT-PST取得6.12%平均NRMSE与2.20 m三维RMSE，相比3D-PT-PS降低平均NRMSE 13.5%，相比标定后的MDS-MAP(P)与CATL分别降低43.6%与69.1%。

Conclusion: 结果表明连通性信息与时间信息具有互补性，二者结合可在缺乏测距与锚点基础设施的矿堆场景中实现有效三维定位。
