Abstract: In underground and surface mines, wireless Internet-of- Things (IoT) tags deployed with ore or muck loads can support material and grade tracking after burial, when conventional ranging and surveyed localization infrastructure may be unavailable. Building on the three-dimensional Pro- traction Technique (3D-PT), this paper introduces 3D-PT with Power Selection (3D-PT-PS), which selects informative transmit-power levels from binary pilot measurements, and 3D-PT-PS with Temporal Refinement (3D-PT-PST), which incorporates recorded load-deposition times as weak, non- metric cues. Both methods are anchor-free and range-free and require no RSSI, measured ranges, surveyed anchors, pile dimensions, or material parameters. Monte Carlo simulations evaluate different pile sizes and tag densities. In a 5000-t crusher-pocket scenario with 125 tags, 3D-PT-PST achieves 6.12% mean NRMSE and 2.20 m 3D RMSE, reducing mean NRMSE by 13.5% relative to 3D-PT-PS and by 43.6% and 69.1% relative to calibrated MDS-MAP(P) and CATL, respectively. These results show that connectivity and timing provide complementary information.

</details>


### [724] [Evaluating Generalization and Long-Term Stability of Smartwatch-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39394)
*Hongda Huang,Xiao Peng,Xiaoyu Li,Shuailong Tang,Guangpu Zhu,Xiajiao Yang,Hongwei Li,Yelei Li,Yali Zheng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出轻量级信号-上下文门控融合网络SCGBPNet，用于智能手表PPG无袖带血压估计，并系统评估其跨数据集泛化与长期稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能手表无袖带血压监测是长期心血管管理的低负担方案，但实际部署受限于模型复杂度高、跨数据集泛化不确定、长期跟踪稳定性证据不足。

Method: 构建SCGBPNet：以自注意力整合信号级表征，并通过紧凑门控融合模块引入受试者特定的上下文信息；在Aurora-BP公开集与私有智能手表数据集上开展数据集内验证、跨数据集迁移及一个多月随访的长期稳定性评估。

Result: Aurora-BP上SBP/DBP的MAE为7.08/4.90 mmHg，私有手表数据集数据集内为6.44/4.89 mmHg，差异较小；Aurora-BP迁移至手表数据集后MAE升至8.98/6.47 mmHg，跨数据集退化明显；长期随访中周间波动小、日衰减率低，稳定性良好；但当血压显著偏离个体基线时精度下降。

Conclusion: 良好的总体MAE不能等同于可部署性能，需在数据集设置、血压区间与基线偏离水平等维度开展系统化分层评估，以判断智能手表无袖带血压监测的实际可靠性。

Abstract: Smartwatch-based cuffless blood pressure (BP) monitoring is a promising low-burden solution for long-term cardiovascular management, but practical deployment remains constrained by model complexity, uncertain cross-dataset generalization, and insufficient evidence on long-term tracking stability. This study presents an efficient Signal-Context Gated Fusion Network (SCGBPNet) for cuffless BP estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) signals. SCGBPNet integrates signal-level representations through self-attention and further incorporates subject-specific contextual information via a compact gated fusion module. On Aurora-BP, SCGBPNet achieved SBP/DBP mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.08/4.90 mmHg, compared with 6.44/4.89 mmHg under within-dataset validation on the private smartwatch dataset, indicating a modest within-dataset discrepancy. Cross-dataset transfer from Aurora-BP to the smartwatch dataset increased the MAEs to 8.98/6.47 mmHg, demonstrating substantial cross-dataset degradation. For long-term stability, the proposed method showed low week-to-week performance variation and a low daily decay rate, indicating good stability over a follow-up period of more than one month. Nevertheless, estimation accuracy deteriorated when BP deviated substantially from an individual's baseline. These findings indicate that favorable aggregate MAE alone should not be interpreted as evidence of deployment-ready performance. More systematic and stratified evaluation across dataset settings, BP ranges, and baseline-deviation levels is needed to assess the practical reliability of smartwatch-based cuffless BP monitoring.

</details>


### [725] [On the Performance of AoA-Based Physical-Layer Authentication Under Multi-Source Impersonation Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39397)
*Jeongbin Kim,Moonsik Min,Yo-Seb Jeon*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文刻画了针对基于到达角(AoA)认证的协同冒充攻击，给出攻击源最优预编码与可完美复现合法空间签名的充要条件，并揭示角域分集、攻击源数与天线数对安全性的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AoA认证依赖合法发射机空间签名的唯一性，但多个空间分布的攻击源可能协同伪造该签名，其可行性与系统参数的定量关系尚不明确，需要刻画脆弱性与鲁棒性边界。

Method: 针对配备数字均匀线阵的接收机，通过最小化合法与攻击接收信号间的均方误差推导多空间分布攻击源的最优预编码向量；利用Vandermonde矩阵的秩性质，建立攻击源能够复现合法发射机空间签名的必要与充分条件。

Result: 当攻击源数少于接收天线数时，除非至少一个攻击源满足特定AoA条件，否则无法完美复现合法签名；当攻击源数不少于接收天线数时，若没有攻击源满足该AoA条件，增加接收天线数可降低冒充成功概率。数值结果验证了理论分析并评估了AoA认证的安全性能。

Conclusion: AoA认证的安全性由角域分集与攻击源/天线数量比共同决定，接收天线数与AoA分布条件是抵御协同冒充攻击的关键设计参数。

Abstract: This paper investigates cooperative impersonation attacks against angle-of-arrival (AoA)-based authentication for a wireless communication receiver equipped with a digital uniform linear array. Specifically, we characterize the vulnerability and robustness of this authentication system in relation to adversarial angular diversity and the relative numbers of adversarial sources and receive antennas. To this end, we first derive the optimal precoding vector for multiple spatially distributed adversarial sources by minimizing the mean squared error between legitimate and adversarial received signals. By means of the rank property of Vandermonde matrices, we then establish necessary and sufficient conditions under which the adversarial sources can reproduce the legitimate transmitter's spatial signature. With fewer adversarial sources than receive antennas, perfect reproduction is not possible without at least one adversarial source satisfying a specific AoA condition. In the other case, increasing the number of receive antennas can reduce impersonation success probabilities when none of the adversarial sources has an AoA satisfying this condition. Numerical results validate the theoretical analysis and evaluate the security performance of AoA-based authentication.

</details>


### [726] [Beyond Diagonal RIS for Physical-Layer Security: Low-Complexity Solution in the Low-SNR Regime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39533)
*Rawan Derbas,Hamad Yahya*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文研究相关窃听信道下基于超对角可重构智能表面（BD-RIS）的物理层安全，结合发射天线选择（TAS）与基于特征向量的散射矩阵设计，在低SNR区最大化保密速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在合法与窃听信道强相关时，传统以合法用户为中心或以迫零消除窃听泄漏的设计效果受限；同时单一射频链路需兼顾发射分集。因此需在低SNR区利用BD-RIS灵活散射与TAS实现增强与抑制的平衡。

Method: 采用一阶保密速率近似，提出两阶段方案：第一阶段基于有效信道上界设计两种TAS方案；第二阶段针对单连接、群连接、全连接三种BD-RIS架构设计基于特征向量的散射矩阵，兼顾合法信号增强与信息泄漏抑制而不强制零泄漏。

Result: 仿真表明所提方案提升保密性能，尤其在合法与窃听信道强相关条件下优势明显。

Conclusion: BD-RIS结合TAS可在相关窃听信道中有效提升PLS性能，非迫零的平衡式设计优于合法用户中心或窃听零化准则。

Abstract: This letter investigates beyond diagonal reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (BD-RIS) for physical-layer security (PLS) in correlated wiretap channels. A multi-antenna transmitter is considered, and transmit antenna selection (TAS) is used to exploit transmit-side diversity with a single active radio-frequency (RF) chain. Using the first-order secrecy rate approximation, we develop a two-stage scheme to maximize the secrecy rate in the low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regime. In the first stage, two TAS schemes are developed based on the effective channel upper-bound. In the second stage, an eigenvector-based BD-RIS scattering matrix is designed for single-connected, group-connected, and fully-connected architectures. Unlike legitimate-user-centric or eavesdropping-nulling designs, the proposed approach balances legitimate-user signal enhancement and information-leakage suppression without forcing zero leakage. Simulation results show improved secrecy performance, particularly under a strong correlation between legitimate and eavesdropping channels.

</details>


### [727] [Human Activity Recognition using Ceiling-Mounted Multi-Radar Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39628)
*Ananya Prabhu,Aditi Site,Tarmo Lipping*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种基于三台吊顶雷达点云融合、无需摄像头与穿戴设备的室内连续活动监测系统，并实时可视化。随机森林帧级分类精度为随机划分74%、留一参与者68%。去掉位置特征后降至46%/44%，表明存在对房间布局的部分依赖；改用窗口级非位置特征可达67%/65%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 辅助生活场景中的连续活动监测应避免使用摄像头或穿戴设备，雷达是合适方案；但现有雷达研究多用单一传感器、活动在孤立条件下采集，且很少有实时结果输出。

Method: 融合三台吊顶式雷达传感器的点云，采用密度聚类；提取运动与姿态特征用于活动分类；结果在实时仪表盘上展示。八名参与者以单一连续场景完成日常活动进行初步验证，对比随机80/20划分与留一参与者交叉验证，并做消融（去除位置特征、改用窗口级特征）。

Result: 随机森林帧级精度：随机80/20划分为74%，留一参与者为68%；无位置特征时降至46%和44%；无位置特征的窗口级特征为67%和65%。

Conclusion: 多雷达点云融合可实现实时、无摄像头的连续室内活动监测；但位置特征贡献显著，模型对房间布局存在部分依赖，窗口级特征可在不使用位置信息时部分补偿性能下降。样本规模（8人）为初步结论，泛化性有待更大规模验证。

Abstract: Continuous activity monitoring in assisted living should work without cameras or wearable devices. Radar meets this requirement, but most radar studies use a single sensor and activities recorded in isolation, and few deliver results in real time. We present an indoor monitoring system in which point clouds from three ceiling-mounted radar sensors are fused using density-based clustering, movement and posture features are derived for activity classification, and results are shown on a real-time dashboard. In a preliminary study with eight participants performing everyday activities as one continuous scenario, a random forest reached 74% frame-level accuracy with a random 80/20 split and 68% with leave-one-participant-out evaluation. Without position features, accuracy fell to 46% and 44%, indicating partial dependence on room layout, while window-level features without position reached 67% and 65%.

</details>


### [728] [Implementation and Validation of Mismatch-Tolerant High-Gain OTA with a Calibrated Negative Conductance Load](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39699)
*Mayank Aggarwal,Naveen Kadayinti*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在65nm CMOS中提出基于自动负电导校准的mismatch容忍高增益OTA电路实现，片上校准环路无需复制电路或外部调谐，通过将单位增益反馈稳态误差趋零提升增益，并用6-bit CDAC比较器失调校准将失调标准差从4.11mV降至132μV。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OTA有限输出电导限制其增益，现有负电导补偿需复制电路或外部调谐，且高增益所需的亚毫伏稳态误差检测受比较器失调等实际非理想因素制约。

Method: 采用交叉耦合晶体管对补偿OTA有限输出电导，配片上校准环路自动调节；以单位增益反馈驱动稳态误差趋零的方式校准增益；针对比较器失调、DAC设计及减法器增益/失调进行处理，设计6-bit电容DAC比较器失调校准方案以可靠检测亚毫伏稳态误差。

Result: 后布局蒙特卡洛仿真显示比较器失调标准差由4.11mV降至132μV，校准后最大失调625μV；完整校准电路经后布局仿真实现与评估。

Conclusion: 所提自动负电导校准方案可在无复制电路与外部调谐条件下实现高增益OTA，并通过CDAC失调校准满足亚毫伏误差检测需求，验证了电路级可行性。

Abstract: This paper presents the circuit-level implementation of a mismatch-tolerant high-gain operational transconductance amplifier (OTA) using automatic negative-conductance calibration in 65-nm CMOS. The technique enhances OTA gain by compensating for its finite output conductance using a cross-coupled transistor pair, with an on-chip calibration loop that eliminates the need for a replica circuit or external tuning. The calibration routine increases the gain by driving the steady state error of the OTA in a unity gain feedback loop toward zero. The implementation addresses practical challenges involving comparator offset, DAC design, and subtractor gain and offset. A 6-bit capacitive DAC (CDAC)-based comparator offset calibration scheme enables reliable detection of the sub-millivolt steady state error required for high OTA gain. Post-layout Monte Carlo simulations show that the comparator offset standard deviation is reduced from 4.11 mV to 132 $μ$V, with a maximum observed post-calibration offset of 625 $μ$V. The complete calibration circuitry is implemented and evaluated through post-layout simulations.

</details>


### [729] [Integrated Sensing and Communication via Channel Knowledge Maps Built from Beam Feedback Coefficients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.39917)
*Chongda Huang,Yue Xiao,Gang Wu,Vladimir Poulkov,Xianfu Lei,Wei Xiang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于信道知识地图（CKM）的定位框架，利用通信波束管理过程中采集的波束反馈系数作为紧凑位置指纹，避免全信道反馈与额外感知测量；基站借助粗位置先验检索邻近CKM条目并做局部插值细化定位，同时分析空间指纹变化与定位精度的关系及反馈量化影响，仿真显示在测试多径环境下相比稠密与稀疏化频谱指纹具有更优的存储—精度折中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CKM定位依赖精细信道指纹，存储开销大；作者希望复用通信系统本就存在的波束管理信令，实现低存储、免额外感知的定位。

Method: 以波束管理中的波束反馈系数作为紧凑指纹构建CKM；利用粗位置先验在基站侧检索邻近CKM条目，通过局部插值细化位置估计；理论分析空间指纹变化与定位精度的关系，并评估反馈量化对性能的影响。

Result: 仿真表明，在测试的多径环境下，该方法相较稠密频谱指纹与稀疏化频谱指纹在存储—精度权衡上更具优势；反馈量化效应得到了量化评估。

Conclusion: 波束反馈系数可作为高效的位置指纹支撑CKM定位，在保证精度的同时显著降低存储需求，为通信—定位一体化提供了低开销方案。

Abstract: Channel knowledge maps (CKMs) support wireless localization by linking channel features to user locations. Detailed channel fingerprints, however, can require substantial storage. This paper proposes a CKM-based localization framework that uses beam feedback coefficients collected during communication. These coefficients serve as compact location fingerprints within the beam management process, without requiring full channel feedback or additional sensing measurements. Using a coarse position prior, the base station searches nearby CKM entries and refines the location estimate through local interpolation. We analyze the relationship between spatial fingerprint variation and localization accuracy, and evaluate the effect of feedback quantization. Simulations show favorable storage--accuracy trade-offs relative to dense and sparsified spectral fingerprinting in the tested multipath environments.

</details>


### [730] [Measuring the Value of Communication in Multi-Agent Tracking Under Finite-Rate Belief Sharing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40010)
*Danial Dehghani,Maximilian Lübke,Zahra Seifaei,Norman Franchi*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究速率受限信息交换下协作多智能体跟踪中的通信价值（VoC），刻画低速率退化、通信高效区与收益递减的“拐点”区间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有工作分别研究了分布式跟踪、量化通信与鲁棒融合，但尚不清楚在何种通信速率下即可获得大部分可实现的跟踪增益，以及超过该速率后额外通信资源仅带来边际收益。

Method: 静态智能体通过异构距离与方位测量观测运动目标，各自运行局部扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF），对后验状态均值进行量化后交换，并用协方差交叉（CI）融合；性能以RMSE随通信速率变化评估，并与无通信基线、集中式oracle及CI理想参考对比。

Result: 通信并非一致有益：极低速率因量化粗糙反而降低性能，中速率可恢复大部分可实现增益。该场景下每智能体速率由4 bit/s升至12 bit/s时RMSE由13.93 m降至6.35 m，进一步升至32 bit/s仅小幅改善至5.93 m。

Conclusion: 存在明显的中速率“拐点”区域，其后剩余误差主要源于融合架构（CI）的保守性；所提框架刻画了低速率退化、通信高效运行与收益递减，并凸显速率与感知几何共同决定通信收益。

Abstract: This paper investigates the value of communica- tion (VoC) in cooperative multi-agent tracking under rate- constrained information exchange. Although prior work has studied distributed tracking, quantized communication, and robust fusion, it remains unclear at what communication rate most of the achievable tracking gain is obtained, beyond which additional communication resources yield only marginal benefit. We consider stationary agents that observe a moving target through heterogeneous range and bearing measurements, perform local extended Kalman filtering (EKF), quantize their posterior state means, and fuse exchanged information via covariance intersection (CI). Performance is evaluated versus communication rate relative to no-communication baselines, a centralized oracle, and a CI-perfect reference. The results show that communication is not uniformly beneficial: very low rates can degrade performance due to coarse quantization, whereas moderate rates recover most of the achievable gain. In the considered scenario, increasing the rate from 4 to 12 bit/s per agent reduces the root-mean-square error (RMSE) from 13.93 m to 6.35 m, while a further increase to 32 bit/s per agent improves it only marginally to 5.93 m. This reveals a clear knee region at moderate rates, beyond which the remaining loss is mainly due to the conservatism of the fusion architecture. Overall, the proposed framework characterizes low-rate degradation, communication-efficient operation, and diminishing returns, while highlighting the joint role of rate and sensing geometry in determining communication benefit.

</details>


### [731] [AFDM-ISAC Design Amalgamating FMCW Radar and Carrier Aggregation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40107)
*Qu Luo,Qihao Peng,Zihuai Lin,Maged Elkashlan,Pei Xiao,Rahim Tafazolli,Lajos Hanzo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文提出载波聚合辅助的AFDM（CA-AFDM）框架用于通感一体化（ISAC），并设计FMCW式去啁啾接收机及两类CA方案，实现高精度时延-多普勒估计与跨域感知辅助信道估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AFDM的啁啾子载波具备脉冲压缩特性，但单一AFDM波形的感知精度与距离分辨率有限；同时分数时延与分数多普勒（FDFD）信道下AFDM信道估计困难。因此需要一种既提升感知性能又改善通信信道估计的统一框架。

Method: 1) 构建CA辅助的AFDM ISAC系统，采用受FMCW启发的去啁啾接收机利用啁啾子载波的脉冲压缩；2) 设计两类CA方案：Type-I在多CA带聚合回波后再做雷达处理以降低估计误差且硬件开销低；Type-II将不同CA带的啁啾设计为连续啁啾集合以扩大感知带宽、提升距离分辨率，并据此提出可变子载波感知与异步感知方案；3) 推导FDFD信道下AFDM的广义输入-输出关系，提出跨域感知辅助信道估计（CDS-CE），在时域估计时延-多普勒参数并在仿射域恢复信道系数。

Result: 仿真表明，与现有先进方法相比，该框架在感知精度、距离分辨率以及信道估计性能上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: CA-AFDM结合去啁啾接收与两类CA方案，可在低硬件开销下兼顾感知精度与分辨率，并通过CDS-CE有效应对FDFD信道估计难题，为AFDM-based ISAC提供可行且性能优越的设计方案。

Abstract: Carrier-aggregation (CA)-assisted affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) is conceived for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW)-inspired dechirping receiver is developed to exploit the inherent pulse-compression property of AFDM chirp subcarriers for accurate delay-Doppler estimation. To further enhance sensing performance, a pair of CA schemes is proposed. The Type-I CA scheme improves sensing accuracy by aggregating echo signals across multiple CA bands prior to radar processing, thereby reducing estimation error with low hardware overhead. The Type-II CA scheme enhances range resolution by effectively enlarging the sensing bandwidth, where chirps from different CA bands are designed to form a continuous set of chirp signals. Based on this principle, variable subcarrier sensing and asynchronous sensing schemes are developed. For the communication receiver, the generalized input-output relationship of AFDM is derived under both fractional delay and fractional Doppler (FDFD) channels. To address the challenge of FDFD estimation, a cross-domain sensing-assisted channel estimation (CDS-CE) scheme is proposed to facilitate time-domain delay-Doppler parameter estimation and affine-domain channel coefficient recovery. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves significant improvements in sensing accuracy and resolution, as well as in channel estimation performance compared with state-of-the-art methods.

</details>


### [732] [Adversarial Pilot Injection Against AI-Based CSI Feedback in FDD Massive MIMO Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40229)
*Jinli Zhai,Yusen Wang,Qimei Cui,Zengbao Zhu,Shengyuan Liang,Xiaofeng Tao*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文识别并评估了针对AI-based CSI反馈的"对抗性导频注入"攻击路径：攻击者在导频获取阶段注入扰动，使量化比特虽正确传输却编码了被污染的信道估计；提出APG攻击生成器与AAT对抗训练防御。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI-based CSI反馈虽能降低FDD大规模MIMO开销，但其重构质量依赖导频获取的完整性。既有研究多关注量化反馈传输环节，忽视了估计端在编码前即被污染这一上游攻击面。

Method: 建模完整攻击链：攻击者传播→LMMSE估计→压缩→量化→解码，并施加总发射能量约束。提出对抗扰动生成器（APG），仅依赖信道统计信息，部署时无需当前合法CSI或瞬时攻击者信道观测。防御端采用交替对抗训练（AAT），联合适配反馈编码器与解码器以应对受污染导频；并在条件匹配训练下针对最终接收机重新优化APG进行评测。

Result: 在Rician攻击者信道因子10 dB、发射扰动-信号比-4 dB时，APG使基站CSI重构NMSE达0.84 dB，而高斯干扰仅为-10.31 dB。估计器定向攻击与重构定向攻击产生不同的误差排序；重构损伤还进一步恶化波束成形性能。AAT在六种代表性信道—功率条件下将NMSE降低2.40–3.79 dB。

Conclusion: 量化反馈的正确投递不足以保证CSI重构质量，导频获取环节须与量化反馈传输一并防护；AAT是有效的对抗性缓解手段，但需条件匹配训练及针对最终接收机重优化攻击方能公平评估。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI)-based channel state information (CSI) feedback reduces overhead in frequency division duplexing (FDD) massive multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) systems, yet its reconstructed CSI depends on the integrity of pilot acquisition. This paper identifies and evaluates the attack path of adversarial pilot injection against this feedback. A transmitted disturbance can damage the user-side estimation before encoding; correctly delivered quantized bits can still represent a contaminated channel estimate. We model this path through attacker propagation, linear minimum mean square error estimation, compression, quantization, and decoding under a total transmit-energy constraint. An adversarial perturbation generator (APG) implements the attack using channel statistics without current legitimate CSI or instantaneous attacker-channel observations at deployment. At a Rician attacker-channel factor of 10~dB and a transmit perturbation-to-signal ratio of $-4$~dB, APG produces a normalized mean-square error (NMSE) of 0.84~dB in base-station CSI reconstruction, compared with $-10.31$~dB for Gaussian interference. Estimator-targeted and reconstruction-targeted attacks yield different error orderings, and reconstruction damage also degrades beamforming. As a countermeasure, alternating adversarial training (AAT) adapts the feedback encoder and decoder to contaminated pilots. With condition-matched training and APGs reoptimized for the final receiver, AAT reduces NMSE by 2.40--3.79~dB across six representative channel--power conditions. The results demonstrate the importance of protecting pilot acquisition alongside quantized feedback delivery.

</details>


### [733] [Confidence-Aware Speed-over-Ground Estimation from Doppler Spectra via Reconstruction-Based Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.40253)
*Malte Stelzer,Marvin Sach,Timo Bartels,Dinu Mihailescu-Stoica,Sören Kohnert,Florian Poprawa,Marc Zeller,Tim Fingscheidt*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种置信度感知的对地速度估计方法：基于自编码器潜空间特征与重建任务实现速度估计及逐帧误差界预测，在铁路域数据上优于经典基线并具鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向铁路等移动平台，基于对地多普勒谱的速度估计至关重要；经典信号处理方法在理想条件下准确，但在恶劣条件下性能显著退化，且缺乏可靠性指示。

Method: （1）将利用自编码器重建任务进行性能估计的思想迁移至多普勒雷达；（2）在自编码器潜空间特征上附加对地速度估计头；（3）推理阶段舍弃重建解码器，改用低成本专用置信头做逐帧误差界估计；（4）采用噪声增强训练提升鲁棒性。

Result: 实验中速度估计精度优于经典基线，同时提供有信息量的置信度估计，能指示单帧预测的可靠性，即使在不利信号条件下亦有效。

Conclusion: 自编码器潜特征联合速度估计头与专用置信头、配合噪声增强训练，可在铁路域多普勒谱上实现准确且可自评可靠性的对地速度估计。

Abstract: Reliable speed-over-ground estimation from ground-facing Doppler spectra is essential for mobile platforms such as railway systems. Classical signal-processing approaches can provide accurate estimates under favorable conditions, but often degrade in challenging conditions. We propose confidence-aware speed-over-ground estimation trained on rail-domain data that estimates speed over ground and frame-level confidence from Doppler spectra with several novel contributions: First, we transfer the idea of exploiting a reconstruction task by an autoencoder for performance estimation from previous work to Doppler RaDAR. Second, we append a speed-over-ground estimation head operating on the autoencoder's latent space features. Third, we omit the reconstruction decoder during inference but add a low-cost dedicated confidence head for frame-wise error-bound estimation. Fourth, we reveal how noise augmentation training can provide high robustness to the method. Experiments show that our approach improves speed estimation accuracy over classical baselines while providing informative confidence estimates that indicate the reliability of individual predictions, even under adverse signal conditions.

</details>
